answer: The picture shows information about annual income of bachelor degrees holders in diﬀerent ﬁelds. First of all, the largest number of 1980 comes from business, which is 91000, while the smallest number comes from language and literature, which is 64000. When we look at the year of 2000, the largest number also comes from business, which is 105000 and much larger than that in recent years. By the way, the smallest number still comes from language and literature, which is 80000 and still larger than that in recent years. In conclusion, we can ﬁnd that the annual income of bachelor degree holder in diﬀerent ﬁelds increases generally over the years.
answer_zh: 图为不同领域本科生年收入信息。首先，1980年人数最多的是商业，为91000人；最少的是语言文学方面，为64000人。再看2000年，人数最多的也是商业，为105000人，比近几年多很多。顺便说一句，数量最少的仍然是语言文学，有8万，仍然比近几年多。综上所述，我们可以发现，不同领域本科学历持有者的年收入逐年普遍增长。

answer: The picture shows information about company expenses in 2014 ﬁrst of all the largest number can be found and salaries and wages, which is around 40%. What’s more, the second largest number can be found in overhead, which is about 20%. To be more speciﬁc, their proportion of marketing is as large as research and development, possessing 10% each. Moreover, the smallest number can be found in miscellaneous, which is 5%. In conclusion, the picture is very useful.
answer_zh: 图为2014年公司开支信息，其中数量最多的是薪资和工资，占比在40%左右。另外，第二大的数字是开销，大约为20%。具体来说，他们的营销比重和研发比重一样大，各占10%。而且，杂项的数量最少，为5%。总之，这张图非常有用。

title_en: Electricity use in an English restaurant
answer: The picture shows information about the electricity use in an English restaurant in 2016. First of all, the largest proportion can be found in food preparation, which is around 25%. Secondly, the second largest number can be found in refrigeration, sanitation as well as heating, which is around 17% each. In addition, the smallest number can be found in cooling, which is about 2%. What’s more, the electricity use in lighting is a little bit larger than cooling. Besides, there are also some other items, including oﬃce equipment, computers, and ventilation. In conclusion, the picture is very informative.
answer_zh: 图为2016年一家英国餐厅的用电量信息。首先可以发现，占比最大的是食物准备，约为25%。其次，第二大行业是制冷、卫生和供暖，各占 17% 左右。另外，冷却方面的数字最小，约为2%。更重要的是，照明用电量比制冷用电量要大一些。除此之外，还有一些其他物品，包括办公设备、电脑、通风设备等。总之，这张图片信息量很大。

answer: This bar chart compares the percentages of people participating in volunteering at least once a month. In formal volunteering, women have a higher percentage, nearly 30%, while men are at over 20%. For informal volunteering, women also lead with roughly 40%, and men stand at over 30%. Overall, women took part in volunteering more than men in both categories, and informal volunteering was way more common overall.
answer_zh: 该条形图比较了每月至少参与一次志愿服务的人数百分比。在正式志愿服务中，女性比例较高，接近30%，而男性则超过20%。在非正式志愿服务方面，女性也领先，大约占 40%，男性则超过 30%。总体而言，在这两个类别中，女性参与志愿服务的人数都多于男性，而且非正式志愿服务总体上更为普遍。

answer: The line graph compares home rental rates in Portugal and Luxembourg from 2010 to 2017. In 2010, Luxembourg’s rate stood at around 32%, much higher than Portugal’s 20%. Luxembourg’s ﬁgure fell gradually until 2013, when both countries reached 25%. After that, both rates remained stable, ending at roughly 22% in 2017. Overall, it shows a clear downward trend for Luxembourg and little change for Portugal.
answer_zh: 该折线图比较了葡萄牙和卢森堡2010年至2017年的房屋租金率。2010年，卢森堡的房屋租金率为32%左右，远高于葡萄牙的20%。卢森堡的数字逐渐下降，直到 2013 年，两国都达到了 25%。此后，两个利率保持稳定，2017 年约为 22%。总体而言，卢森堡呈明显下降趋势，葡萄牙则变化不大。

answer: This ﬂoor plan shows the layout of an oﬃce. At the top, there’s a big store room, with an entrance on the left that leads out to the road, and a ﬁre exit on the right. Below the store, you’ll ﬁnd two meeting rooms: meeting room 1 on the left, and meeting room 2 on the right. To the right of meeting room 2, there’s a staircase, plus a toilet in the bottom right corner. Overall, the oﬃce has clear access routes, meeting areas and essential facilities.
answer_zh: 该平面图显示了办公室的布局。顶部有一个大储藏室，左边有一个通向马路的入口，右边有一个消防出口。在商店下方，您会发现两个会议室：左侧为会议室 1，右侧为会议室 2。 2号会议室的右侧有一个楼梯，右下角有一个厕所。总体而言，该办公室拥有清晰的出入路线、会议区域和基本设施。

answer: The following graph gives information about water wheels with diﬀerent rotational directions On the left, we can see a water wheel rotating anticlockwise. Then on the right, there is another water wheel, which is rotating clockwise. According to this graph, the water wheels are both overshot ones, with a ﬂume overhead. And through it, water ﬂows down on the wheels. Finally, tail races lie below the water wheels, and they enable falling water ﬂow away. To sum up, the graph tells about water wheels.
answer_zh: 下图给出了不同旋转方向的水车的信息。在左边，我们可以看到一个逆时针旋转的水车。然后在右边，还有一个水车，它是顺时针旋转的。根据该图，水轮均为上冲式水轮，上方有水槽。水通过它流到车轮上。最后，尾槽位于水轮下方，它们可以使落下的水流走。总而言之，该图讲述了水轮。

answer: The following graph shows information about age groups in the city of Canterbury and the rest of new Zeland in 2016. According to the graph we can see, for Canterbury, the largest number can be found in 45-59, which is about 22%. After that, for New Zealand, 15-29 has the largest number, which is about 20%. It is clear to see, for 0-14, the ﬁgure for New Zealand is greater than that in Canterbury. To sum up, the graph is very informative.
answer_zh: 下图显示了2016年坎特伯雷市和新西兰其他地区的年龄组信息。从图中我们可以看到，对于坎特伯雷来说，最多的年龄段是45-59岁，约为22%。之后，对于新西兰来说，15-29岁的人数最多，约为20%。可以明显看出，0-14，新西兰的数字高于坎特伯雷。总而言之，该图信息量很大。

answer: The following graph shows information about UK energy consumption. According to the graph we can see, for 1970, the largest number can be found in solid fuel and petroleum, which are about 40%. After that, for 2010, the largest number can also be found in gas, which is about 60%. It is clear to see, the ﬁgure for electricity in 2010 is greater than that in
answer_zh: 下图显示了有关英国能源消耗的信息。从图中可以看出，1970年，固体燃料和石油的数量最多，约为40%。此后，2010年，最大数量也出现在天然气中，约为60%。可以明显看出，2010年的用电量比2010年还要高。

title_en: To sum up, the graph is very informative.

answer: The following graph shows information about time spent on services. According to the graph we can see, for 2011, the largest number can be found in TV, which is 218. After that, for 2012, the largest number can also be found in TV, which is 241. It is clear to see, ﬁxed phone has the smallest number for both 2011 and 2012, which is 14 and 10 respectively. It is also clear to see, the ﬁgure for radio in 2011 is greater than that in 2012. To sum up, the graph is very informative.
answer_zh: 下图显示了有关在服务上花费的时间的信息。从图中我们可以看到，2011年，电视的数量最多，为218台。之后，2012年，电视的数量也最多，为241台。可以看出，2011年和2012年，固定电话的数量最少，分别为14台和10台。还可以清楚地看到，2011 年广播的数据要大于 2012 年。综上所述，该图信息量很大。

answer: The following graph shows information about girls and boys growth rates. According to the graph we can see, for Boys, the largest number can be found in 2, which is about 14 centimeters. After that, for girls, the smallest number can be found in 16, which is about 0. It is clear to see, the ﬁgure for boys is always greater than that for girls. To sum up, the graph is very informative.
answer_zh: 下图显示了有关女孩和男孩增长率的信息。从图中我们可以看到，对于男孩来说，最大的数字是2，大约是14厘米。之后，对于女孩来说，最小的数字是16，大约为0。显然，男孩的数字总是大于女孩的。总而言之，该图信息量很大。

answer: This ﬂow chart talks about the salt bed, this picture is so diﬃcult because it has many steps, the ﬁrst step is the water, and it goes into a pump which is in purple color, and the third step is salt dissolved to brine, which is located at the bottom. The next step is brine, which will be collected in a tank, and the ﬁnal step is chemical plant, which is dangerous. In conclusion, this picture is about the story of salt bed.
answer_zh: 这张流程图讲的是盐床，这张图很难，因为它有很多步骤，第一步是水，它进入紫色的泵，第三步是盐溶解成盐水，位于底部。下一步是盐水，将收集在罐中，最后一步是化工厂，这是危险的。总之，这张图是关于盐床的故事。

title_en: Types of clubs that people belong to
title_zh: 人们所属的俱乐部类型
answer: This bar chart from Statistics New Zealand illustrates the participation rates of New Zealanders in diﬀerent club types for the year ending March 2015. Overall, sports clubs were the most popular at nearly 28%, while political clubs were the least popular at just 2%. Religion clubs followed at around 21%, with hobby clubs next at 16%. Besides, volunteer, professional and neighborhood clubs had lower participation, ranging from 7% to 12%. In summary, this bar chart shows a clear preference for sports, religion and hobby clubs.
answer_zh: 新西兰统计局的这张条形图显示了截至 2015 年 3 月的一年新西兰人对不同类型俱乐部的参与率。总体而言，体育俱乐部最受欢迎，接近 28%，而政治俱乐部最不受欢迎，仅为 2%。宗教俱乐部紧随其后，占 21% 左右，其次是业余爱好俱乐部，占 16%。此外，志愿者、专业俱乐部和邻里俱乐部的参与度较低，为 7% 至 12%。总之，这张条形图显示了对体育、宗教和业余爱好俱乐部的明显偏好。

answer: The image shows a ﬂoor plan of an apartment or room with labeled dimensions and features. From the diagram, we can see the total length is 6.9 meters and the total width is 3.8 meters. Key features include a kitchen, a bathroom, a double bed, a wardrobe, and a desk. The room also has a window. Various dimensions are provided, such as 2 meters, 1.4 meters, 2.2 meters, and 3.1 meters, indicating the sizes of diﬀerent sections. In conclusion, the plan eﬀectively illustrates the layout and measurements of the living space.
answer_zh: 该图像显示了带有标签尺寸和功能的公寓或房间的平面图。从图中我们可以看到总长度为6.9米，总宽度为3.8米。主要设施包括厨房、浴室、一张双人床、一个衣柜和一张桌子。房间还有一扇窗户。提供2米、1.4米、2.2米、3.1米等多种尺寸，表示不同断面的尺寸。总之，该平面图有效地说明了居住空间的布局和尺寸。

title_en: Layers of the Earth and the distance
answer: This diagram describes the layers of the Earth. There are four main layers: the inner core, the outer core, the mantle, and the crust. The mantle is the thickest layer at about 1,800 miles, while the crust is the thinnest, ranging from 5 to 25 miles. The inner core is about 800 miles thick, and the outer core is approximately 1,400 miles thick. Overall, the table clearly shows the structure of our planet.
answer_zh: 该图描述了地球的各层。主要有四个层：内核、外核、地幔和地壳。地幔最厚，厚约 1,800 英里，而地壳最薄，厚 5 至 25 英里。内核厚约 800 英里，外核厚约 1,400 英里。总体而言，该表清楚地显示了我们星球的结构。

answer: The image illustrates the life cycle of a mosquito, which consists of four main stages. It begins with eggs, which then hatch into larvae. The larvae develop into pupae, and ﬁnally, adult mosquitoes emerge from the pupae. This cycle repeats continuously. In conclusion, the diagram clearly shows the four stages of mosquito development from eggs to adults.
answer_zh: 该图展示了蚊子的生命周期，由四个主要阶段组成。它从卵开始，然后孵化成幼虫。幼虫发育成蛹，最后，成蚊从蛹中孵化出来。这个循环不断重复。总之，该图清楚地显示了蚊子从卵到成虫发育的四个阶段。

title_zh: 按地区划分的合法移民
answer: This graph shows the changing sources of U.S. legal immigrants from 1992 to 2012. In 1992, most came from Latin America at 44% and Asia-Paciﬁc at 36%. By 2012, Asia-Paciﬁc rose to 38%, equaling Latin America which dropped to 38%. Europe 's share fell from 13% to 8%, while North America, Middle East, and Africa all saw small increases. Overall, Asia-Paciﬁc became equally dominant while Latin America declined sharply.
answer_zh: 该图显示了 1992 年至 2012 年美国合法移民来源的变化。1992 年，大多数来自拉丁美洲，占 44%，来自亚太地区，占 36%。到 2012 年，亚太地区上升至 38%，与拉丁美洲下降至 38% 持平。欧洲的份额从13%下降到8%，而北美、中东和非洲均出现小幅增长。总体而言，亚太地区同样占据主导地位，而拉丁美洲则大幅下滑。

answer: This bar chart illustrates the population in millions of seven major European countries for the years 1996 and 2007. The countries included are Germany, Spain, France, Italy, Poland, the United Kingdom, and Turkey. We can see that Turkey had the largest population in both years, while Poland had the smallest. The data shows a general increase in population for most countries over this eleven-year period. In conclusion, this graph provides a clear comparison of demographic sizes and trends across these key European nations.
answer_zh: 此条形图显示了 1996 年和 2007 年七个主要欧洲国家的百万人口。其中包括德国、西班牙、法国、意大利、波兰、英国和土耳其。我们可以看到，土耳其这两年的人口数量最多，而波兰的人口数量最少。数据显示，在这十一年期间，大多数国家的人口普遍增长。总之，该图清楚地比较了这些主要欧洲国家的人口规模和趋势。

answer: This chart shows the share of companies according to their size, categorized by the number of employees. The data is divided into three main groups. The largest segment, representing half of the companies, are small businesses with 3 to 6 employees. Medium-sized companies, which have between 7 and 50 employees, make up 40% of the total. Finally, the smallest segment, at 10%, consists of large companies that have more than 50 employees. In summary, the majority of the companies are small, while large companies constitute the smallest group.
answer_zh: 该图表显示了按规模和员工人数分类的公司所占的份额。数据分为三个主要组。最大的部分是拥有 3 至 6 名员工的小型企业，占公司的一半。拥有 7 至 50 名员工的中型公司占总数的 40%。最后，最小的部分（10%）由拥有 50 名以上员工的大公司组成。综上所述，小公司占大多数，大公司是最小的群体。

answer: This picture provides information about doing an experiment. On the left-hand side of the map, there is a professor who wears a uniform. And on the right-hand side, people will ﬁnd a student who is doing an experiment. After that, there are two beakers with white liquid, which is located at the bottom of the map. Finally, the student is pouring the red liquid into another beaker, which means that the chemistry reaction is about to take place. In summary, this is a professional experiment.
answer_zh: 这张图片提供了有关进行实验的信息。在地图的左侧，有一位穿着制服的教授。在右手边，人们会发现一个正在做实验的学生。之后，有两个装有白色液体的烧杯，位于地图的底部。最后，学生将红色液体倒入另一个烧杯中，这意味着化学反应即将发生。综上所述，这是一次专业的实验。

answer: The picture shows the layout of a bedroom with an ensuite bathroom. When we look at the picture, we can see diﬀerent areas clearly marked. On the top left side, there is an ensuite, which is connected to the main room. In the middle part of the room, a desk is placed near the bathroom area. At the bottom right corner, there is a bed, while a wardrobe is located on the bottom left side. Overall, the image shows that the room is well-organized and suitable for daily living.
answer_zh: 图片显示了一间带套间浴室的卧室的布局。当我们看图片时，我们可以看到不同的区域被清楚地标记出来。左上角有一个套间，与主房间相连。房间中部靠近浴室区域放置了一张书桌。右下角有一张床，左下角有一个衣柜。总体而言，图像显示房间布置良好，适合日常生活。

answer: This line graph tracks Ontario’s manufacturing employment (blue, '000s) and Canada’s USD exchange rate (red) 1981-2013. Employment peaked ~2001 then fell, while the exchange rate dropped to 0.65 in 2001 before rising. There’s an inverse trend: when employment fell, the exchange rate often rose.
answer_zh: 该线图追踪了 1981-2013 年安大略省的制造业就业（蓝色，'000s）和加拿大的美元汇率（红色）。就业率在 2001 年达到顶峰，然后下降，而汇率在 2001 年跌至 0.65，然后上升。有一个相反的趋势：当就业下降时，汇率往往会上升。

answer: This chart compares age distributions of male (blue) and female (pink) graduates. Both groups have the largest share in the 1-15 age range (15.5% for females, 20.5% for males). The smallest share is in the 85+ group (0.4% females, 0.8% males). Males have slightly higher proportions across most age groups.
answer_zh: 该图表比较了男性（蓝色）和女性（粉色）毕业生的年龄分布。这两个群体在 1-15 岁年龄段所占比例最大（女性 15.5%，男性 20.5%）。比例最小的是 85 岁以上群体（0.4% 女性，0.8% 男性）。在大多数年龄组中，男性的比例略高。

answer: This pie chart shows U.S. pet-owning households by pet type. Dogs (65.1 million, 44.6%) and cats (46.5 million, 31.9%) dominate. Freshwater ﬁsh (11.1 million) follow, while smaller groups like saltwater ﬁsh and horses each make up 1.5%. Overall, common pets (dogs, cats) account for most pet-owning households.
answer_zh: 此饼图按宠物类型显示了美国拥有宠物的家庭。狗（6510万，44.6%）和猫（4650万，31.9%）占主导地位。淡水鱼（1110 万条）紧随其后，咸水鱼和马等较小群体各占 1.5%。总体而言，普通宠物（狗、猫）占养宠物家庭的大多数。

answer: This map shows the distribution of three gorilla species in Africa. There are three types of gorillas: the Western Lowland Gorilla, shown in yellow, is distributed in the western part of central Africa. The Mountain Gorilla, in turquoise, is located in the eastern part of central Africa. The Eastern Lowland Gorilla, in purple, is also in the eastern region. In summary, this map clearly displays where each of the three gorilla species can be found across Africa.
answer_zh: 这张地图显示了非洲三种大猩猩的分布。大猩猩共有三种类型：黄色所示的西部低地大猩猩，分布于中非西部地区。绿松石色的山地大猩猩位于中非东部。紫色的东部低地大猩猩也位于东部地区。总之，这张地图清楚地显示了这三种大猩猩在非洲的分布区域。

answer: This chart illustrates the population distribution across diﬀerent age groups in Australia, distinguishing between females and males. It shows that the 20-39 age group has the highest proportion for both genders, with 14.8% for females and 15% for males, while the over 80 years age group has the lowest, at 1.9% for females and 1.1% for males. Additionally, in most age groups, males have a slightly higher percentage than females, except for the 60-79 and over 80 years groups where females have a higher proportion. Overall, the population of Australia is most concentrated in the 20-39 age bracket, and the share of older individuals (over 80 years) is relatively small, with subtle gender diﬀerences observed across various age groups.
answer_zh: 该图表显示了澳大利亚不同年龄组的人口分布，区分了女性和男性。数据显示，20-39岁年龄段男女比例最高，女性为14.8%，男性为15%；80岁以上年龄段比例最低，为女性1.9%，男性1.1%。此外，在大多数年龄组中，男性比例略高于女性，但60-79岁和80岁以上群体中女性比例较高。总体而言，澳大利亚人口最集中在20-39岁年龄段，老年人（80岁以上）的比例相对较小，各个年龄段之间存在细微的性别差异。

answer: This image illustrates the process of acid rain formation resulting from industrial and human activities. It shows that nitrogen oxides and sulfur dioxide are emitted into the atmosphere from sources such as industry, transportation, ore smelting, and power generation. These pollutants undergo chemical transformation with the help of nitric acid and sulfuric acid, leading to condensation. Subsequently, through dry fallout or precipitation, they return to the Earth 's surface as acid rain, fog, snow, or mist, which include particulates and gases. In conclusion, the image highlights the cycle of air pollution leading to acid precipitation.
answer_zh: 该图展示了工业和人类活动造成的酸雨形成过程。其显示，工业、交通、矿石冶炼、发电等源头向大气排放氮氧化物和二氧化硫。这些污染物在硝酸和硫酸的帮助下发生化学转化，导致冷凝。随后，通过干燥沉降物或降水，它们以酸雨、雾、雪或雾的形式返回地球表面，其中包括颗粒物和气体。总之，该图像突出显示了空气污染导致酸降水的循环。

title_zh: 工资增长、 消费、 家
answer: This bar chart compares the percentages of wage growth, consumption, and household debt. Wage growth has the lowest percentage, around 5%. Consumption is higher, at about 15%. Household debt stands out with the highest percentage, reaching approximately 40%. Clearly, household debt is signiﬁcantly greater than both wage growth and consumption.
answer_zh: 该条形图比较了工资增长、消费和家庭债务的百分比。工资增长百分比最低，约为 5%。消费较高，约为15%。家庭债务所占比例最高，达到约40%。显然，家庭债务明显高于工资增长和消费。

answer: This organizational chart outlines a company's structure, with the Board of Directors at the top. It oversees four key committees: Risk Management, Nomination and Remuneration, Executive, and Audit (which has an Internal Audit branch). Below the Board is the Chief Executive Oﬃcer, who leads the Company Secretary and two Business Development divisions. Each Business Development division further splits into departments like Sales & Marketing, Warehousing, and Finance & Accounting, ensuring clear hierarchical and functional organization.
answer_zh: 该组织结构图概述了公司的结构，董事会位于最高层。它监督四个主要委员会：风险管理、提名和薪酬、执行和审计（设有内部审计部门）。董事会下方是首席执行官，领导公司秘书和两个业务发展部门。每个业务开发部门进一步分为销售与营销、仓储、财务与会计等部门，确保清晰的层次结构和职能组织。

answer: This diagram vividly presents a restaurant 's smooth ordering process. Diners at table 1 or table 2 ﬁrst use a mobile phone to place their orders. Then, the order swiftly transmits to a computer. Finally, the computer sends instructions to the bar, where staﬀ promptly prepare items like a plate of rice and a bottle of wine. This streamlined workﬂow ensures eﬃcient service.
answer_zh: 这张图形象地展现了一家餐厅流畅的点餐流程。 1号桌或2号桌的食客首先使用手机点餐。然后，命令迅速传输到计算机。最后，电脑向酒吧发送指令，工作人员立即准备一盘米饭和一瓶酒等物品。这种简化的工作流程确保了高效的服务。

answer: This line graph illustrates the collapse of Atlantic cod stock on Newfoundland 's East Coast, focusing on ﬁsh landings from 1850 to 2000. After a long period of relative stability, landings surged sharply around the mid-20th century before plummeting. By 1992, the cod stock had collapsed, with landings near zero, highlighting the severe impact of overﬁshing.
answer_zh: 该线图显示了纽芬兰东海岸大西洋鳕鱼种群的锐减，重点关注 1850 年至 2000 年的鱼类上岸量。经过长期相对稳定后，上岸量在 20 世纪中叶左右急剧上升，然后急剧下降。到 1992 年，鳕鱼数量锐减，捕捞量接近于零，凸显了过度捕捞的严重影响。

answer: This bar chart compares the percentages of formal and informal volunteering jobs between males and females. In formal volunteering, females have a higher percentage, around 33%, while males are at about 20%. For informal volunteering, females also lead with roughly 40%, and males stand at around 25%. Clearly, females participate more in both types. 中频33. Motor Vehicle Theft Trends / 机动车盗窃趋势 #10056 中频 This bar chart titled "Motor Vehicle Theft " illustrates the number of people (per 100,000) aﬀected by motor vehicle theft from 1998 to 2002. In 1998, the number was the highest, around 58 per 100,000. It decreased to about 53.5 in 1999, remained similar at around 53.5 in 2000, increased to around 56 in 2001, and then dropped to around 51 in 2002. Overall, there was a ﬂuctuating trend, with the highest rate in 1998 and the lowest in 2002.

title_en: Housing owned and rented in the UK
title_zh: 在英国拥有和租赁的住房
answer: This chart compares housing ownership and rental types in the UK between 1991 and 2007. The total number of homes increased from 22 million to 27 million over this period. It illustrates the distribution among home owners, social renting, and private renting. The data shows a growth in housing supply and likely changes in tenure patterns, with home ownership remaining a signiﬁcant category throughout these years.
answer_zh: 该图表比较了 1991 年至 2007 年间英国的住房所有权和租赁类型。在此期间，房屋总数从 2200 万套增加到 2700 万套。它说明了房主、社会租赁和私人租赁之间的分布。数据显示，住房供应量有所增长，保有权模式也可能发生变化，这些年来，住房所有权仍然是一个重要的类别。

answer: This line graph depicts the growth of wind power capacity from 1995 to 2011. In 1995, the capacity stood at just 6.1 gigawatts, marking a relatively low starting point. It then showed steady growth: reaching 39 gigawatts by 2003, doubling to 94 gigawatts in 2007, and rising further to 159 gigawatts in 2009. By the end of the period in 2011, the capacity had surged to 238 gigawatts, reﬂecting a dramatic and consistent upward trend in wind power adoption globally.
answer_zh: 该折线图描绘了1995年至2011年风电装机容量的增长情况。1995年，风电装机容量仅为6.1吉瓦，起点较低。随后呈现出稳定增长的趋势：到 2003 年达到 39 吉瓦，2007 年翻一番，达到 94 吉瓦，2009 年进一步上升到 159 吉瓦。到 2011 年末，装机容量已飙升至 238 吉瓦，反映出全球风电采用量持续大幅上升的趋势。

answer: This picture shows the process of plastic recycling. First, people put diﬀerent kinds of plastic waste, such as bottles, cans, and containers, into recycling bins. Then, the collected plastics are transported and shredded into smaller pieces. After that, the pieces are washed carefully to remove dirt and labels. Next, they are melted at a high temperature and go through extrusion. Finally, the melted plastic is pelletized into small granules, which can be reused for making new plastic products. This cycle helps reduce pollution and saves resources.
answer_zh: 这张图显示了塑料回收的过程。首先，人们将不同种类的塑料垃圾，如瓶子、罐头和容器放入回收箱中。然后，收集的塑料被运输并撕成更小的碎片。之后，仔细清洗碎片以去除污垢和标签。接下来，它们在高温下熔化并经过挤压。最后，熔化的塑料被造粒成小颗粒，可以重新用于制造新的塑料制品。这个循环有助于减少污染并节省资源。

answer: This table compares inbound visitors to Australia from four major countries in 2005 and 2006. New Zealand had the highest number of visitors, though it decreased slightly from 1099 to
answer_zh: 该表比较了 2005 年和 2006 年来自四个主要国家的入境游客数量。新西兰的游客人数最多，但从 1,099 人略有下降到

title_en: Japan and the United States both saw modest increases, reaching 586 and 720
extra_text: thousand respectively. Conversely, Germany experienced a decline from 430 to 410
thousand. Overall, visitor numbers remained relatively stable with minor ﬂuctuations across these key markets.

answer: This graph illustrates the evolution of real house prices in New Zealand, using an index where 1990 is set at 100. According to the OECD Economic Survey of New Zealand 2015, house prices have risen markedly over the years. The index reached 200, indicating that prices doubled compared to the 1990 baseline. This demonstrates a signiﬁcant and sustained increase in housing costs, reﬂecting strong market growth and potential economic trends in the country during this period.
answer_zh: 该图显示了新西兰实际房价的演变，使用的指数将 1990 年定为 100。根据 OECD 2015 年新西兰经济调查，房价多年来显着上涨。该指数达到 200，表明价格与 1990 年基准相比翻了一番。这表明住房成本显着且持续增加，反映了这一时期该国强劲的市场增长和潜在的经济趋势。

title_en: The ratio of male and female volunteers changes
answer: The line chart shows the ratio of male and female volunteers changes over the years. The ratio of male volunteers is represented by a blue line while the ratio of female’s is represented in a pink line. Firstly, the largest number of male can be found in the year of 2003, in which the ratio is around 40%. At the same time, the ratio of female reaches its highest point as well, which is around 25% and much lower than male. The smallest number of male can be found at the beginning point of 1990, while the smallest number of female can be found in 1995 and 2006, in which the ratio is 20%. Over all, the trend of the ratio of male and female volunteers both ﬂuctuate unsteadily and are similar to each other.
answer_zh: 折线图显示了多年来男性和女性志愿者的比例变化。男性志愿者的比例用蓝线表示，而女性志愿者的比例用粉色线表示。首先，2003年男性人数最多，比例约为40%。与此同时，女性的比例也达到最高点，约为25%，远低于男性。男性人数最少出现在1990年初，女性人数最少出现在1995年和2006年，比例为20%。总体来看，男性和女性志愿者的比例变化趋势均不稳定，但具有相似性。

title_en: Beginning of ﬂow chart for quiz
answer: This image displays a ﬂowchart illustrating the structure of an interactive quiz. It begins with an initial slide prompting the user to start. The ﬁrst question then appears, oﬀering two choices: selecting "False " leads to a correct response notiﬁcation, while choosing "True " results in an incorrect feedback message. Both outcomes direct the user to proceed to the next question, demonstrating a linear and user-friendly assessment design with immediate answer validation.
answer_zh: 此图显示了一个流程图，说明了交互式测验的结构。它以提示用户开始的初始幻灯片开始。然后出现第一个问题，提供两种选择：选择“False”会导致正确的响应通知，而选择“True”则会导致错误的反馈消息。这两种结果都会引导用户继续下一个问题，展示线性且用户友好的评估设计，并立即验证答案。

answer: This graph displays recent global monthly average Carbon Dioxide levels measured in parts per million (ppm) from 2004 to 2006. The data shows a consistent upward trend in atmospheric Carbon Dioxide concentrations across these years, indicating a gradual increase in greenhouse gas levels during this period.
answer_zh: 该图显示了 2004 年至 2006 年以百万分之一 (ppm) 为单位测量的近期全球月平均二氧化碳水平。数据显示这些年来大气二氧化碳浓度呈持续上升趋势，表明在此期间温室气体水平逐渐增加。

answer: The pie chart gives information about the time arrangements of individuals who were enrolled at a university or college. First of all, we can see sleeping takes the largest part of their time, which possesses 8.3 hours. Followed by leisure and sports, educational activities as well as working and related activities, which possess 3 hours per day in average. What’s more, grooming, traveling and eating take the smallest part of their time, which is averagely an hour per day. In addition, other activities still take 2.3hours of their day and are not illustrated precisely in the pie chart. In conclusion, the time arrangement of a university student is well organized.
answer_zh: 饼图提供了有关在大学或学院就读的个人的时间安排的信息。首先，我们可以看到睡眠占据了他们最大的时间，占了8.3个小时。其次是休闲体育、教育活动以及工作及相关活动，平均每天3小时。更重要的是，梳洗、旅行和吃饭只占用了他们最少的时间，平均每天只有一个小时。此外，其他活动仍然需要每天 2.3 小时，并且没有在饼图中精确说明。综上所述，大学生的时间安排是有条理的。

answer: The picture shows information about how to choose best food for brain health. Firstly, on the left of the picture, we can see unhealthy foods represented in red colour such as potato chips, fried chicken, donuts, ice cream and wine. Obviously, gaining too much junk food can bring negative impacts to our brain. On the right of the picture, on the contrary, there are healthy foods represented in green which can boost our brainpower. To be speciﬁc, appropriate intake of fruits and vegetables such as carrots, bananas and broccoli can strengthen your ﬁtness and moreover make your brain works better. In conclusion, if we can change our bad habits of taking too much junk food and try to eat more organic fruits and vegetables, we will ultimately get stronger and keep our brain active.
answer_zh: 图片显示了如何选择最有利于大脑健康的食物的信息。首先，在图片的左侧，我们可以看到以红色表示的不健康食品，如薯片、炸鸡、甜甜圈、冰淇淋和酒。显然，摄入过多的垃圾食品会给我们的大脑带来负面影响。相反，在图片的右侧，有绿色代表的健康食品，可以增强我们的脑力。具体来说，适当摄入胡萝卜、香蕉、西兰花等水果和蔬菜，可以强身健体，还能让大脑更好地运转。总之，如果我们能改变吃太多垃圾食品的坏习惯，尝试多吃有机水果和蔬菜，我们最终会变得更强壮，保持大脑活跃。

answer: The table compares the primary funding sources for international students in the U.S. between 2003/04 and 2013/14. Overall, the total number of students increased by 55%, from about 572,000 to over 886,000. Personal and family support remained the main funding source, although its proportion slightly dropped from 67% to 65%. Funding from U.S. colleges rose by 28%, but its percentage decreased from 23% to 19%. The most signiﬁcant increases came from foreign governments and current employers, growing by 383% and 390% respectively, rising from only 2% each to 7% and 6%. In contrast, funding from other sources declined by 14%. In summary, while most students still rely on personal funding, external support, especially from foreign governments and employers, has grown rapidly.
answer_zh: 该表比较了 2003/2004 年和 2013/2014 年美国国际学生的主要资金来源。总体而言，学生总数增加了 55%，从约 572,000 人增加到超过 886,000 人。个人和家庭支持仍然是主要的资金来源，尽管其比例从67%略有下降至65%。美国大学的资助增加了 28%，但比例从 23% 下降到 19%。增长最为显着的是外国政府和现任雇主，分别增长了 383% 和 390%，从各自的 2% 上升到 7% 和 6%。相比之下，其他来源的资金下降了 14%。总之，虽然大多数学生仍然依赖个人资助，但外部支持，特别是来自外国政府和雇主的支持，已经迅速增长。

title_en: Arrests number for using illegal drugs
title_zh: 因使用非法药物被捕人数
answer: This line graph shows the number of arrests per year for using illegal drugs from 1991 to
answer_zh: 该折线图显示了从 1991 年到 2017 年每年因使用非法毒品而被捕的人数

title_en: The blue line represents the changes over time.From 1991 to 1995, arrests increased steadily, rising from about 10 to 60. Between 1995 and 1997, the number stayed the same, and then dropped sharply in 1999 to around 35. After that, arrests rose again, peaking at 70 in 2000.However, there was a dramatic fall in 2001, with the number dropping below 20. In

answer: This pie chart shows the population of EU countries in 2007 by percentage. Each country is shown in a diﬀerent color. Germany, in red, has the largest share at 16.6%. France is blue with 12.8%, and the UK is yellow with 12.3%. Italy is green at 11.9%, and Spain, in orange- yellow, is 9.0%. Poland, in dark red, is 7.7%. The biggest part is “All other countries (21)”, in light blue, which makes up 29.7%. Overall, the chart shows how the EU population is shared among diﬀerent countries.
answer_zh: 此饼图按百分比显示 2007 年欧盟国家的人口。每个国家都以不同的颜色显示。德国（红色）所占份额最大，为 16.6%。法国为蓝色，占 12.8%，英国为黄色，占 12.3%。意大利为绿色，为 11.9%，西班牙为橙黄色，为 9.0%。深红色的波兰为 7.7%。最大的部分是“所有其他国家（21）”，浅蓝色，占29.7%。总体而言，该图表显示了欧盟人口在不同国家之间的分布情况。

answer: This bar chart shows why some adults don’t visit museums and galleries more often. The bars are dark gray on a white background. The x-axis shows the percentage from 0 to 60, and the y-axis lists diﬀerent reasons. The biggest reason is lack of time, close to 55%. Next is not available locally, around 30%. Other reasons include transport, cost, care duties, and lack of event info, all with lower percentages. The lowest one is lack of information, under 10%. In total, the survey includes 347,000 adults.This graph shows that time is the main problem for people visiting these places.
answer_zh: 这张条形图显示了为什么一些成年人不经常参观博物馆和画廊。条形在白色背景上呈深灰色。 x 轴显示从 0 到 60 的百分比，y 轴列出不同的原因。最大的原因是时间不够，接近55%。 Next 本地不可用，大约 30%。其他原因包括交通、成本、护理职责和缺乏活动信息，所有这些比例都较低。最低的是信息缺乏，不到10%。此次调查总共涉及 347,000 名成年人。该图显示，时间是人们游览这些地方的主要问题。

answer: This line chart shows the number of cell phone users in Anytowne from 1996 to 2002. There are three colored lines: a blue line with diamonds for men, a pink line with squares for women, and a red line with triangles for both sexes. Overall, the number of users increased over time. The red line is always the highest, starting at around 3,000 in 1996 and reaching about 3,700 in 2002. Both the blue and pink lines start at around 1,500. The pink line is slightly higher than the blue line in most years. By 2002, both lines reach around 1,800 to 2,000. The graph clearly shows a steady rise in cell phone use among men and women.
answer_zh: 此折线图显示了 1996 年至 2002 年 Anytowne 的手机用户数量。共有三种颜色的线：带有菱形的蓝色线代表男性，带有正方形的粉色线代表女性，带有三角形的红色线代表男女。总体而言，用户数量随着时间的推移而增加。红线始终是最高的，从 1996 年的 3,000 左右开始，到 2002 年达到 3,700 左右。蓝线和粉红线都从 1,500 左右开始。大多数年份粉红线略高于蓝线。到 2002 年，两条线路均达到 1,800 至 2,000 辆左右。该图清楚地显示男性和女性的手机使用率稳步上升。

answer: This bar chart shows the weekly household spending in Australia. According to the graph, the highest spending is on current housing costs, which is close to 300 dollars. Food and non-alcoholic drinks come next, with about 250 dollars, followed by transport, around 200 dollars. Other categories like recreation, miscellaneous goods, and health expenses are lower. The smallest amount of spending goes to tobacco products. In summary, the chart shows how Australian households spend money in diﬀerent areas each week.
answer_zh: 该条形图显示了澳大利亚每周的家庭支出。从图中可以看出，目前的住房费用支出最高，接近300美元。其次是食物和非酒精饮料，大约 250 美元，其次是交通，大约 200 美元。其他类别如娱乐、杂货和医疗费用则较低。烟草产品的支出最少。总之，该图表显示了澳大利亚家庭每周如何在不同领域花钱。

answer: The line chart shows the cellphone and smartphone ownership among U.S. adults from 2005 to 2020. The purple line shows general cellphone use, starting above 60% in 2005 and slowly rising to nearly 100% by 2020. The blue line shows smartphone ownership, which started much lower, but grew quickly after 2010, reaching over 80% in 2020. The note explains that surveys were done by phone before 2023, and by web and mail in 2023. Overall, the chart shows that smartphone use has increased sharply, and most adults now own smartphones.
answer_zh: 该折线图显示了 2005 年至 2020 年美国成年人的手机和智能手机拥有量。紫色线显示了手机的总体使用情况，从 2005 年开始超过 60%，到 2020 年缓慢上升到近 100%。蓝色线显示了智能手机拥有率，开始时要低得多，但在 2010 年之后迅速增长，到 2020 年达到 80% 以上。该说明解释说，调查是在 2020 年之前通过电话完成的。 2023 年通过网络和邮件。总体而言，该图表显示智能手机的使用量急剧增加，大多数成年人现在都拥有智能手机。

answer: This bar chart shows where international companies place their European headquarters. The UK has way more, like over 200, which is much higher than others. Germany, Switzerland, France follow, but their numbers are much lower, around 50. Then Netherlands, Ireland, and the rest have even fewer. So clearly, the UK is the top choice for these European HQs.
answer_zh: 此条形图显示了国际公司的欧洲总部所在地。英国的数量要多得多，大约有 200 多个，比其他国家高得多。德国、瑞士、法国紧随其后，但数量要少得多，约为 50 个。然后是荷兰、爱尔兰，其他国家的数量更少。显然，英国是这些欧洲总部的首选。

answer: The ﬂow chart shows ﬁve steps for preparing food safely. Step 1, in blue, is Clean, where someone washes hands to remove germs. Step 2, in green, is Separate, showing raw meat cut on a board, reminding us to keep raw and cooked food apart. Step 3, in red, is Cook, with a turkey in the oven, meaning food should be cooked thoroughly. Step 4, in teal, is Chill, showing food stored in a fridge to stay fresh. Step 5, in dark pink, is Throw Away, with the message: If in doubt, throw it out. Overall, it highlights key steps to avoid foodborne illness and stay healthy.
answer_zh: 该流程图显示了安全准备食物的五个步骤。第 1 步（蓝色）是“清洁”，即有人洗手以去除细菌。第2步，绿色，是分开的，显示切在板上的生肉，提醒我们将生食和熟食分开。第三步，红色部分是烹饪，将火鸡放在烤箱中，这意味着食物应该彻底煮熟。第 4 步（青色）是“冷藏”，显示储存在冰箱中以保持新鲜的食物。第 5 步是深粉色的“扔掉”，并显示以下信息：如果有疑问，请将其扔掉。总体而言，它强调了避免食源性疾病和保持健康的关键步骤。

answer: The picture shows a colorful fruit section in a grocery store. Peaches in soft pink and yellow, plums in dark purple and red, and bright orange oranges are neatly displayed on the shelves. Price tags like $5.99 and $3.99 are clearly shown in front of the fruits. Above the fruit area, there are clear signs such as “Fresh Produce,” “Organic Fresh,” and “Fresh Seafood,” helping people ﬁnd what they need. The store is well-lit with bright white lights from the ceiling, making the area look clean, fresh, and welcoming. Overall, the image shows a tidy and inviting space with a focus on fresh food.
answer_zh: 图为杂货店内色彩缤纷的水果区。淡粉色和黄色的桃子，深紫色和红色的李子，还有亮橙色的橙子整齐地陈列在货架上。 5.99 美元和 3.99 美元等价格标签清晰地显示在水果前面。水果区上方有“新鲜农产品”、“有机新鲜”、“新鲜海鲜”等明显标志，帮助人们找到自己需要的东西。店内光线充足，天花板上发出明亮的白光，使整个区域看起来干净、清新、温馨。总体而言，该图像显示了一个整洁而温馨的空间，重点是新鲜食品。

answer: This bar chart shows the percentage of UK households with selected consumer durables in 2001/02 and 2007. For Telephone, Microwave, and CD Player, the percentages increased from 2001/02 to 2007. Telephone had the highest growth, reaching nearly 100%. Mobile phone, however, had a lower percentage in 2001/02 but still saw an increase by 2007.Overall, these durables became more common in UK households over this period.
answer_zh: 此条形图显示了 2001/02 和 2007 年英国家庭拥有选定耐用消费品的百分比。对于电话、微波炉和 CD 播放器，百分比从 2001/02 到 2007 年有所增加。电话增长最快，达到近 100%。然而，2001/2002 年移动电话的比例较低，但到 2007 年仍有所增加。总体而言，在此期间，这些耐用品在英国家庭中变得更加普遍。

title_zh: 安大略省的工作旅行时间
answer: The pie chart shows how long people in Ontario spent traveling to work in 2016. The biggest group spent 15 to 29 minutes, at 32.2%, shown in dark teal. About 24% of people traveled less than 15 minutes, in light blue. 30 to 44 minutes, in dark blue, made up 21.3%. 45 to 59 minutes, in red, was 10.1%, and over 1 hour, in pink, was 12.4%. In general, most people had a commute under 30 minutes, and fewer people traveled longer than 45 minutes.
answer_zh: 饼图显示了 2016 年安大略省人们上班所花费的时间。最大的群体花费了 15 到 29 分钟，占 32.2%（以深青色显示）。大约 24% 的人乘坐浅蓝色出行时间不到 15 分钟。 30至44分钟，深蓝色占21.3%。 45 至 59 分钟，红色为 10.1%，超过 1 小时，粉色为 12.4%。一般来说，大多数人的通勤时间在 30 分钟以内，而很少有人的通勤时间超过 45 分钟。

answer: The pie chart illustrates pet ownership by region, using diﬀerent colors to represent each area. The largest segment is North America, shown in light blue, accounting for 40%. answer: This bar chart illustrates the number of U.S. households keeping various types of pets. In total, around 84.9 million households own pets. Dogs are the most popular, owned by 63.4 million households, followed by cats, kept by 42.7 million. Freshwater ﬁsh are owned by 11.5 million households, while birds and reptiles are owned by 5.7 and 4.5 million respectively. Horses and saltwater ﬁsh are the least common, each with 1.6 million. Other types of pets are owned by around 5.4 million households. Overall, dogs and cats dominate pet ownership in the U.S., while exotic animals are much less common.
answer_zh: 该条形图显示了饲养各种宠物的美国家庭数量。总共约有 8490 万个家庭拥有宠物。狗最受欢迎，有 6340 万户家庭饲养，其次是猫，有 4270 万户家庭饲养。 1150 万户家庭拥有淡水鱼，而鸟类和爬行动物分别由 5.7 和 450 万户家庭拥有。马和咸水鱼是最不常见的，各有 160 万条。大约有 540 万个家庭拥有其他类型的宠物。总体而言，狗和猫在美国宠物饲养中占主导地位，而外来动物则不太常见。

answer: This line graph shows the population growth in Canada from 1978/1979 to 2008/2009, broken down into three components: total growth, natural increase, and net international migration. The green line representing total growth ﬂuctuated over the period, peaking around 1988/1989 at approximately 500,000 people. The natural increase, shown in purple, remained relatively stable but showed a slight downward trend over time. In contrast, net international migration, depicted by the black line, varied more signiﬁcantly. It increased sharply around 1988/1989, dropped, and then steadily rose again towards 2008/2009. Overall, the graph highlights that population growth in Canada has been increasingly driven by international migration rather than natural increase.
answer_zh: 该折线图显示了 1978/1979 年至 2008/2009 年加拿大的人口增长，分为三个组成部分：总增长、自然增长和净国际移民。代表总增长的绿线在此期间波动，在 1988/1989 年左右达到峰值，约为 500,000 人。自然增长（以紫色显示）保持相对稳定，但随着时间的推移呈现轻微下降趋势。相比之下，黑线所示的净国际移民变化更为显着。它在 1988/1989 年左右急剧增加，然后下降，然后在 2008/2009 年再次稳定上升。总体而言，该图凸显了加拿大的人口增长越来越多地受到国际移民而非自然增长的推动。

answer: The image illustrates the global ocean circulation system, showing the movement of warm shallow currents and cold and salty deep currents across the world 's oceans. The warm shallow current, caused by solar heating of ocean waters, ﬂows from the Paciﬁc Ocean through the Indian and Atlantic Oceans. It releases heat into the atmosphere, as shown by the "Sea-to-Air Heat Transfer " label. The current then sinks in the North Atlantic, becoming a cold and salty deep current that circulates back to the Paciﬁc. This continuous loop helps regulate Earth’s climate and distribute heat around the globe.
answer_zh: 该图像展示了全球海洋环流系统，显示了全球海洋中暖浅流和冷咸深流的运动。由海水的太阳加热引起的温暖浅流从太平洋流经印度洋和大西洋。它将热量释放到大气中，如“海空传热”标签所示。然后洋流在北大西洋下沉，成为寒冷且含盐分的深海洋流，循环回到太平洋。这种连续的循环有助于调节地球的气候并在全球范围内分配热量。

title_en: Sunrise and Sunset Times for Detroit
title_zh: 底特律的日出日落时间表
answer: This image presents a graph of sunrise and sunset times throughout 2016 for Detroit, MI, plotted against the day of the year. Firstly, we can see that the sunrise times start late at 7am and gradually become earlier, reaching their earliest point, which is approximately 5 am around the middle of the year before becoming later again. Conversely, the sunset times follow an opposite trend , starting early at 4 pm and becoming later, and then shifting earlier. This creates a signiﬁcant change in the length of day. In conclusion, the graph shows that the longest days, with the most daylight hours, occur during the summer months. In contrast, the shortest days, with the least sunlight, are found in the winter.
answer_zh: 此图像显示了密歇根州底特律 2016 年全年日出和日落时间的图表，根据一年中的日期绘制。首先，我们可以看到日出时间从早上 7 点开始较晚，然后逐渐变早，到达最早点，大约在年中的早上 5 点左右，然后又变得更晚。相反，日落时间则遵循相反的趋势，从下午 4 点开始较早，然后变得较晚，然后又提前。这会导致一天的长度发生显着变化。总之，该图显示最长的白天和最多的日照时间发生在夏季。相比之下，冬季白天最短，阳光最少。

In terms of women in the labor force, the ﬁgure increased from just under 20 percent to about 75 percent during the period. In conclusion, this graph shows important information about women in the labor force.
answer_zh: 折线图显示了 1900 年至 2010 年未婚女性和劳动力中的女性。数据显示，就未婚女性而言，这一数字从 1900 年的 25% 下降到 1960 年的 17% 左右，然后在 2010 年增加到 43%。就劳动力中的女性而言，这一数字在此期间从略低于 20% 上升到约 75%。总之，该图显示了劳动力中女性的重要信息。

answer: This graph represents information about a survey on transport modes used by respondents. According to the graph, we can see that 100 respondents participated in this survey. According to the data, 60 respondents chose to travel by train, while 30 respondents preferred to travel by car over train. Apart from that, we found that 10 respondents choose both. In conclusion, this graph provides important information about travel mode choice.
answer_zh: 该图表示有关受访者使用的交通方式调查的信息。从图表中我们可以看到，有 100 名受访者参与了本次调查。数据显示，60名受访者选择乘坐火车出行，30名受访者更喜欢自驾出行而不是火车出行。除此之外，我们发现有 10 名受访者选择两者。总之，该图提供了有关出行方式选择的重要信息。

answer: The picture shows information about soot emissions in one of the cities in Asia. According to the picture, we can see the city suﬀers from high levels of smog that reduces visibility. At the bottom of the picture, we can see three women riding bicycles on the street. In the background, we can see pedestrians crossing the road. At the top of the picture, we can see a gray sky. To sum up, the government should think of ways to reduce soot emissions.
answer_zh: 图为亚洲某城市油烟排放信息。从图片中我们可以看到，该市雾霾严重，能见度降低。在图片的底部，我们可以看到三个女人在街上骑自行车。在背景中，我们可以看到行人过马路。在图片的顶部，我们可以看到灰色的天空。综上所述，政府应该想办法减少烟尘排放。

answer: This bar chart presents information about ﬂu vaccination rates for the over-65 age group in 2018. According to the data, South Korea had the highest ﬂu vaccination rate for people aged over 65, which was about 85 percent. This is closely followed by the UK, which was 72 percent, while the lowest ﬂu vaccination rate goes to Turkey, which was only 7 percent. Apart from that, we can see, the ﬂu vaccination rate for people over 65 years old in the USA is much higher than that of Germany. To conclude, this graph provides important information about ﬂu vaccination in diﬀerent countries.
answer_zh: 这张条形图展示了2018年65岁以上人群的流感疫苗接种率信息。数据显示，韩国65岁以上人群的流感疫苗接种率最高，约为85%。紧随其后的是英国，为 72%，而流感疫苗接种率最低的是土耳其，仅为 7%。除此之外，我们还可以看到，美国65岁以上人群的流感疫苗接种率远高于德国。总之，该图提供了有关不同国家流感疫苗接种的重要信息。

answer: This bar chart shows information about the popularity of cultural websites in Scotland in
answer_zh: 此条形图显示了有关苏格兰文化网站受欢迎程度的信息

title_en: As we can see from the graph, the largest proportion comes from none of these, at 55 percent of adults. The second largest proportion comes from concert websites, at 31 percent of adults. However, the smallest proportion goes to archive or records websites, which is
extra_text: only 8 percent of adults. To sum up, records websites are the least popular website in Scotland.

answer: The bar chart is about Australian domestic airline passengers, growth over year to June quarter 2011. As we can see from the graph, the largest proportion comes from mining exposed in pink color, at about 8 percent . It is followed by Inter-capital, which is about 2 percent. It can also be noticed that the smallest proportion goes to leisure in purple color, which is about - 4 percent. In conclusion, this graph provides important information about Australian domestic airline passengers.
answer_zh: 该条形图显示了截至 2011 年 6 月季度澳大利亚国内航空旅客的同比增长情况。从图中我们可以看到，最大的比例来自粉红色的采矿业，约为 8%。其次是 Inter-capital，约占 2%。还可以注意到，紫色休闲装所占比例最小，约为 4%。总之，该图提供了有关澳大利亚国内航空公司乘客的重要信息。

answer: This line graph displays annual working hours in Germany between 1970 and 2017. According to the data, in Germany, the largest number comes from 1970, at 1973 working hours per year. It is followed by 1975, at 1812 hours per year. However, the smallest ﬁgure goes to 2017, which is about 1350 hours per year. It can also be noticed that in Germany, the annual working hours decreased over the time period. In conclusion, the annual working hours will continue to decrease in the future.
answer_zh: 这张折线图显示了1970年至2017年间德国每年的工作时间。数据显示，在德国，最多的数字来自1970年，每年有1973个工作时间。接下来是 1975 年，每年 1812 小时。然而，最小的数字是 2017 年，每年约为 1350 小时。还可以注意到，在德国，年工作时间随着时间的推移而减少。综上所述，未来每年的工作时间将会继续减少。

answer: This bar chart represents information about the world’s biggest chocolate consumers. According to the data, Switzerland consumes the most chocolate, with 19.8 pounds per capita each year. After that we can see, Germany consumes the second-highest amount of chocolate in the world, with 17.4 lbs each year. However, France is the ninth-largest consumer of chocolate, with 9.3 lbs each year. It is interesting to note that both Ireland and the United Kingdom have the same amount of chocolate consumption each year, ranked as the third-largest in the world. In conclusion, this graph provides important information about the world’s biggest chocolate consumers.
answer_zh: 该条形图代表了世界上最大的巧克力消费者的信息。数据显示，瑞士巧克力消费量最多，每年人均19.8磅。之后我们可以看到，德国的巧克力消费量位居世界第二，每年 17.4 磅。然而，法国是第九大巧克力消费国，每年消费 9.3 磅。有趣的是，爱尔兰和英国每年的巧克力消费量相同，均位居世界第三。总之，该图提供了有关世界上最大的巧克力消费者的重要信息。

answer: The bar chart represents information about the frequency of dining at fast-food restaurants among Americans in 2003, 2006, and 2013. According to the data, in July 2003, 31 percent of people in America ate fast food about once a week. In contrast, only 4 percent of Americans dine at fast-food restaurants every day. In July 2013, 33 percent of Americans ate fast food once or twice a month. Apart from that, we can see 4 percent of people in America never ate fast food in both 2006 and 2013. To sum up, most Americans dine at fast-food restaurants about once a week.
answer_zh: 该条形图代表了 2003 年、2006 年和 2013 年美国人在快餐店就餐频率的信息。数据显示，2003 年 7 月，31% 的美国人大约每周吃一次快餐。相比之下，只有 4% 的美国人每天在快餐店用餐。 2013 年 7 月，33% 的美国人每月吃一到两次快餐。除此之外，我们可以看到2006年和2013年都有4%的美国人从未吃过快餐。综上所述，大多数美国人大约每周在快餐店用餐一次。

answer: This map shows information about the location of the Bermuda Triangle. According to the graph, we can see Bermuda Triangle is a triangular area on the western part of the North Atlantic Ocean. The triangular area is bounded by Florida, Bermuda, and Puerto Rico. We can also see the Gulf of Mexico, Caribbean Sea, and Tropic of Cancer from the map. In conclusion, the graph provides important information about Bermuda Triangle.
answer_zh: 这张地图显示了有关百慕大三角位置的信息。从图中我们可以看出，百慕大三角是北大西洋西部的一个三角形区域。该三角形区域以佛罗里达州、百慕大群岛和波多黎各为界。我们还可以从地图上看到墨西哥湾、加勒比海和北回归线。总之，该图提供了有关百慕大三角的重要信息。

answer: The following graph shows information about GNH. According to this picture, we can see some circles. From this picture, we can see the psychological well-being, health and time use. They are around the circle of GNH. From this picture, we can see education, cultural diversity, resilience, and good governance. They are also very important to GNH. According to this picture, we can also see community vitality, ecological diversity and resilience, and living standards. They are around the circle, which is very important to GNH. According to this picture, we can see the GNH circle is the largest area. In conclusion, we can see many diﬀerent colors, and they are informative.
answer_zh: 下图显示了有关 GNH 的信息。根据这张图，我们可以看到一些圆圈。从这张图中，我们可以看到心理幸福感、健康状况和时间利用情况。它们围绕着国民幸福总值（GNH）的圆圈。从这张图中，我们可以看到教育、文化多样性、韧性和良好的治理。它们对于国民幸福指数也非常重要。根据这张图，我们还可以看到社区活力、生态多样性和复原力以及生活水平。它们围绕着圆圈，这对 GNH 非常重要。根据这张图，我们可以看到GNH圆是最大的面积。总之，我们可以看到许多不同的颜色，并且它们提供了丰富的信息。

answer: Japan and Singapore have the world 's most powerful passports, according to the table.
answer_zh: 根据该表，日本和新加坡拥有世界上最强大的护照。

answer: The bar chart represents information about countries with the biggest average and median wealth per capita in 2020. According to the data, in terms of average wealth, Switzerland had the highest average wealth per capita, which is about 673,000 dollars. This is followed by the United States, which is about 500,000 dollars. In contrast, the Netherlands has the lowest average wealth per capita, which is around 377,000 dollars. In terms of median wealth, Australia has the biggest median wealth per capita in the world, which is about 238,000 dollars. In conclusion, Switzerland was the wealthiest country in the world.
answer_zh: 条形图代表了2020年人均财富中位数最高的国家的信息。数据显示，就平均财富而言，瑞士的人均财富最高，约为67.3万美元。其次是美国，约为50万美元。相比之下，荷兰的人均财富最低，约为 377,000 美元。就财富中位数而言，澳大利亚的人均财富中位数是世界上最高的，约为238,000美元。总之，瑞士是世界上最富有的国家。

answer: This bar chart presents information about the percentage of population in diﬀerent age groups. According to the data, in terms of females, the largest proportion can be found in between the age of 25 and 34, which is 16.5 percent, while the smallest proportion can be found in aged 85 or over, which is only 1.1 percent. In terms of males, the largest proportion can also be found in aged 25 to 34, which is 16.2 percent. The smallest lowest proportion can be found in over the age of 85, which is only 0.7 percent. In conclusion, this graph is about age distribution.
answer_zh: 此条形图显示有关不同年龄组的人口百分比的信息。数据显示，就女性而言，25岁至34岁之间的比例最大，为16.5%，而85岁以上的比例最小，仅为1.1%。从男性来看，25岁至34岁年龄段所占比例最大，为16.2%。比例最低的是85岁以上的老年人，仅为0.7%。总之，这张图是关于年龄分布的。

answer: This graph shows information about weekly household spending from 2015 to 2016 in Ireland. As we can see from the graph, transport is the highest household spending in Ireland, with 124 euro per week. Food is the second largest weekly household expenditure category, with 123 euro. Apart from that we can see, holiday is the fourth largest household spending item after medical, which is around 30 dollars per week. In conclusion, households in Ireland spend the most money on transport and food.
answer_zh: 该图显示了 2015 年至 2016 年爱尔兰每周家庭支出的信息。从图中我们可以看出，交通是爱尔兰家庭支出最高的支出，每周 124 欧元。食品是家庭每周第二大支出类别，为 123 欧元。除此之外，我们还可以看到，假期是仅次于医疗的第四大家庭支出项目，每周约为30美元。总之，爱尔兰家庭在交通和食品上花费最多的钱。

answer: This map shows information about the location of European countries. It can be seen from the graph that Germany, Switzerland, Austria and Hungary can be found in central Europe, while a number of countries in northern Europe that include Denmark, Norway, Sweden, and Finland. Apart from that we can see, Italy, Spain and Portugal are located in the southern part of Europe, while several countries in southeast Europe that include Romania, Bulgaria, and Greece. To sum up, this graph provides information about regions of Europe.
answer_zh: 该地图显示有关欧洲国家位置的信息。从图中可以看出，德国、瑞士、奥地利和匈牙利位于中欧，北欧也有一些国家，包括丹麦、挪威、瑞典和芬兰。除此之外我们还可以看到，意大利、西班牙和葡萄牙位于欧洲南部，而东南欧的几个国家包括罗马尼亚、保加利亚和希腊。总而言之，该图提供了有关欧洲地区的信息。

answer: This graph shows the link between education levels, unemployment rates, and weekly earnings in 2007. Higher education leads to lower unemployment, with doctoral degrees at 1.4% and associate degrees at 3.0%. Earnings also rise with education—doctoral degree holders earned $1,497 weekly, while associate degree holders made $740. In conclusion, more education means better job security and higher income.
answer_zh: 该图显示了 2007 年教育水平、失业率和周收入之间的联系。高等教育导致失业率降低，博士学位为 1.4%，副学士学位为 3.0%。收入也随着教育程度的增加而增加——博士学位持有者每周收入 1,497 美元，而副学士学位持有者每周收入 740 美元。总之，更多的教育意味着更好的工作保障和更高的收入。

answer: The picture shows the process of bottle recycles. The bottle was ﬁrstly used by the manufacturer for packing. After it is consumed by the customer, the plastic bottle will be squeezed down to lower the cost of delivery to the recycle station. Thanks to the modern tech of waste recycle, plastic waste turns into a brand new bottle again.
answer_zh: 图为瓶子回收过程。该瓶子首先被制造商用于包装。顾客消费完后，塑料瓶会被挤压，以降低运送到回收站的成本。得益于现代废物回收技术，塑料废物再次变成了全新的瓶子。

answer: The picture shows the tomato processing cycle. Firstly, the tomatoes are picked up from farm and delivered to the processing line, in which, the tomatoes will be separated by their quality. Then the good tomatoes will be packed up and sent to the retail shops. In conclusion, the process of selling tomato is divided in to ﬁve steps.
answer_zh: 图为番茄加工周期。首先，西红柿从农场采摘并运送到加工线，在加工线上，西红柿将根据质量进行分离。然后，好的西红柿将被包装并发送到零售店。总之，销售番茄的过程分为五个步骤。

answer: This graph gives information about a ﬂoor plan of an oﬃce. As we can see from the picture, on the left-hand side, there is an oﬃce with a small kitchen. While on the right-hand side, we can see there are male toilet, female toilet and toilet for people who are handicapped. Besides, when we look at the top of the picture, there is a main hall. To sum up, this graph shows a simple oﬃce ﬂoor plan layout.
answer_zh: 该图提供了有关办公室平面图的信息。从图中我们可以看到，左边是一间办公室，还有一个小厨房。而在右手边，我们可以看到有男厕所、女厕所和残疾人厕所。此外，当我们看图片的顶部时，还有一个大殿。总而言之，该图显示了一个简单的办公室平面图布局。

answer: This pie chart shows information about the diﬀerent types of recycling. According to the picture, the largest number can be found in thermal recycling, which accounts for 5.02 million tons. It is followed by material recycling, which is 2.04 million tons. While the smallest ﬁgure comes from chemical recycling, which is 0.38 million tons. Apart from that we can see thermal recycling is represented in blue color and chemical recycling is represented in grey color. To sum up, there are three main types of recycling.
answer_zh: 该饼图显示了有关不同类型回收的信息。从图中可以看出，数量最多的是热回收，达到了502万吨。其次是材料回收量，为204万吨。而最小的数字来自化学回收，为 38 万吨。除此之外，我们可以看到热回收用蓝色表示，化学回收用灰色表示。概括起来，回收主要分为三种类型。

answer: This graph shows information about London’s expected energy target in 2030. As we can see from the picture, the largest proportion comes from heating and cooling, which is 51%, and the renewable energy is 10%. The second largest proportion is transport, which is 32%. While the smallest proportion can be found in power, which is 17%. Apart from that we can see the renewable energy is 26%, and it shows an increasing trend. In conclusion, this graph gives informative information about expected energy target in London in 2030.
answer_zh: 这张图显示了伦敦2030年预期能源目标的信息。从图中我们可以看到，最大的比例来自于供暖和制冷，为51%，可再生能源为10%。第二大比例是交通运输，为32%。而占比最小的是权力，为17%。除此之外我们可以看到可再生能源是26%，并且呈现出增长的趋势。总之，该图提供了有关伦敦 2030 年预期能源目标的信息。

answer: This graph provides information about ship lock operation. According to a picture, in the ﬁrst stage, we can see a boat going downstream and upstream gate opens. After that, we can see the ship enters the lock, upstream gate closes and water level evens. In the ﬁnal step, downstream gates are opened and the ship exits the gate. In conclusion, the graph gives information about the principle of ship lock operation.
answer_zh: 该图提供有关船闸操作的信息。从图片上看，第一阶段，我们可以看到一艘船向下游行驶，上游的闸门打开。之后，我们可以看到船舶进入船闸，上游闸门关闭，水位趋平。最后一步，下游闸门打开，船舶驶出闸门。总之，该图提供了有关船闸操作原理的信息。

answer: This bar chart shows information about the favorite type of movie. According to the graph, the largest ﬁgure is romance, which is 6. It is closely followed by action, which is 5. However, the lowest number can be found in drama, which is only 1. Apart from that we can see sci-ﬁ and comedy. In conclusion, romance is the most popular movie type.
answer_zh: 此条形图显示有关最喜欢的电影类型的信息。从图中可以看出，数量最多的是爱情片，为6。其次是动作片，为5。而数量最少的是戏剧，只有1。除此之外，我们还可以看到科幻和喜剧。总之，爱情片是最受欢迎的电影类型。

answer: This pie chart gives information about the approximate composition of the air. As we can see from the graph, the largest proportion comes from nitrogen, which is 79%. It is followed by oxygen, which is 20 %. While the smallest proportion can be found in other gases, which is only 1%. Apart from that, it should be noted that other gases include carbon dioxide and small properties of other gases include argon and water vapour. In conclusion, the air in the atmosphere is mainly composed of nitrogen and oxygen.
answer_zh: 该饼图提供了有关空气大致成分的信息。从图中我们可以看到，最大的比例来自于氮，为79%。其次是氧气，为 20%。而其他气体所占比例最小，仅为1%。除此之外，应该注意的是，其他气体包括二氧化碳，其他气体的小性质包括氩气和水蒸气。总之，大气中的空气主要由氮气和氧气组成。

answer: This graph presents information about minimum ice thickness guidelines for new clear ice only. According to the Department of Natural Resources, for ice ﬁshing or other activities on foot, a minimum of 4 inches is needed. For snowmobile, 5-7 inches is needed, while for normal vehicles, 8-12 inches is recommended. Lastly, for driving a medium truck, 12-15 inches of solid ice is required. Overall, ice is never 100 % safe.
answer_zh: 该图仅提供有关新透明冰的最小冰厚度指南的信息。根据自然资源部的说法，冰钓或其他步行活动至少需要 4 英寸的距离。对于雪地摩托，需要5-7英寸，对于普通车辆，建议8-12英寸。最后，驾驶中型卡车需要 12-15 英寸的固体冰。总的来说，冰永远不是 100% 安全的。

answer: This picture provides information about what you can and cannot do in historic gardens. From the picture, we can see that people are only permitted to walk their dogs in the historic garden. However, cycling and drinking alcohol are not allowed in the garden. Apart from that, playing football in historic gardens is prohibited as well. In conclusion, the public need to respect historic gardens.
answer_zh: 这张图片提供了有关在历史花园中可以做什么和不能做什么的信息。从图片中我们可以看到，人们只允许在历史悠久的花园里遛狗。但花园内禁止骑自行车和饮酒。除此之外，在历史花园里踢足球也是被禁止的。总之，公众需要尊重历史园林。

answer: The bar chart shows Internet users who accessed via a mobile phone in 2011. From the graph, we can see that the largest proportion can be found in the 16-24 age group, which is 71 %. The second largest proportion can be found in those aged between 25 and 34, which is 65%. While the smallest proportion can be found in those aged over 65, which is only 9%. Overall, young people prefer to access the internet via their smartphones.
answer_zh: 条形图显示了2011年通过手机上网的网民。从图中我们可以看到，16-24岁年龄段的比例最大，为71%。第二大比例是25岁至34岁之间的人，为65%。而65岁以上的人所占比例最小，仅为9%。总体而言，年轻人更喜欢通过智能手机访问互联网。

answer: The diagram provides the information about steps to make instant coﬀee.The ﬁrst step is to put instant coﬀee to a cup. The second stage is to ﬁll with hot water to a desired level. In the next step, stir with the spoon to dissolve the coﬀee. Finally, we can enjoy instant coﬀee. Overall, making instant coﬀee is quite simple.
answer_zh: 该图提供了有关制作速溶咖啡的步骤的信息。第一步是将速溶咖啡放入杯子中。第二阶段是注入热水至所需水位。在下一步中，用勺子搅拌以溶解咖啡。终于，我们可以享用速溶咖啡了。总的来说，制作速溶咖啡非常简单。

answer: This picture illustrates the composition of e-waste. The largest segment, at 30%, consists of various other electric waste. Household appliances including refrigerators account for 20%, while entertainment devices like DVD players make up 15%. The smallest category, at 10%, includes various other electronic waste. The chart eﬀectively breaks down the major sources of e-waste in our environment.
answer_zh: 这张图说明了电子垃圾的成分。最大的部分（占 30%）由各种其他电子废物组成。冰箱等家用电器占20%，DVD播放机等娱乐设备占15%。最小的类别（占 10%）包括各种其他电子废物。该图表有效地分解了我们环境中电子废物的主要来源。

answer: The picture is about the percentage of students from disadvantaged backgrounds entering university in England. Apparently, the light green line, which represents graduation ﬁgures, starts at around 11 percent in 2006 and ends at almost 20 percent in 2014. The whole trend demonstrates a 60 percent increase within 8 years and the percentage increases steadily on average. In conclusion, there are increasingly more students with disadvantaged backgrounds receiving higher education.
answer_zh: 这张图显示的是来自弱势背景的学生进入英国大学的比例。显然，代表毕业数字的浅绿线从 2006 年的 11% 左右开始，到 2014 年接近 20% 结束。整个趋势表明，8 年内增长了 60%，并且平均百分比稳步增长。总之，越来越多的弱势群体学生接受高等教育。

answer: This picture talks about 9 steps of hand washing. The ﬁrst step is to wet the hands. The second step is to take an adequate amount of liquid soap. The third step is to rub hands to lather and then the fourth step is to rub the back of each hand with the opposite palm. In the ﬁfth step, people need to rub palms with ﬁngers interlaced. The sixth step is to rub each thumb clasped in the opposite palm. Then the seventh step is to rub ﬁngertips in the opposite palm. The eighth step is to scrub the wrists. Finally the last step is to rinse well with running water. In conclusion, washing hands properly with the 9 steps is important amid the pandemic.
answer_zh: 这张图讲的是洗手的9个步骤。第一步是弄湿双手。第二步是取适量的皂液。第三步是揉搓双手起泡沫，第四步是用另一只手掌揉搓每只手的手背。第五步，双手十指交叉搓揉。第六步是摩擦另一只手掌中紧握的拇指。然后第七步，用指尖摩擦另一只手掌。第八步，擦洗手腕。最后最后一步是用流水冲洗干净。总之，在疫情期间，按照九步正确洗手很重要。

answer: This picture is about population density in the world. The largest population density is marked as black, 700 people per square kilometers, which can be found in North India and northeast of China. The medium population density is marked as red, 350 people per square kilometers, which is scattered across all continents. On the contrary, the smallest density is marked as orange, which is largely found in North and South Poles, Australia and Russia. In conclusion, Oceania has the lowest population density among all continents.
answer_zh: 这张图是关于世界人口密度的。人口密度最大的标记为黑人，每平方公里700人，分布在印度北部和中国东北地区。中等人口密度标记为红色，每平方公里350人，分布在各大洲。相反，密度最小的标记为橙色，主要分布在南北两极、澳大利亚和俄罗斯。总之，大洋洲是所有大陆中人口密度最低的。

answer: This picture shows a cafe scenario. In the forefront, it looks like the man in blue is placing orders and the waitress in black apron is taking the order with a tablet. In the background, there are also some customers queuing and waiting. There are also some seats next to the window with sunshine shining through. In conclusion, this picture shows the relaxed and joyful vibes in the cafe.
answer_zh: 这张图展示了一个咖啡馆的场景。最前面，蓝衣男子正在下单，黑围裙的女服务员正在用平板电脑点餐。后台，也有一些顾客在排队等待。还有一些靠窗的座位，阳光照进来。总而言之，这张照片展现了咖啡馆里轻松愉快的氛围。

answer: The picture shows information about a food market. According to the picture, the marketplace is an indoor market and is a very busy place. The market is crowded with green stalls selling a wide range of fresh food including fruits, vegetables and other goods. Except for stalls, there are lots of stores in the market as well. Also, we can see that some shoppers are bargaining with stallholders, while others are just casually browsing the stalls. In conclusion, this market is a great place for people to buy fresh food.
answer_zh: 图为某菜市场信息。从图片上看，市场是一个室内市场，非常热闹。市场上挤满了绿色摊位，出售各种新鲜食品，包括水果、蔬菜和其他商品。市场里除了摊位之外，还有很多商店。此外，我们还可以看到，有些购物者正在与摊主讨价还价，而另一些则只是随意浏览摊位。总之，这个市场是人们购买生鲜食品的好地方。

answer: The diagram shows information about how instant coﬀee is made. As we can see from the graph, at the ﬁrst stage, green coﬀee beans are sent to a factory, after which the beans are roasted to bring out ﬂavor and aroma. In the next step, soluble coﬀee ingredients need to be extracted. Then, the next stage is to cool down coﬀee extracts to a very low temperature. After that, it goes to the concentration process and then drying process. The ﬁnal phase of the process is about instant coﬀee which is ready to be packaged. To sum up, the production of instant coﬀee is quite complicated.
answer_zh: 该图显示了有关如何制作速溶咖啡的信息。从图中我们可以看出，在第一阶段，咖啡生豆被送往工厂，然后对咖啡豆进行烘焙，以释放出风味和香气。在下一步中，需要提取可溶性咖啡成分。然后，下一阶段是将咖啡提取物冷却至非常低的温度。之后进入浓缩过程，然后进行干燥过程。该过程的最后阶段是准备包装的速溶咖啡。综上所述，速溶咖啡的生产相当复杂。

answer: This picture is about music revenues that is adjusted for inﬂation in dollars in 2017. For the physical area in dark blue, the largest ﬁgure is 20 billion dollars in 1999. Another ﬁgure that has been outlined is the 16 billion dollars in 2004. However, the digital area in green looks relatively weaker, with its highest point at around 6 billion dollars in 2017. In conclusion, from 1997 to 2017, physical revenue dominates the whole music revenues.
answer_zh: 这张图是2017年根据通货膨胀调整后的音乐收入。对于深蓝色的物理区域，最大的数字是1999年的200亿美元。另一个已经概述的数字是2004年的160亿美元。然而，绿色的数字区域看起来相对较弱，2017年的最高点约为60亿美元。综上所述，从1997年到2017年，实体收入在整个音乐收入中占据主导地位。

answer: This picture is about a girl in a stationery shop. in the left of the picture, it shows the mother holds her daughter in her arms and buys a pink bag for her cute daughter. in the right, the picture depicts the little girl is wearing the pink backpack and holding a pencil in her hand. Apart from that, look at the picture she is very happy. in conclusion, this picture is about a girl and her mother in a stationery shop.
answer_zh: 这张照片是关于一个文具店里的女孩的。左边的照片中，妈妈抱着女儿，给可爱的女儿买了一个粉色的包包。右边的照片描绘的是小女孩背着粉色背包，手里拿着一支铅笔。除此之外，看照片她也很开心。总之，这张照片是关于一个女孩和她的母亲在文具店里的。

answer: This picture talks about some common knowledge of construction. On the left-hand side, there are three signs showing the requirements to wear a helmet, a pair of goggles and a pair of safety boots. Then on the right-hand side, there are another three signs. They also inform readers of the requirements to wear anti-noise earmuﬀs, masks and a pair of gloves. Correspondingly, the man in the middle demonstrate how these accessories look like in details, such as yellow helmet and red transparent goggles. In conclusion, this instruction can be found in particular construction area, such as cutting trees.
answer_zh: 这张图讲的是一些施工常识。左侧有三个标志，要求佩戴头盔、护目镜和安全鞋。然后在右手边，还有另外三个标志。他们还告知读者佩戴防噪音耳罩、口罩和手套的要求。相应地，中间的人则详细地展示了这些配件的样子，比如黄色的头盔和红色的透明护目镜。总之，该指令可以在特定的建筑领域找到，例如砍伐树木。

answer: This picture shows information about a family gathering. According to the graph, we can see family members are catching up for a meal. They interact with each other, laughing and sharing. In the middle of the picture, we can see a delicious meal including salad, cheese, steak, and some drinks on the dining table, and I guess they love the meal and are having a great time. In conclusion, this graph illustrates information about a family gathering.
answer_zh: 这张照片显示了有关家庭聚会的信息。从图中我们可以看到家人正在赶着吃饭。他们互相交流、欢笑、分享。在图片的中间，我们可以看到餐桌上有美味的饭菜，包括沙拉、奶酪、牛排和一些饮料，我猜他们很喜欢这顿饭，玩得很开心。总之，此图说明了有关家庭聚会的信息。

answer: This picture demonstrates the process to commercialize fruits. It uses grapes as an example. Firstly, the grapes are pick up from farms. Secondly, grapes are loaded on trucks for delivery. Thirdly, grapes are transferred to factories to process on conveyor belts. Then fourthly, they are packed up in boxes for further delivery. Lastly, grapes are put in trolleys for customers to purchase. In conclusion, this low chart of grapes shows the pattern of how fruits are delivered from farms to customers.
answer_zh: 这张照片展示了水果商业化的过程。它以葡萄为例。首先，葡萄是从农场采摘的。其次，将葡萄装上卡车进行运输。第三，葡萄被转移到工厂，在传送带上进行加工。第四，将它们包装在盒子中以便进一步交付。最后，葡萄被放入手推车中供顾客购买。总之，这张葡萄的低图表显示了水果如何从农场交付给客户的模式。

answer: This picture gives information about the distribution of rainforests in South America. According to the information, we can see the tropical rainforest in green, which can be found in the north and east part of south America, including Colombia, Ecuador, Bolivia and Brazil. However, we can see the temperate rainforest in dark green, which can only be found in the south eastern coastline of south America, covering part of Chile. This picture also talks about other areas like Paciﬁc Ocean, Atlantic Ocean, Argentina and Falkland Islands. In conclusion, tropical rainforests are far bigger than temperate rainforests.
answer_zh: 这张图片提供了有关南美洲雨林分布的信息。据资料显示，我们可以看到绿色的热带雨林，分布在南美洲的北部和东部，包括哥伦比亚、厄瓜多尔、玻利维亚和巴西。然而，我们可以看到深绿色的温带雨林，这种雨林只能在南美洲东南海岸线发现，覆盖了智利的部分地区。这张图片还谈到了太平洋、大西洋、阿根廷和福克兰群岛等其他地区。总之，热带雨林比温带雨林大得多。

answer: The diagram gives information about ice sheet melting. The ﬁrst step in the process is snowfall. In the next step, ice sheets are formed due to the accumulation of snowfall. After that, the ice sheet melts as a result of warm ocean water. In the ﬁnal stage, we can see some icebergs are ﬂoating in the water, and the iceberg is getting smaller. In conclusion, ice sheets play a vital role in the global climate system.
answer_zh: 该图提供了有关冰盖融化的信息。 The ﬁrst step in the process is snowfall.下一步，由于降雪的积累，冰盖形成。之后，冰盖因温暖的海水而融化。在最后阶段，我们可以看到一些冰山漂浮在水中，并且冰山变得越来越小。总之，冰盖在全球气候系统中发挥着至关重要的作用。

answer: The line chart gives information about income by age and gender in the UK in pounds. As we can see from the graph, male income starts at 12,000 pounds in the under 20 age group, and then the ﬁgure reaches the peak at the 45 to 49 age range, which is 30,000 pounds. After that, the ﬁgure decreases to 18,000 pounds in the over 75 age group. In terms of females, the ﬁgure increases from 11,000 pounds at under 20 age range to 21,000 pounds at the 30- 34 age range. After that, the ﬁgure shows a decreasing trend. In conclusion, males’earnings are higher than females over the course of a lifetime.
answer_zh: 该折线图提供了英国按年龄和性别划分的收入信息（以英镑为单位）。从图中我们可以看出，20岁以下年龄段的男性收入从12,000英镑开始，然后在45岁至49岁年龄段达到顶峰，即30,000英镑。此后，75 岁以上年龄组的体重下降至 18,000 磅。就女性而言，这一数字从 20 岁以下年龄范围的 11,000 磅增加到 30-34 岁年龄范围的 21,000 磅。之后，该数字呈现下降趋势。总之，男性一生的收入高于女性。

answer: This line graph gives information about the product life cycle consists of four stages. From the picture, we can see that the line is represented in red color. It is clear that the sales of the product are very low during the introduction stage. After that, the product enters the growth stage, and there is a dramatic increase in sales volume. During the maturity stage, sales will reach a peak and then start to slow down. Entering the ﬁnal stage, there is a decline in sales volume. Overall, the product life cycle has four stages: introduction, growth, maturity, and decline.
answer_zh: 该线图提供了有关产品生命周期的信息，该生命周期由四个阶段组成。从图中，我们可以看到该线以红色表示。显然，该产品在导入阶段的销量非常低。此后，产品进入成长期，销量急剧增加。在成熟阶段，销售将达到顶峰，然后开始放缓。进入最后阶段，销量出现下滑。总体而言，产品生命周期有四个阶段：引入期、成长期、成熟期和衰退期。

answer: This graph shows the process of germination of a seed into a plant. In the ﬁrst stage, a small seed is planted in soil. In the second stage, we can see an embryo from a seed. In the third stage, the seed starts to grow roots, and the seed coat protects the seed from water damage. After that, we can see a small plant breaks through the soil. After that, there is a larger plant with some leaves. Finally, we can see there is a large plant with many roots and leaves. In conclusion, the seed germination process is quite complicated.
answer_zh: 该图显示了种子发芽成植物的过程。在第一阶段，将一颗小种子种植在土壤中。在第二阶段，我们可以从种子中看到胚胎。第三阶段，种子开始长根，种皮保护种子免受水损害。之后，我们可以看到一株小植物破土而出。之后，有一个更大的植物，有一些叶子。最后，我们可以看到有一棵很大的植物，有很多根和叶子。总之，种子的发芽过程是相当复杂的。

answer: This graph shows information about the height of diﬀerent penguins. From the graph, it can be seen that the emperor penguin is 120 centimeters, which is the tallest penguin. The second largest penguin is the King, which is around 95 centimeters high. While Adelie penguins are about 68 centimeters tall and they are the smallest penguin. In conclusion, Chinstrap and Macaroni penguins have a very similar size.
answer_zh: 该图显示了有关不同企鹅身高的信息。从图中可以看出，帝企鹅身高120厘米，是最高的企鹅。第二大的企鹅是王企鹅，高约 95 厘米。而阿德利企鹅高约68厘米，是最小的企鹅。总之，帽带企鹅和马卡罗尼企鹅的体型非常相似。

answer: This graph shows information about the water cycle. According to the graph, the process starts from evaporation, and we can see the water is evaporated from the ocean due to solar radiation. The second stage is cloud transportation. The next step is precipitation. It can be seen that rain falls to the ground in this process. The last step is a surface run-oﬀ , and then the water will rise again into the atmosphere. In conclusion, this process will start all over again.
answer_zh: 该图显示了有关水循环的信息。根据该图，该过程从蒸发开始，我们可以看到水是由于太阳辐射而从海洋中蒸发的。第二阶段是云运输。下一步是沉淀。可以看到，在这个过程中，雨水落到了地面上。最后一步是地表径流，然后水将再次上升到大气中。总之，这个过程将重新开始。

answer: This picture is about journeys made by men and women in the United Kingdom according to their purpose measured in percentages. For men represented in blue bar, the largest number can be found in commuting and business, which is about 23 percent. The smallest number can be found in holiday or day trip, which is about 3. For women represented in red bar, the largest number can be found in shopping, which is about 24. The second-largest number can be found in school run, which is about 18. In conclusion, shopping is the most common purpose of traveling for women in the UK.
answer_zh: 这张图显示了英国男性和女性的旅行目的，并以百分比衡量。蓝条中的男性中，通勤和商务领域的人数最多，约为 23%。最少的是度假或一日游，约为3次。红条代表的女性中，最多的是购物，约为24次。第二多的是学校跑步，约为18次。综上所述，购物是英国女性最常见的出行目的。

answer: This graph illustrates information about an Iron Age hut. According to the graph, there are several items in this picture. On the top of the picture, we can see a pointed roof. In the middle of the picture, we can see there is a pillar supporting the house. On the left of the picture, we can see the rafter, while we can see the reed thatch on the right of the graph. At the bottom of the picture, we can see a seat, ashes, and a turf wall. In conclusion, this graph gives important information about an Iron Age house.
answer_zh: 该图展示了有关铁器时代小屋的信息。根据图表来看，这张图中有几个项目。在图片的顶部，我们可以看到一个尖尖的屋顶。在图片的中间，我们可以看到有一根柱子支撑着房子。在图的左边，我们可以看到椽子，而在图的右边，我们可以看到芦苇茅草。在图片的底部，我们可以看到一个座位、骨灰和一面草皮墙。总之，该图提供了有关铁器时代房屋的重要信息。

answer: This picture is about the number of texts on a typical day of adults and teens based on cellphone users who text. For adults represented in dark blue color, the largest number can be found in 1 to 10, which is about 51 percent. And the smallest number can be found in 51 to 100, which is about 7 percent. For the teens represented in light blue color, the largest number can be found in over 101, which is about 29 percent. And the smallest number can be found in none, which is about 2 percent. In conclusion, the number of 21 to 50 and 51 to 100 have the same ﬁgure, which is 18 percent.
answer_zh: 这张图显示了成年人和青少年一天中发短信的手机用户的短信数量。对于以深蓝色表示的成年人，数量最多的为 1 至 10，约为 51%。最小的数字是51到100，大约是7%。浅蓝色代表的青少年数量最多，超过 101 人，约占 29%。最少的也没有，大约是百分之二。综上所述，21至50和51至100的比例相同，均为18%。

answer: The bar graph compares volunteer participation rates across diﬀerent age groups, categorized by gender. The vertical axis shows the percentage of volunteers, ranging from 0 percent to 50 percent , while the horizontal axis lists age brackets from 18-24 to 85 years and over. Overall, females consistently volunteer at higher rates than males in all age groups. Participation peaks in the 35-44 and 45-54 age ranges for both genders, with females reaching nearly 50 percent and males around 35 percent . Rates decline gradually after age 55, with the lowest participation among those aged 85 years and over.
answer_zh: 该条形图比较了不同年龄组（按性别分类）的志愿者参与率。纵轴显示志愿者的百分比，范围从 0% 到 50%，而横轴列出从 18-24 岁到 85 岁及以上的年龄段。总体而言，在所有年龄段中，女性的志愿服务率始终高于男性。男女参与率在 35-44 岁和 45-54 岁年龄段达到顶峰，女性达到近 50%，男性约为 35%。 55 岁以后，参与率逐渐下降，其中 85 岁及以上人群的参与率最低。

answer: The following graph shows information about the process of hotel reservation. According to the graph, we can see that the ﬁrst step is customer, who is ﬁlling out a request form. Following by that, step two is hotel website for the request execution. According to the information we can get from the graph, the third step is of the request receiving by email. Finally, hotel administrator will conﬁrm reservation by phone. In conclusion, there are several steps all together and the process will start all over again.
answer_zh: 下图显示了有关酒店预订流程的信息。根据该图，我们可以看到第一步是客户，他正在填写申请表。接下来，第二步是执行请求的酒店网站。根据图中我们可以得到的信息，第三步是通过电子邮件接收请求。最后，酒店管理员将通过电话确认预订。总之，有几个步骤在一起，并且该过程将重新开始。

answer: This picture is about solar panel heat water. From the picture, we can see that the sun in yellow color provides sun rays, which is heat energy. And ﬁrst, we can see the cool water is in through the inlet. After that, the water goes through the water pipe placed in a box. After that, the warm water is out through the outlet. And we can also see there is a transparent top of the box. In conclusion, this picture is about the process of heating water.
answer_zh: 这张照片是关于太阳能电池板热水的。从图中我们可以看到，黄色的太阳提供的是太阳光线，也就是热能。首先，我们可以看到冷水通过入口进入。之后，水通过放置在盒子中的水管。之后，温水从出水口流出。我们还可以看到盒子的顶部有一个透明的。总之，这张图是关于加热水的过程。

answer: This picture gives information about a school hall. On the top of the picture, I can see the ceiling with bright lights. And also the windows arranged at the top of both left-hand-side and right-hand-side walls. At the bottom of the picture, I can see many red chairs. They are arranged in 7 lines and 6 rows with stairs in between. Apart from that, I can also see the big screen for projection with a stage set below. In conclusion, this is a very spacious and bright school hall.
answer_zh: 这张图片提供了有关学校礼堂的信息。在图片的顶部，我可以看到天花板上有明亮的灯光。左侧和右侧墙壁的顶部也设有窗户。在图片的底部，我可以看到许多红色的椅子。它们排列成7行6行，中间有楼梯。除此之外，我还可以看到投影的大屏幕，下面还有舞台。总之，这是一个非常宽敞明亮的学校礼堂。

answer: This chart displays the monthly rainfall (in mm) and average daily maximum and minimum temperatures (in Celsius) over a year. Looking at rainfall, it starts low in January, increases steadily from February to June, reaching the highest point in June. Then it decreases gradually from July to December, with very little rainfall in the last few months. For temperatures, both the average daily maximum and minimum remain relatively stable throughout the year, with only slight ﬂuctuations. They stay at a low level, around 20-30 Celsius, without signiﬁcant changes month by month. In summary, the area experiences a distinct rainy season from February to July, while temperatures remain consistently mild all year round.

answer: The ﬂow chart shows us a business cycle. As we can see that there are four steps. The ﬁrst step is to start with the manufacturers. They will produce goods and services. Then the second step is the retailer. They will get products from the manufacturer and sell them in the store. Then the third step is the consumer. They will buy the products in the store and use them. Then it comes to the ﬁnal step of recycler. They will recycle the products from the consumers and return them to the manufacturer. In conclusion, the process is simple and straightforward.
answer_zh: 流程图向我们展示了一个经济周期。我们可以看到有四个步骤。第一步是从制造商开始。他们将生产商品和服务。那么第二步就是零售商。他们将从制造商处获取产品并在商店中出售。那么第三步就是消费者。他们会在商店购买产品并使用它们。然后就到了回收器的最后一步。他们将从消费者那里回收产品并将其返回给制造商。总之，该过程简单明了。

answer: The ﬂow chart shows us the project management process. As we can see that there are four steps. Firstly, the project is created and goes to the monitor project status and data warehouse. Secondly, we need to create the project documentation. This needs time, expense and purchase, and it goes to data warehouse. Thirdly, we need to assign tasks and processes to adjust project schedule as required. We also need to sign oﬀ on process check points. Finally, we need to conduct meetings, document agendas and minutes. In conclusion, the process is complex, and the background is blue.
answer_zh: 该流程图向我们展示了项目管理流程。我们可以看到有四个步骤。首先，项目被创建并进入监控项目状态和数据仓库。其次，我们需要创建项目文档。这需要时间、费用和购买，并且会进入数据仓库。第三，我们需要分配任务和流程，根据需要调整项目进度。我们还需要签署流程检查点。最后，我们需要召开会议、记录议程和会议记录。总之，过程比较复杂，背景是蓝色的。

answer: The ﬂow chart shows us the life of the chicken. As we can see that there are three steps. In the ﬁrst step, the adult chicken will lay egg and the chicken is in yellow color. In the second step, there is an egg. It is yellow and round. After 3 weeks, the egg will become young chick. The chick is cute and beautiful. After about 3 months, the young chick will become the adult chicken. In conclusion, the cycle will start again.
