answer: The picture shows us the process of the photography.It can be seen from the ﬂowchart that the ﬁrst step is about whether you have a camera or not, if the answer is yes, you then need to make sure it has batteries. After that you still need to conﬁrm that the batteries are fully charged. And then the next step is to ensure that the camera can work as normal, ﬁnally you need to ﬁgure out how to use the camera and whether it is complicated.If you may answer no to any questions during the process, the only thing you need to do is to ﬁnd another hobby.In conclusion, the ﬂowchart shows us a clear process of using a camera as a hobby.
answer_zh: 图为我们拍摄的过程。从流程图中可以看出，第一步是判断你是否有相机，如果有，那么你需要确保它有电池。之后您仍然需要确认电池已充满电。然后下一步就是确保相机能正常工作，最后你需要弄清楚如何使用相机，是否复杂。如果在这个过程中你对任何问题的回答都是“否”，那么你唯一需要做的就是找到另一个爱好。总之，流程图向我们展示了一个清晰的使用相机作为爱好的过程。

answer: The graph demonstrates the world population development from 1750 to 2050 in developing and industrialized countries.Form the graph we can see that the population in developing countries has remained stable in 1 billion from 1750 to 1900, after that it witnessed a dramatic increase to 10 billion until 2050.However for industrialized countries, it remained at a relatively low level throughout the years, which is around 1 billion.In conclusion, while developing countries have undergone a sharp population increase, the population in industrialized countries has seen little change.
answer_zh: 该图展示了从1750年到2050年发展中国家和工业化国家的世界人口发展情况。从图中我们可以看到，从1750年到1900年，发展中国家的人口一直稳定在10亿，之后急剧增加到2050年的100亿。而工业化国家多年来一直保持在一个相对较低的水平，在10亿左右。综上所述，发展中国家人口急剧增长的同时，工业化国家的人口变化不大。

answer: The ﬂow chart indicates how an apple seed can become an apple tree.As can be seen from the chart, the ﬁrst step is about the apple seed, after burying it under the ground, it will go to the second step which is about a small apple tree.After the leaves are grown on the tree, it will come to the third step which is about the blossom of the tree. Then many small apples will come out of the blossoms. Finally we can get the red and big apples from the apple tree.In conclusion, we can get the seed from the matured apple and start the whole process again and again.
answer_zh: 流程图展示了一颗苹果种子如何变成一棵苹果树。从图中可以看出，第一步是苹果种子，把它埋在地下后，就会进入第二步，变成一棵小苹果树。当树上长出叶子后，就会进入第三步，变成树上的花。然后花丛中就会结出许多小苹果。最后我们可以从苹果树上得到又红又大的苹果。总之，我们可以从成熟的苹果中得到种子，并不断地开始整个过程​​。

answer: The line chart indicates the US fruit and vegetable consumption trends from 1970 to 2010 in pounds per person per year.For the vegetable consumption, it has remained stable at 330 from 1970 to 1980, after that it climbed drastically to 425 in 2000, which is the highest, before dropping down to 400 in 2010.When we look at the fruit consumption, it increased gradually from 230 in 1970 to 280 in 2000, which is the highest, and then it also declined to 250 until the end of the period.In conclusion, vegetable consumption is much larger than fruit consumption throughout the period.
answer_zh: 折线图显示了美国从1970年到2010年的水果和蔬菜消费趋势，单位是每年人均磅数。蔬菜消费量从1970年到1980年一直稳定在330，之后急剧攀升至2000年的最高425，然后在2010年下降到400。从水果消费来看，从2010年的230开始逐渐增加。 1970年到2000年最高为280，之后也下降到250，直到该时期结束。综上所述，整个时期蔬菜消费远大于水果消费。

answer: The bar chart shows the average rainfall in inches in New York, Dallas, phoenix and Honolulu.As we can see from the graph, New York has the largest amount, which is 47.25 inches, next to it is Dallas, which is 33.70 inches.When we look at the other two cities, they are signiﬁcantly smaller than the ﬁrst two, with phoenix amounting for 7.66 and Honolulu, 22.02.In conclusion, we may guess that the average rainfalls in the four diﬀerent cities are largely aﬀected by geographic locations and speciﬁc climate patterns.
answer_zh: 条形图显示了纽约、达拉斯、菲尼克斯和檀香山的平均降雨量（以英寸为单位）。从图中我们可以看到，纽约的降雨量最大，为 47.25 英寸，其次是达拉斯，为 33.70 英寸。当我们看其他两个城市时，它们明显小于前两个城市，菲尼克斯的降雨量为 7.66 英寸，檀香山的降雨量为 7.66 英寸， 22.02. 总之，我们可以猜测这四个不同城市的平均降雨量在很大程度上受到地理位置和特定气候模式的影响。

answer: The ﬂow chart shows us the HEART.The ﬁrst step is about the patient, who will go to see a doctor when feeling sick.After that the second step is about the rehab center, the patients will be assigned to have supervised rehabilitation exercise or take a rest at home.Next the third step is about doctor follow-up, this step includes a facility called HEART, which can facilitate the long-term lifestyle change in the patient.Apart from that, the HEART contains bands and feedback.In conclusion, the whole process requires the collaboration between the patients and the doctors.
answer_zh: 流程图向我们展示了HEART。第一步是病人，生病时去看医生。第二步是康复中心，病人会被安排进行监督康复锻炼或在家休息。接下来第三步是医生随访，这一步包括一个叫做HEART的设施，可以促进病人长期生活方式的改变。除此之外，HEART还包含带子和反馈。总而言之，整个过程需要患者和医生之间的合作。

answer: The picture indicates the ocean currents. From the picture we can see there is a circuit with two diﬀerent currents. The ﬁrst step is about the sea-to-air heat transfer which can transfer the heat from the ocean to the air, after that the sea will ﬂow into the cold and salty deep current along with diﬀerent oceans such as the Indian Ocean. And then it comes to the second step which is about the solar warming of the ocean waters, the currents are running counter-clockwise to mix with the Paciﬁc Ocean so that it becomes the warm shallow current. In conclusion, the two currents are running in a circuit among diﬀerent oceans around the world.
answer_zh: 图为洋流。从图中我们可以看到有一个具有两种不同电流的电路。第一步是海气传热，将海洋中的热量传递到空气中，之后海水会与印度洋等不同的海洋一起流入冷而咸的深海流。然后是第二步，关于海水的太阳变暖，洋流逆时针流动，与太平洋混合，成为温暖的浅水流。总之，这两种洋流在世界各地不同海洋之间循环流动。

answer: The line chart gives a vivid description about the median and average sale prices for new homes sold in the US between 1963 and 2011.For the average sales ﬁgure, it remained stable at 40,000 from 1963 to 1977, after that it began to increase slowly to 150,000 in 1989, then it ﬂuctuated a bit before climbing up again to the highest point, which is at 300,000 in 2007, however after the peak it began to drop to 260,000 in 2009.In terms of the median sales ﬁgure, it has shared a similar pattern with the average one with the peak at 250,000 in 2007.In conclusion, for the new homes sold in United States, 2007 is a turning point for both median and average sales prices.
answer_zh: 折线图生动地描述了 1963 年至 2011 年间美国新房销售中位数和平均销售价格。对于平均销售数字而言，1963 年至 1977 年稳定在 4 万套，之后开始缓慢增长，到 1989 年达到 15 万套，随后略有波动，再次攀升至最高点，即2007年为30万套，但在峰值后开始回落，2009年降至26万套。从销售中位数来看，与平均销售价格走势类似，2007年达到峰值25万套。综上所述，对于美国新房销售来说，2007年对于销售中位数和平均销售价格来说都是一个转折点。

title_zh: 三个非洲城市的月均气温
answer: This line graph gives the information about average monthly temperature for three African cities, including Mombasa, Cairo and Cape Town from January to December, measured in degree Fahrenheit. Mombasa, which is represented in red, starts at 80 degree Fahrenheit in January and the minimum occurs in July at 75 degree Fahrenheit. Cairo is represented in blue, and it starts at 55 degree Fahrenheit in January and concludes at 57 degree Fahrenheit in December. The maximum occurs in July at 83 degree Fahrenheit. In conclusion, this graph shows very interesting information about temperatures in Africa.
answer_zh: 此线图提供了三个非洲城市（包括蒙巴萨、开罗和开普敦）一月至十二月的平均每月气温信息（以华氏度为单位）。蒙巴萨以红色表示，一月份开始气温为 80 华氏度，最低气温出现在 7 月份，气温为 75 华氏度。开罗以蓝色表示，一月开始温度为 55 华氏度，十二月结束温度为 57 华氏度。最高温度出现在 7 月，温度为 83 华氏度。总之，该图显示了有关非洲气温的非常有趣的信息。

answer: This map gives the information about browser usage on Wikimedia in October 2011. The largest area is more than 100 million, which is represented in dark blue, and you can ﬁnd it in the south and northwest of North America, east of South America, north of Asia and Europe. More than 1 billion is represented in black, and you can ﬁnd it only in China and a little bit in south of Asia. The least area is less than 1 million, which is represented in yellow, and you can ﬁnd it in northeast of North America, and a little bit in Africa and South America. In conclusion, this map shows very interesting information about browser usage on Wikimedia in the world.
answer_zh: 这张地图给出了2011年10月维基媒体上浏览器使用情况的信息。最大的区域超过1亿，用深蓝色表示，你可以在北美的南部和西北部、南美洲的东部、亚洲和欧洲的北部找到它。超过 10 亿人用黑色表示，而且只有在中国和亚洲南部的一小部分地区才能找到。最小的面积不到100万，用黄色表示，在北美东北部都可以找到，非洲和南美洲也有一点。总之，这张地图显示了有关世界各地维基媒体浏览器使用情况的非常有趣的信息。

answer: This pie chart gives the information about net surﬁng using diﬀerent browsers in percentage. I.E. which is represented in blue, occupies the largest proportion, at 34.2%, and Android, which is represented in orange, occupies the smallest proportion, at 1.9%. In addition, Firefox and Chrome, which are represented in red and green, are at 23.6% and 20.6% respectively. Other browsers, including Opera in light green and other in grey, occupy 5.0% and 3.5% respectively. In conclusion, this graph presents very interesting information about net surﬁng on diﬀerent browsers.
answer_zh: 该饼图以百分比形式给出了使用不同浏览器上网的信息。 IE。以蓝色表示的占比最大，为34.2%；以橙色表示的Android占比最小，为1.9%。此外，以红色和绿色代表的Firefox和Chrome分别占23.6%和20.6%。其他浏览器，包括浅绿色的 Opera 和灰色的其他浏览器，分别占据 5.0% 和 3.5%。总之，该图提供了有关不同浏览器上上网的非常有趣的信息。

answer: This line graph provides the information about the relationship between temperature variation, carbon dioxide and dust concentration from thousands years ago till now. For temperature variations measured in degree Celsius and represented in blue, the peak occurs in 325 thousand years ago and 125 thousand years ago, at 3 degree Celsius. Carbon dioxide is measured in ppmv and represented in blue, and the peak occurs at the same time as the maximum temperature variation occurs. Lastly, for dust concentration in ppm and red, the peak occurs around nowadays at 1.8 ppm. In conclusion, this graph shows impressive information about air pollution.
answer_zh: 该线图提供了从数千年前到现在温度变化、二氧化碳和灰尘浓度之间关系的信息。对于以摄氏度测量并以蓝色表示的温度变化，峰值出现在 32.5 万年前和 12.5 万年前，温度为 3 摄氏度。二氧化碳以 ppmv 为单位测量并以蓝色表示，峰值与最大温度变化同时出现。最后，对于 ppm 和红色粉尘浓度，峰值出现在 1.8 ppm 附近。总之，该图显示了有关空气污染的令人印象深刻的信息。

answer: This line graph provides the information about annual per capita meat consumption from 1961 to 2009, measured in kilograms, in diﬀerent countries including USA, China and Liberia. USA, which is shown in blue, starts at 90 kg in 1961 and concludes at 120kg in 2009. China, which is shown in red, starts at 5kg in 1961 and then increases rapidly and concludes at a maximum of 60kg in 2009. However, for Liberia, India and Ethiopia which are shown in green, orange and grey, the meat consumption remains relatively stable throughout the years. In conclusion, this graph gives impressive information about meat consumption.
answer_zh: 该折线图提供了 1961 年至 2009 年美国、中国和利比里亚等不同国家的年人均肉类消费量信息（以千克为单位）。以蓝色显示的美国，1961年为90公斤，2009年为120公斤。以红色显示的中国，1961年为5公斤，然后迅速增加，2009年达到最高60公斤。而以绿色、橙色和灰色显示的利比里亚、印度和埃塞俄比亚，多年来肉类消费量保持相对稳定。总之，这张图提供了有关肉类消费的令人印象深刻的信息。

answer: This table provides the information about annual income of bachelor degree holders in diﬀerent ﬁelds, including business and education, in 2001 and 2011, measured in dollars. It is clear that for business ﬁeld, the annual income increases from about 100 thousand dollars in 2001 to about 180 thousand dollars in 2011, while for education ﬁeld, the annual income increases from about 80 thousand dollars in 2001 to about 95 thousand dollars in 2011. In conclusion, this table gives impressive information about annual income of bachelor degree holders in business and education ﬁelds.
answer_zh: 该表提供了 2001 年和 2011 年不同领域（包括商业和教育）学士学位持有者的年收入信息（以美元计算）。很明显，商业领域的年收入从2001年的约10万美元增加到2011年的约18万美元，而教育领域的年收入从2001年的约8万美元增加到2011年的约9.5万美元。总而言之，该表提供了有关商业和教育领域学士学位持有者年收入的令人印象深刻的信息。

answer: This table shows some information about the relationship between babies’ sleep time and their ages, including nighttime sleep, daytime sleep and total sleep, measured in hours. And the numbers of naps in parentheses are also shown. It can be seen that as babies’ ages increase from 1 month old to 3 years old, the nighttime sleep increases from 8.5 hours to 10.5 hours and the daytime sleep decreases from 7 hours to 1.5 hours. As a results, the total sleep decreases from 15.5 hours to 12 hours. Also the number of naps decreases from 3 to
answer_zh: 该表显示了有关婴儿睡眠时间与其年龄之间关系的一些信息，包括夜间睡眠、白天睡眠和总睡眠（以小时为单位）。括号中还显示了小睡的次数。可以看出，随着宝宝年龄从1个月大到3岁，夜间睡眠时间从8.5小时增加到10.5小时，白天睡眠时间从7小时减少到1.5小时。结果，总睡眠时间从 15.5 小时减少到 12 小时。小睡次数也从 3 次减少到

title_en: In conclusion, this table gives impressive information about babies’ sleep time.

answer: This table shows some information about the relationship between the population and the year, from 1650 to 2000. The table is sourced from the World Almanac and Book of Facts. We can see from the table that in 1650, the population was about half billion, and in 1850, the population was about 1.2 billion, more than doubled. After 1850, the growth became even more rapidly. The population reached 4.5 billion in 1980 and 6 billion in 2000, which was six times more than that in 1850. Over the 350 years, the population increased by 12 times. In conclusion, this table provides a lot of information about population.
answer_zh: 该表显示了 1650 年至 2000 年人口与年份之间关系的一些信息。该表源自《世界年鉴》和《事实之书》。从表中我们可以看到，1650年，人口约为5亿，1850年，人口约为12亿，增加了一倍多。 1850年后，增长更加迅速。 1980年人口达到45亿，2000年达到60亿，是1850年的六倍。350年来，人口增长了12倍。总之，该表提供了有关人口的大量信息。

answer: This ﬂow diagram gives the information about the recycling process in industry. There are ﬁve stages in total and it is a cycle process. It starts from the manufacturing production going to the transportation, and after the transportation, the utilization is reused. While the products are provided to the users, the disposal is recycled and sent to the material extraction stage. After the material extraction stage, the materials which can be used are sent to the manufacturing production again to be reused, and the process is continuing. In conclusion, this graph clearly shows a recycle process in industry.
answer_zh: 该流程图提供了有关工业回收过程的信息。总共有五个阶段，是一个循环过程。从制造生产到运输，运输后再利用。在将产品提供给用户的同时，废物被回收并送往材料提取阶段。在材料提取阶段之后，可以使用的材料被再次发送到制造生产以重新使用，并且该过程继续进行。总之，该图清楚地显示了工业中的回收过程。

answer: This bar chart gives the information about leverage ratios for major investment banks, including Bear Stearns, Lehman Brothers and Morgan Stanley, from 2003 to 2007. The leverage ratio is measured in total debt or stockholders’ equity. Bear Stearns is represented in light blue, and its leverage ratio achieves a maximum in 2007 at 34, while reaches a minimum in 2005 at 26. For Morgan Stanley, which is represented in pink, a maximum occurs in 2007 as well at 34, and a minimum in 2003 at 23, while Lehman Brothers in green also has a highest leverage ratio in 2007, at 29. In conclusion, this graph shows important information about leverage ratios for major investment banks.
answer_zh: 此条形图提供了 2003 年至 2007 年期间主要投资银行（包括贝尔斯登、雷曼兄弟和摩根士丹利）的杠杆率信息。杠杆率以总债务或股东权益衡量。贝尔斯登以浅蓝色表示，其杠杆率在 2007 年达到最高，为 34，而在 2005 年达到最低，为 26。对于以粉红色表示的摩根士丹利，最大值出现在 2007 年，为 34，最低出现在 2003 年，为 23，而绿色雷曼兄弟的杠杆率也在 2007 年达到最高，为 29。总而言之，该图显示了重要的杠杆率。有关主要投资银行杠杆率的信息。

answer: This bar chart is about the percentage of students proﬁcient in a foreign language in diﬀerent countries, including China, India and Russia, categorized by males and females. India has the highest percentage of both male and female students proﬁcient in a foreign language, at 56% and 69% respectively. In contrast, China has the lowest percentage of both female and male students proﬁcient in a foreign language, at 33% and 15% respectively. In Thailand, the percentages of male and female students proﬁcient in a foreign language are 30% and 27% respectively. In conclusion, this graph provides interesting information.
answer_zh: 该条形图显示了不同国家（包括中国、印度和俄罗斯）精通外语的学生的百分比（按男性和女性分类）。印度精通外语的男女学生比例最高，分别为 56% 和 69%。相比之下，中国男女学生精通外语的比例最低，分别为 33% 和 15%。在泰国，精通外语的男女学生比例分别为 30% 和 27%。总之，该图提供了有趣的信息。

answer: This graph is about the amount of potatoes consumed from Monday to Sunday, measured in kilos. It starts at 15 kilos on Monday, followed by an rapid increase to a small peak at 30 kilos on Wednesday. However, the amount starts to decrease and achieves a minimum at 10 kilos on Thursday. After that, the amount increases rapidly again and it reaches a maximum of 35 kilos on Sunday. This graph is a combination of bar chart and line chart, where the line chart shows the middle points of the bars. In conclusion, this graph provides interesting information about the amount of potatoes consumed over the week.
answer_zh: 该图显示了周一至周日的土豆消耗量（以公斤为单位）。周一开始体重为 15 公斤，随后迅速增加，周三达到 30 公斤的小高峰。然而，数量开始减少，并在周四达到最低 10 公斤。此后，数量再次迅速增加，周日最高达到35公斤。该图是条形图和折线图的组合，其中折线图显示条形的中点。总之，该图提供了有关一周内土豆消耗量的有趣信息。

answer: This line graph is about actual and projected total emissions of six greenhouse gases from 1990 to 2010 in United Kingdom. Also the target of emission is shown on the graph. The emission is measured in million tones CO2 equivalent. The projected emission, which is represented in black, starts at 725 million tonnes in 1990, and concludes at 675 million tonnes in 2010. The minimum occurs in 2000 at about 650 million tonnes. For Actual emission represented in white, it starts at about 750 million tonnes in 1990 and concludes at about 650 million tonnes in 2000. In conclusion, This graph provides very interesting information.
answer_zh: 该折线图显示了 1990 年至 2010 年英国六种温室气体的实际和预计总排放量。排放目标也显示在图表上。排放量以百万吨二氧化碳当量衡量。预计排放量（以黑色表示）从 1990 年开始为 7.25 亿吨，到 2010 年为 6.75 亿吨。最低排放量出现在 2000 年，约为 6.5 亿吨。对于以白色表示的实际排放量，其起始于 1990 年约 7.5 亿吨，结束于 2000 年约 6.5 亿吨。 总之，该图提供了非常有趣的信息。

answer: This bar chart reveals the information about product sales of product X from January to December, measured in dollars. The product is represented in orange colour. It starts at $80,000 in January, followed by a decrease to about $20,000 in April. A slight increase to $25,000 in May occurs and then the sales decrease to a minimum of $13,000 in June. After that, the sales ﬂuctuate a bit and achieves a maximum of $72,000 in November. The sales conclude at $65,000 in December. In conclusion, this graph includes information of product sales of product x by month.
answer_zh: 此条形图显示了产品 X 从 1 月到 12 月的产品销售额信息（以美元为单位）。该产品以橙色表示。一月份起价为 80,000 美元，四月份降至约 20,000 美元。 5 月份销售额小幅增加至 25,000 美元，然后 6 月份销售额降至最低 13,000 美元。此后，销售额略有波动，11 月份最高达到 72,000 美元。 12 月份的销售额为 65,000 美元。总之，该图包含了产品x按月的产品销售信息。

answer: This graph reveals the information about subprime share of mortgage originations and home ownership rate in the US from 1997 to 2007, both measured in percentage. The subprime share is represented in blue bars. The minimum occurs in 1999 at 5% and the maximum occurs in 2006 at about 20%. The home ownership is represented in a red line. It starts at 65.5% in 1997, and concludes at about 68% in 2007. A maximum occurs in 2004 at 69%. In conclusion, this graph includes a lot of information about subprime share and home ownership in the US.
answer_zh: 该图显示了 1997 年至 2007 年美国次级抵押贷款发放比例和住房拥有率的信息（均以百分比衡量）。次级抵押贷款份额以蓝色条表示。最小值出现在 1999 年，为 5%，最大值出现在 2006 年，约为 20%。房屋所有权用红线表示。 1997 年为 65.5%，2007 年为 68% 左右。2004 年达到最高值，为 69%。总之，该图包含了有关美国次级抵押贷款份额和房屋所有权的大量信息。

answer: This pie chart reveals the information about Taxes weather deaths from 1988 to 2005. Flooding, which is presented in purple, and extreme heat, which is represented in red, occupy the most proportions of the chart. The sum of these two has exceeded half of the chart. Followed by ﬂooding and extreme heat, tornadoes in dark red, lightning in yellow, and tropical systems in blue also occupy some of the proportions. The least proportions go to winter storms in green and high wind in pink. High wind occupies the smallest proportion of all. In conclusion, this graph gives a lot of information about Texas weather deaths, over the year from 1988 to 2005.
answer_zh: 该饼图显示了 1988 年至 2005 年有关税收天气死亡的信息。紫色表示的洪水和红色表示的极端高温占据了图表的大部分比例。两者加起来已经超过了图表的一半。继洪水和极端高温之后，深红色的龙卷风、黄色的闪电和蓝色的热带系统也占据了一些比例。绿色表示冬季风暴，粉红色表示大风。强风所占比例最小。总之，该图提供了 1988 年至 2005 年这一年德克萨斯州天气死亡人数的大量信息。

answer: This graph is about the company percentage of total market share of six diﬀerent companies. The information is represented in two forms including a pie chart and a bar chart. From both of the charts, we can see that company B occupies the largest proportion at 40%, and it is represented in purple, followed by which company C occupies 25% and company D occupies 17%, and they are represented in green and red respectively. Company A and company E are represented in light blue and dark blue respectively, at 10% and 7%. Company F occupies the least proportion at 1% only and is represented in orange. In conclusion, the two charts include a lot of information.
answer_zh: 该图显示了六家不同公司的总市场份额的百分比。该信息以两种形式表示，包括饼图和条形图。从两张图中我们可以看到，B公司占比最大，为40%，用紫色表示，其次是C公司，占25%，D公司占17%，分别用绿色和红色表示。 A公司和E公司分别用浅蓝色和深蓝色表示，比例为10%和7%。 F公司所占比例最小，仅1%，以橙色表示。总之，这两张图表包含了很多信息。

answer: This bar chart provides the information about securitization market activity from the year 00 to the year 09, measured in billion dollars and categorized by CDO in yellow, ABS in green, CMBS in blue and RMBS in black. It is clear that the total number starts at about $500 billion in the year 00 and concludes at about $100 billion in the year 09. A maximum occurs in the year 06 at about $2000 billion. The RMBS number has a similar trend as the total number, while the other numbers remain relatively stable for the ﬁrst few years until the year 06 and 07 when the numbers become larger. In conclusion, this graph includes a lot of information about securitization market activity.

answer_zh: 此饼图提供了有关不同州的梅洛销售信息，包括澳大利亚首都特区、新南威尔士州、昆士兰州和维多利亚州。维多利亚州以紫色表示，占比最大，为 37,583 人，其次是昆士兰州，以绿色表示，占比第二大，为 33,373 人。澳大利亚首都特区以蓝色表示，占第三大比例，为 32,305 人。新南威尔士州所占比例最小，为 28,190 人，并以红色表示。总之，这个饼图包含了很多有趣的信息。

answer: This bar chart provides the information about total wine sales in diﬀerent states, including ACT, NSW, QLD and VIC. answer_zh: 该条形图提供了不同州（包括澳大利亚首都直辖区、新南威尔士州、昆士兰州和维多利亚州）葡萄酒总销量的信息。在以蓝色表示的 ACT 地区，Semillion 的销量最高，约为 40,000 辆，而 Shiraz 的销量最低，约为 20,000 辆。在以红色表示的新南威尔士州，起泡酒的销量最多，约为 30,000 辆，而雷司令的销量最少，约为 10,000 辆。在绿色的昆士兰州和紫色的维多利亚州，Semillion 的销量最高，分别为 35,000 辆和约 40,000 辆。总之，这张图提供了很多有趣的信息。

answer: This ﬂow diagram is about the life of a letter. It starts from paper being produced and a letter can be written on the paper. After that, the letter is put into an envelop and an address is written on it with a stamp. Then the letter is ready to be sent out. The letter is put into a postbox, from which the letter can be received by the post oﬃce. A post man sends the letter to the address indicated on the envelop. The letter is received by the person who opens the envelop and read the letter. Later he throws the letter into the bin, and it will be recycled so that new paper will be produced and used to write a new letter. The process continues. In conclusion, this graph provides impressive information.
answer_zh: 这个流程图是关于一封信的生命周期的。它从生产纸张开始，然后可以在纸上写信。之后，将信件放入信封中，并在上面写上地址并贴上邮票。然后这封信就可以寄出了。信件被放入邮箱，邮局可以从该邮箱接收信件。邮递员将信寄往信封上注明的地址。打开信封并阅读这封信的人会收到这封信。后来他把这封信扔进垃圾桶，它会被回收利用，从而生产出新的纸张并用来写一封新信。该过程仍在继续。总之，该图提供了令人印象深刻的信息。

answer: This pie chart reveals the information about income from various economic sectors in Morocco, including ﬁshing, agriculture and industry, in 2003. Tourism, which is represented in red, occupies the largest proportion at 26%, followed by which industry in yellow and workers’ remittances in blue occupy 24% and 21% respectively. Petroleum in purple and ﬁshing in light red occupy 14% and 13% respectively. Agriculture in blue occupies the smallest proportion at 2%. In conclusion, this graph provides very impressive information about income in Morocco.
answer_zh: 该饼图显示了2003年摩洛哥各经济部门的收入信息，包括渔业、农业和工业。其中红色代表的旅游业所占比例最大，为26%，其次是黄色工业和蓝色工人汇款，分别占24%和21%。紫色为石油，浅红色为渔业，分别占14%和13%。蓝色农业所占比例最小，为2%。总之，该图提供了有关摩洛哥收入的非常令人印象深刻的信息。

answer: This map reveals the information about change in potential cereal output in 2080. Most areas in the north and south of the map are categorized by not suitable, represented in grey. In the middle of the map where it is suitable, no change (plus or minus 5%) represented in yellow occupies the largest area, followed by which increasing by 5%-25% or more represented in light green and dark green occupy the second largest proportion. Also there are small areas on the edges that are categorized by decreasing by 50% or more and they are represented in red. In conclusion, this map provides very impressive information about cereal output.
answer_zh: 该地图揭示了 2080 年谷物潜在产量变化的信息。地图北部和南部的大部分地区都属于不适宜地区，以灰色表示。在适宜的地图中部，以黄色表示的无变化（正负5%）所占面积最大，其次是浅绿色和深绿色表示的增加5%-25%以上所占比例次之。此外，边缘上还有一些小区域，按减少 50% 或更多进行分类，并以红色表示。总之，这张地图提供了有关谷物产量的非常令人印象深刻的信息。

answer: This graph reveals the information about sunrise and sunset times over the year, recording the ﬁrst days and the ﬁfteenth days of the months from January to December. It is clear that the sunrise time represented in blue is early in January and December, and gradually becomes the latest in June. In contrast, the sunset time represented in pink is the latest in January and December, while it is the earliest in June. It can be observed that the times of the sunrise and sunset are exactly opposite, and the shapes of the trends of both sunrise and sunset times show an “S” shape. In conclusion, this graph gives very interesting information about sunrise and sunset times.
answer_zh: 该图显示了一年中有关日出和日落时间的信息，记录了从一月到十二月的第一天和第十五天。可以明显看出，蓝色代表的日出时间在1月和12月较早，到6月逐渐变得最晚。相比之下，粉色代表的日落时间在一月和十二月最晚，而在六月最早。可以观察到，日出和日落的时间完全相反，日出和日落时间的趋势形状均呈“S”形。总之，该图提供了有关日出和日落时间的非常有趣的信息。

answer: This table reveals the information about total inactivity rate 15 years above, categorized by age groups including 15-19, 40-44 and 65 plus, and by sex. The information consists of total population, total inactivity population and inactivity rate. For males, the largest total population is in the age group 15-19, and the largest total inactivity population is also in the 15-19 group. Therefore, the inactivity rate is the highest in this age group at 36.9%. For female, however, the age group 15-19 also has the largest total population and total inactivity population, but the inactivity rate is the highest in the 65 group at 53.6%. answer_zh: 该表显示了 15 岁以上总不活动率的信息，按年龄组（包括 15-19 岁、40-44 岁和 65 岁以上）以及性别分类。 The information consists of total population, total inactivity population and inactivity rate. answer: The diagram shows the process of milk production. Firstly, cows are grazed and they can produce milk through milking machines. Milk can be obtained twice a day. Some of the milk obtained is sent to refrigeration storage, and the rest is delivered to Dairy by a milk tanker daily. In the Dairy, the milk is processed in two ways. One is to make the milk into dairy products such as cheese, cream and butter, while the other way is to pasteurize and package the milk. The packaged milk is sent to the supermarkets and shops for sale. In conclusion, this graph shows very impressive information about milk and dairy products production.
answer_zh: 下图显示了牛奶生产的过程。首先，奶牛被放牧，它们可以通过挤奶机生产牛奶。每天可以获得两次牛奶。获得的牛奶部分被送往冷藏库，其余的每天由奶罐车运送到乳品厂。在乳制品行业，牛奶有两种加工方式。一种是将牛奶制成奶酪、奶油和黄油等乳制品，另一种方法是将牛奶进行巴氏灭菌和包装。包装好的牛奶被送往超市和商店出售。总之，该图显示了有关牛奶和乳制品生产的非常令人印象深刻的信息。

answer: This graph contains the information about the population of Litchﬁeld from 1901 to 2011. The information is shown in a line and the population is shown by the blue-shaded area under the line. It starts at about 7500 in 1901 and gradually increases to about 10,000 in 1951. After that, the population increases much more rapidly and reaches about 22,000 in 1971. The increase slows down later and concludes at about 24,000 in 2011. There is a slight decrease from 1991 to 2001. In conclusion, this graph provides signiﬁcant information about the population of Litchﬁeld.
answer_zh: 该图包含 1901 年至 2011 年利奇菲尔德的人口信息。信息以线条显示，人口由线条下方的蓝色阴影区域显示。 1901 年人口约为 7500 人，逐渐增加到 1951 年约 10,000 人。此后，人口增长速度更快，1971 年达到约 22,000 人。随后增长速度放缓，2011 年人口约为 24,000 人。1991 年至 2001 年略有下降。总之，该图提供了有关人口数量的重要信息。利奇菲尔德的人口。

answer: The bar graph illustrates volunteer participation rates across diﬀerent age groups, comparing males and females. Notably, females consistently demonstrate higher volunteer rates than males in every age category. The data suggests middle-aged individuals are most likely to volunteer, while participation declines signiﬁcantly in older age groups.
answer_zh: 条形图显示了不同年龄组的志愿者参与率，比较了男性和女性。 35 至 44 岁年龄段的男女志愿者比例最高（女性约为 40%，男性约为 30%）。随着年龄的增长，参与率逐渐下降，85岁及以上人群的参与率最低。值得注意的是，在每个年龄段，女性的志愿率始终高于男性。数据表明，中年人最有可能参与志愿服务，而老年群体的参与度则显着下降。

answer: This line graph contains the information about overseas visitors to three diﬀerent areas including the coast, the mountains and the lakes, in a European country between 1987 and 2007, measured in thousands people. For rainfall intensity measured in mmh, the maximum ﬂuctuates with a maximum of about 30mm per hour and a minimum of 0mm per hour, while the average remains relatively stable at 0mm per hour throughout the time. In conclusion, this graph gives crucial information about rainfall.
answer_zh: 该线图显示了哈尔蒂和西多米尼加共和国从 4 月 21 日到 4 月 27 日的降雨量和降雨强度，其中红色代表最大值，蓝色代表平均值。对于以毫米为单位的降雨累积量，随着时间的推移，最大总降雨量不断增加，从大约 0 毫米到 400 毫米，而平均值从 0 毫米开始，到 100 毫米结束。对于以毫米/小时为单位测量的降雨强度，最大值波动约为每小时 30 毫米，最小值为每小时 0 毫米，而平均值在整个时间内保持相对稳定，为每小时 0 毫米。总之，该图提供了有关降雨量的重要信息。

answer: This graph is about genset diesel monitoring of ﬁve diﬀerent generators, recording the fuel consumption measured in liter and number of operation hours. For quantity consumed represented in blue bars, generator B has the highest consumption at about 210 liters, and generator A has the lowest consumption at about 124 liters. Generator E has a similar consumption as A at about 126 liters. For operation hours represented in a red line, generator E has the longest operation hours at 97 hours while generator D has the shortest operation hours at about 68 hours. In conclusion, this graph gives crucial information about diesel monitoring.
answer_zh: 该图是关于五台不同发电机的发电机组柴油监测，记录以升为单位测量的燃油消耗量和运行小时数。对于蓝色条表示的消耗量，发电机 B 的消耗量最高，约为 210 升，发电机 A 的消耗量最低，约为 124 升。发电机 E 的消耗量与 A 类似，约为 126 升。对于红线所示的运行时间，E 发电机的运行时间最长，为 97 小时，而 D 发电机的运行时间最短，约为 68 小时。总之，该图提供了有关柴油监测的重要信息。

answer: This line graph is about global water use by diﬀerent sectors including agriculture, industrial use and domestic use, measured in km3 from 1900 to 2000. Agriculture, which is represented in black, starts at about 500km3 in 1900 and keeps increasing to a maximum of about 3000 km3 in 2000. Industrial use, which is represented in red, starts at about 100km3 in 1900 and keeps increasing to a maximum of about 1000 km3 in 2000. Domestic use, which is represented in black, starts at about 100km3 in 1900 and keeps increasing to a maximum of about 300 km3 in 2000. In conclusion, this graph gives crucial information about global water use.
answer_zh: 该折线图显示了 1900 年至 2000 年期间不同部门的全球用水量，包括农业、工业用水和家庭用水，以平方公里为单位。农业用水量以黑色表示，1900 年开始约为 500 平方公里，并不断增加到 2000 年的最大约 3000 平方公里。工业用水量以红色表示，1900 年开始约为 100 平方公里，并不断增加到最大约 3000 平方公里。 2000 年为 1000 平方公里。家庭用水量（以黑色表示）从 1900 年开始约为 100 平方公里，并不断增加，到 2000 年达到最大约 300 平方公里。总而言之，该图提供了有关全球用水的重要信息。

answer: This image shows the information about thickness of the ice, measured in meters, for the period 1958-1976 and the period 1993-1997 in all regions together. In 1958-1976, the thickness of the ice is about 3m while in 1993 to 1997, the thickness of the ice decreases to about 2.7m, volume down by 40%. The image shows that arctic sea ice volume has decreased by 40% as compared with volumes three to four decades ago. Polar bears will suﬀer from the consequences. In conclusion, this image contains crucial information about ice volume.
answer_zh: 该图像显示了 1958-1976 年期间和 1993-1997 年期间所有地区的冰厚度信息（以米为单位）。 1958-1976年，冰厚约为3m，而1993-1997年，冰厚减至2.7m左右，体积减少了40%。图像显示，与三、四十年前相比，北极海冰体积减少了 40%。北极熊将承受后果。总之，该图像包含有关冰体积的重要信息。

answer: This image shows the information about the world’s water distribution. It can be seen that 97.5% of the world’s water is salt water and only 2.5% is freshwater. In the freshwater sector, glaciers and permanent snow occupies the largest proportion at 68.7%, followed by which groundwater occupies 30.06% of the fresh water. Ground ice and permafrost takes 0.86% of fresh water and other resources take 1.22% of fresh water. In the other sector, lakes occupy the majority of the proportion at 0.26%. in conclusion, this image gives very thorough information about the world’s water distribution.
answer_zh: 该图显示了有关世界水资源分布的信息。可见，世界上97.5%的水是咸水，只有2.5%是淡水。在淡水领域，冰川和永久积雪所占比例最大，为68.7%，其次是地下水，占淡水的30.06%。地冰和永久冻土占淡水的0.86%，其他资源占淡水的1.22%。在其他部门中，湖泊所占比例最大，为0.26%。总之，这张图像提供了有关世界水资源分布的非常全面的信息。

answer: This ﬂow diagram shows the information about how parasites can get into and aﬀect human bodies via female mosquito. Firstly, parasites are attached with female mosquito, which is able to transfer the parasites into the human body. The main organ that can be aﬀected by parasites is the liver, therefore, when parasites reach the liver, many consequences will be resulted. For example, human may experience sweating, muscle stiﬀness, fever and shaking. In conclusion, this ﬂow diagram gives a detailed process in which parasites can be transferred into human bodies and result in diseases via mosquito.
answer_zh: 该流程图显示了有关寄生虫如何通过雌性蚊子进入并影响人体的信息。首先，寄生虫附着在雌性蚊子身上，雌性蚊子能够将寄生虫转移到人体中。寄生虫感染的主要器官是肝脏，因此，当寄生虫到达肝脏时，会产生很多后果。例如，人类可能会出现出汗、肌肉僵硬、发烧和发抖的情况。总之，该流程图给出了寄生虫进入人体并通过蚊子导致疾病的详细过程。

answer: This pie chart shows the overall job satisfaction. Somewhat satisﬁed and very satisﬁed are represented in blue and green respectively, and they share the same proportions at 47%. They occupy majority of the population. Followed by these two categories, some what dissatisfaction, which is represented in purple, and indiﬀerent, which is represented in red, share the same proportion at 6%. Very dissatisﬁed shares the least proportion at 2%, and it represented yellow. It is clear that most of the population are satisﬁed with their jobs to some extent. In conclusion, this pie chart gives very thorough information about job satisfaction.
answer_zh: 该饼图显示了总体工作满意度。比较满意和非常满意分别用蓝色和绿色表示，比例相同，均为 47%。他们占据了人口的大多数。其次是这两个类别，紫色代表的有些不满意，红色代表的漠不关心，比例相同，均为6%。非常不满意的比例最低，为2%，代表黄色。显然，大多数人在某种程度上对自己的工作感到满意。总之，这个饼图提供了有关工作满意度的非常全面的信息。

title_zh: 苹果播放器中的付费音乐
answer: This line graph contains the information about songs purchased on iTunes, depending on week number from week 0 to week 150, measured in million songs. The song purchased in week 0 is 1 million and at ﬁrst, the increase is gradual, and the number of songs achieves about 100 million in week 60. After that, the increase becomes much more rapid and the number quickly doubles and reaches 200 in week 80. Over the last 30 weeks from week 120 to week 150, the number of songs rapidly increases from 500 million to 1000 million. In conclusion, this graph gives very thorough information about iTunes purchased songs.
answer_zh: 此折线图包含有关在 iTunes 上购买的歌曲的信息，具体取决于第 0 周到第 150 周的周数（以百万首歌曲为单位）。第0周购买的歌曲为100万首，起初增长缓慢，第60周歌曲数量达到1亿左右。之后增长速度更快，数量迅速翻倍，在第80周达到200首。从第120周到第150周的最后30周，歌曲数量从5亿迅速增加到10亿。总之，该图提供了有关 iTunes 购买的歌曲的非常全面的信息。

answer: This bar chart contains the information about number of postsecondary institutions in diﬀerent areas including Arizona, Colorado, New Mexico and Utah, categorized by private and public. Public institutions are represented in blue and private ones are represented in yellow. In Arizona, there are 27 public institutions while there are 16 private ones. In Colorado, the number of public institutions is 29 and the number of private ones is 12. In New Mexico, there are 27 public institutions and 9 private ones. In Utah, there are 10 public institutions and 4 private ones. In conclusion, this image shows very thorough information.
answer_zh: 该条形图包含不同地区（包括亚利桑那州、科罗拉多州、新墨西哥州和犹他州）的高等教育机构数量信息，按私立和公立分类。公共机构用蓝色表示，私人机构用黄色表示。亚利桑那州有 27 所公立机构，16 所私立机构。在科罗拉多州，公立机构数量为29个，私立机构数量为12个。在新墨西哥州，有27个公立机构和9个私立机构。犹他州有 10 个公立机构和 4 个私立机构。总之，这张图片显示了非常详尽的信息。

answer: This map gives the information about the population density in Australia, measured in people per square kilometer and categorized by 100 people or more, 10 to 100 people and less than 0.1 people. It is clear that majority of the Australia has a population density of less than 0.1 people per sq km, which is represented in very light orange. You can ﬁnd these areas in the middle of Australia. On the west edge of Australia, the population density is about 0.1 to 1.0 people per sq km. On the east coast of Australia, the population is a little bit denser, about 10 to 100 people per sq km, represented in orange. In conclusion, this map shows very signiﬁcant information about population density in Australia.
answer_zh: 该地图提供了澳大利亚的人口密度信息，以每平方公里人口为单位，并按 100 人或以上、10 至 100 人以及 0.1 人以下进行分类。很明显，澳大利亚大部分地区的人口密度低于每平方公里 0.1 人，以非常浅的橙色表示。您可以在澳大利亚中部找到这些地区。澳大利亚西部边缘的人口密度约为每平方公里0.1至1.0人。澳大利亚东海岸的人口密度稍大一些，每平方公里大约有10到100人，用橙色表示。总之，这张地图显示了有关澳大利亚人口密度的非常重要的信息。

answer: This bar chart gives the information about beneﬁt recipient in 2004 by health area in Sydney including Sydney South West and South Eastern Sydney & Illawara, measured in per cent of eligible population, categorized by age pension represented in blue and disability pension represented in green. In Sydney South West, the percentage of population receiving age pension is 73.3% while that receiving disability pension is 7%. In South Eastern Sydney and Illawara, the percentage of population receiving age pension is 64.9% while that receiving disability pension is 6.2%. In conclusion, this image shows very signiﬁcant information about beneﬁt recipient in Sydney.
answer_zh: 该条形图提供了 2004 年悉尼各卫生区（包括悉尼西南区、悉尼东南部和伊拉瓦拉）的福利领取者信息，以符合资格人口的百分比衡量，按蓝色代表的老年养老金和绿色代表的残疾养老金分类。在悉尼西南区，领取老年养老金的人口比例为73.3%，领取残疾养老金的人口比例为7%。在悉尼东南部和伊拉瓦拉，领取老年养老金的人口比例为 64.9%，领取残疾养老金的人口比例为 6.2%。总之，这张图片显示了有关悉尼受益人的非常重要的信息。

answer: This map shows a few countries in the South America. We can see Brazil, which is represented in yellow, on the east side of the map, and Brazil occupies the largest area on the map. There are three other countries on the west of Brazil shown on the map. One is Peru which is represented in green, and one is Paraguay which is represented in pink. Bolivia is also shown, in orange colour and occupies the second largest area on the map. The capital of Bolivia is La Paz which is located on the west coast of Bolivia. On the southwest side of the map we can see the ocean. In conclusion, this image gives us an illustration of a couple of countries in the South America.
answer_zh: 这张地图显示了南美洲的一些国家。我们可以在地图的东侧看到黄色代表的巴西，巴西在地图上占据的面积最大。地图上还显示了巴西西部的其他三个国家。一个是秘鲁，用绿色表示，一个是巴拉圭，用粉色表示。玻利维亚也以橙色显示，占据地图上第二大面积。玻利维亚的首都是拉巴斯，位于玻利维亚西海岸。在地图的西南侧我们可以看到海洋。总之，这张图片向我们展示了南美洲的几个国家。

Grouped data and stacked data are also shown. The x-axis shows independent variables from 0 to 69, while the y-axis shows independent variables from 0 to 9.5. It is clear that for stream 0, the peaks occur at about 20 and about
answer_zh: 该图显示了一种多条形图。显示了三个流，包括以蓝色表示的流 0、以灰色表示的流 1 和以橙色表示的流 2。还显示分组数据和堆叠数据。 x 轴显示从 0 到 69 的自变量，而 y 轴显示从 0 到 9.5 的自变量。很明显，对于流 0，峰值出现在大约 20 和大约

title_en: For Stream 1, the peaks occur at about 20 and 30. For Stream 2, the peaks occur at about 10 and 70. In conclusion, this graph gives very interesting information.

answer: This bar chart shows the information about amount of assistance measured in million dollars from 2002 to 2010, categorized by reimbursement and assistance. For assistance, which is represented in dark blue, the largest number is in 2010 at about 2,500 million dollars, and the minimum number is in 2004 at about 500 million dollars. In contrast, for reimbursements, which is represented in light blue, the maximum number is in 2010 at about 2000 million dollars while the minimum number is in 2009 at 500 million dollars. In conclusion, this graph gives very interesting information about amount of assistance.
answer_zh: 该条形图显示了 2002 年至 2010 年以百万美元为单位的援助金额信息，按报销和援助分类。深蓝色代表的援助金额最多的是2010年，约为25亿美元，最少的是2004年，约为5亿美元。相比之下，以浅蓝色表示的报销金额，2010 年的最高金额约为 20 亿美元，而 2009 年的最低金额为 5 亿美元。总之，该图提供了有关援助量的非常有趣的信息。

answer: This bar chart indicates the expected city visits by country of origin, including Mexico, Canada and the USA in 2018, measured in thousand visits per year. The cities visited include London represented in blue, Paris represented in red, Madrid represented in yellow and Istanbul represented in green. For visits from Mexico, Madrid is the most common destination at about 65 thousand visits per year, and Istanbul and London are the least common ones at 20 thousand visits per year. In contrast, for visits from the USA, Paris is the most common place to go at 100 thousand visits per year and Istanbul is the least common one at 60 thousand visits per year. In conclusion, this graph contains very interesting information.
answer_zh: 此条形图显示了 2018 年按原籍国（包括墨西哥、加拿大和美国）划分的预期城市访问量（以每年千次访问为单位）。访问的城市包括以蓝色表示的伦敦、以红色表示的巴黎、以黄色表示的马德里和以绿色表示的伊斯坦布尔。对于来自墨西哥的游客来说，马德里是最常见的目的地，每年约有 6.5 万人次访问，伊斯坦布尔和伦敦是最不常见的目的地，每年有 2 万人次访问。相比之下，对于来自美国的游客来说，巴黎是最常见的旅游目的地，每年接待 10 万人次，伊斯坦布尔是最不常见的目的地，每年接待 6 万人次。总之，这张图包含非常有趣的信息。

answer: This map indicates the locations of the cities in the island of Bali as well as its neighbouring countries and oceans. In the middle of the map, we can see the map of Bali, and the capital city is called Denpasar, located at the north of Bali. Other cities in Bali include Bangli, Padangbai and Mendaya and a lot more. There is a small neighbouring island called Nusa Penida to the southeast of Bali. To the west of Bali, Java is located. Between Bali and Nusa Penida, the Badung Strait in Indian Ocean can be found, and between Bali and Java, Bali Strait in Bali sea can be found. In conclusion, this map gives an illustration of the locations of Bali and some neighbouring countries.
answer_zh: 该地图指示了巴厘岛及其邻国和海洋的城市位置。在地图的中间，我们可以看到巴厘岛的地图，首都叫登巴萨，位于巴厘岛的北部。巴厘岛的其他城市包括邦利 (Bangli)、八丹拜 (Padangbai) 和门达亚 (Mendaya) 等。巴厘岛东南部有一个邻近的小岛，称为努沙佩尼达岛。爪哇岛位于巴厘岛以西。巴厘岛和珀尼达岛之间有印度洋的巴东海峡，巴厘岛和爪哇岛之间有巴里海的巴里海峡。总之，这张地图说明了巴厘岛和一些邻国的位置。

answer: This graph indicates the relationship between rain fall, measured in mm, and temperature, measured in Celsius, from January to December. The rainfall is represented in blue bars and it starts at 50mm in January, reaching the maximum of about 300mm in June. It concludes at about 25 mm in December. The temperature, no matter the average maximum daily temperature represented in black or the average minimum daily temperature represented in yellow, remains stable throughout the year, and the minimum and maximum are almost the same. In conclusion,this graph shows very thorough information about rainfall and temperature.
answer_zh: 该图显示了从 1 月到 12 月的降雨量（以毫米为单位）与气温（以摄氏度为单位）之间的关系。降雨量以蓝色条表示，一月开始降雨量为 50 毫米，六月达到最大值约 300 毫米。 12 月结束时厚度约为 25 毫米。无论是黑色代表的日平均最高气温，还是黄色代表的日平均最低气温，全年气温都保持稳定，最低和最高气温几乎相同。总之，该图显示了有关降雨量和温度的非常全面的信息。

answer: This ﬂow diagram indicates the process of anaerobic digestion. Firstly, waste feed material is fed to the digester after storage and any pre-treatment taking place initially. The biogas is produced from the digester and sent to the biogas storage vessel. The biogas can be used as fuel so it is sent to vehicle for transport use, turbine or generator to combine heat and power, and gas burner or boiler to process heat for digester and space heating. The rest of materials from the disgester is sent to a separator such as a presser to produce liquid which can be sent to liquor storage or ﬁbre to land or maturation. In conclusion, this graph illustrates a anaerobic digestion process.
answer_zh: 该流程图显示了厌氧消化的过程。首先，废物原料在储存和最初进行的任何预处理后被送入消化器。沼气由消化池产生并输送至沼气储存容器。沼气可用作燃料，因此可被输送至运输车辆、涡轮机或发电机以将热能和电力结合起来，以及燃气燃烧器或锅炉以处理用于消化器和空间供暖的热量。来自消化器的其余材料被发送到分离器（例如压榨机）以产生液体，该液体可以被发送到液体存储或纤维以着陆或熟化。总之，该图说明了厌氧消化过程。

answer: This bar chart illustrates the transport modes including bus, car, bike and foot in 1960, 1980 and 2000, measured in percentage of total travellers. In 1960, which is represented in blue, the most common transport mode is foot at about 35%, while the least common is car at about 5%. In contrast, in 2000, which is represented in yellow, car occupies the largest proportion at about 40%, while bike occupies the least proportion at about 5%. in 1980 represented in red, the most common mode is bus at about 25%, and the four modes are quite similar. In conclusion, this graph shows signiﬁcant information.
answer_zh: 该条形图显示了 1960 年、1980 年和 2000 年的交通方式，包括公共汽车、汽车、自行车和步行，以占旅客总数的百分比来衡量。 1960年（以蓝色表示），最常见的交通方式是步行，约占35%，而最不常见的是汽车，约占5%。相比之下，2000年（以黄色表示），汽车所占比例最大，约为40%，而自行车所占比例最小，约为5%。红色代表的1980年，最常见的交通方式是公交车，约占25%，四种交通方式非常相似。总之，这张图显示了重要的信息。

answer: This image illustrates how house ﬂies work, that is, the life cycle of a ﬂy. It starts with eggs which are laid by an adult ﬂy, and then the eggs become 1st larva stage. In this stage, the larva is relatively small. Then the cycle goes to the 2nd larval stage where the larva grows larger but the colour remains relatively constant. When it comes to the 3rd larva stage, the larva becomes much larger and the colour starts to become darker. After that, the cycle reaches the pupa stage where the larva is covered with dark skin. The pupa becomes an adult ﬂy eventually which can lay eggs again and let the process continues. In conclusion, this image gives a vivid illustration of a life cycle of a ﬂy.
answer_zh: 这张图片说明了家蝇的工作原理，即苍蝇的生命周期。它从成年苍蝇产下的卵开始，然后卵变成第一幼虫阶段。在这个阶段，幼虫相对较小。然后循环进入第二幼虫阶段，幼虫长大但颜色保持相对恒定。到了第3幼虫阶段，幼虫变得更大，颜色开始变深。之后，循环进入蛹阶段，幼虫被深色皮肤覆盖。蛹最终变成成年果蝇，可以再次产卵并让这个过程继续下去。总之，这张图片生动地展示了苍蝇的生命周期。

answer: This graph illustrates the relationship between precipitation and average temperature from January to December. The average temperature is represented in a red line and measured in degree Celsius. It starts and concludes at minimum of 0oC in January and December, and the maximum occurs in July at about 25oC. Precipitation is presented in blue bars and measured in mm. It remains relatively constant throughout the year. A minimum occurs in June and October at about 80 mm and a maximum occurs in May at 120 mm. In conclusion, this graph contains much logical information and comparisons.
answer_zh: 该图说明了 1 月至 12 月降水量与平均气温之间的关系。平均温度用红线表示，以摄氏度为单位。 1 月和 12 月开始和结束温度最低为 0°C，最高温度出现在 7 月，约为 25°C。降水量以蓝色条表示，并以毫米为单位测量。全年保持相对稳定。最小值出现在 6 月和 10 月，约为 80 毫米，最大值出现在 5 月，约为 120 毫米。总之，这张图包含了很多逻辑信息和比较。

answer: This bar chart shows the information about poverty rates by age and by gender in 2012, measured in percentage. In the age group of 65 and older, poverty rate of female is 11% while that of male is 6.6%. In the age group of 18 to 64, the poverty rate of female is 15.4% and that of male is 11.9%. In the age group under 18, the poverty rate is much higher than other groups, with female 22.3% and male 21.3%. This graph is sourced from the US Census Bureau, current population Survey, 2013 Annual Social and Economic Supplement. In conclusion, this graph gives very thorough information.
answer_zh: 此条形图显示了 2012 年按年龄和性别划分的贫困率信息（以百分比衡量）。在65岁及以上年龄组中，女性贫困率为11%，男性贫困率为6.6%。在18至64岁年龄组中，女性贫困率为15.4%，男性贫困率为11.9%。在18岁以下年龄组中，贫困率远高于其他群体，其中女性为22.3%，男性为2​​1.3%。该图表来源于美国人口普查局、当前人口调查、2013 年度社会和经济增刊。总之，该图提供了非常详尽的信息。

answer: This pie chart shows the information about the percentage of hotel revenues by class, categorized by luxury which has 23 hotels and about 11,000 rooms, upper upscale which has 80 hotels and about 46,000 rooms and other which has 11 hotels and about 3,000 rooms. It is clear from the chart that upper upscale class occupies the largest proportion at 75% and represented in red, followed by which luxury occupies 22% of the total number and is represented in blue. Other, which is represented in green, occupies 3% of the total number. In conclusion, this pie chart contains much logical information.
answer_zh: 该饼图显示了按等级划分的酒店收入百分比信息，按豪华型分类，拥有 23 家酒店，约 11,000 间客房；高级酒店，拥有 80 家酒店，约 46,000 间客房；其他分类，拥有 11 家酒店，约 3,000 间客房。从图表中可以明显看出，高端阶层所占比例最大，为 75%，以红色表示；其次是奢侈品，占总数的 22%，以蓝色表示。其他以绿色表示，占总数的3%。总之，这个饼图包含了很多逻辑信息。

answer: This bar chart indicates the Joe’s fruit stand sales of diﬀerent types of fruits measured in average sales per day, and the percentage is also shown on the graph. It is clear from the graph that oranges represented in orange has the highest sales at 37.8% and about 550 sales per day. Followed by oranges, bananas in yellow and grapes in purple occupy 19.3% and 25.9% of the sales respectively. Limes represented in green has an average sales of 140 sales per day and apple represented in red occupies the least proportion of the sales at 7.5%. In conclusion, this graph illustrates very important information.
answer_zh: 该条形图显示了 Joe’s 水果摊上不同类型水果的平均每日销售额，百分比也显示在图表中。从图中可以明显看出，以橙色为代表的橙子销量最高，达到37.8%，每天销量约550个。其次是橙子，黄色香蕉和紫色葡萄分别占据销售额的19.3%和25.9%。绿色代表的青柠平均每天销售140个，红色代表的苹果所占销售比例最小，为7.5%。总之，该图说明了非常重要的信息。

answer: This image illustrates the life cycle of a frog. It has six stages in total and it is a continuous process. It starts with egg mass which is produced by an adult frog. The eggs become small tadpoles. Later, legs are grown, and the tadpoles become tadpoles with legs. The size has become a little bit bigger. After that, tadpoles come into the young frog stage where the frog has four legs but with a small, short tail. After the tail falls oﬀ , the frog becomes an adult frog eventually. The size becomes much bigger. The adult frogs can lay eggs so that the process can be continued. In conclusion, this image gives a vivid illustration of a life cycle of a frog.
answer_zh: 这张图片展示了青蛙的生命周期。它总共有六个阶段，并且是一个连续的过程。它始于成年青蛙产生的卵块。卵变成小蝌蚪。后来长出了腿，蝌蚪就变成了有腿的蝌蚪。尺寸变大了一些。之后，蝌蚪进入幼蛙阶段，青蛙有四条腿，但尾巴又小又短。尾巴脱落后，青蛙最终成为成年青蛙。尺寸变得更大。成年青蛙可以产卵，这样这个过程就可以继续下去。总之，这张图片生动地展示了青蛙的生命周期。

answer: This graph shows the information about PDO index, the sum of May to September, from 1930 to 2010. From 1930 to 1940, it is the warm regime, and the PDO index is mostly positive which is shown in red. Over the time period of 1950 to 1970, the cool regime is reached where the PDO index is mostly negative which is represented in blue. Then from 1980 to 1990, it is warm regime again. The largest index can reach about 13 in 1940 and the lowest index can achieve -10 in 1950. It is clear that the warm regime and cool regime are altered throughout the time. In conclusion, this graph gives very interesting information.
answer_zh: 该图显示了PDO指数的信息，即1930年至2010年5月至9月的总和。1930年至1940年为温暖时期，PDO指数大多为正值，以红色显示。在 1950 年至 1970 年期间，达到了凉爽状态，其中 PDO 指数大部分为负值，以蓝色表示。然后从1980年到1990年，又是一个温暖的政权。最大的指数在1940年可以达到13左右，最低的指数可以在1950年达到-10。很明显，暖区和冷区在整个时间里都在变化。总之，这张图提供了非常有趣的信息。

answer: This image shows the information about number of students who worked at ages 14 to 18. The number of students who worked is represented in blue and that of students who did not work is represented in red. Students who are 14 have the highest number of did not work, at about 25 students, while students who are 18 has the least number of did not work, at about 3 students. In contrast, there are 23 students who are 18 and worked, and there are about 1 student who is 14 and worked. In conclusion, this graph gives very thorough information.
answer_zh: 该图显示了 14 至 18 岁期间工作的学生人数信息。工作的学生人数以蓝色表示，未工作的学生人数以红色表示。 14 岁的学生中未工作的人数最多，约为 25 名学生，而 18 岁的学生中未工作的人数最少，约为 3 名学生。相比之下，有 23 名 18 岁并工作的学生，大约有 1 名 14 岁并工作的学生。总之，该图提供了非常详尽的信息。

answer: This bar chart shows the information about unemployment rates by ethnic groups, including white, mixed and Indian, and by sex in UK in 2001. Men is represented in light blue and Women is represented in dark blue. For men, the highest unemployment rate is within Bangladeshi at about 23%, and the lowest unemployment rate is within white at 5%. In contrast, for women, the highest unemployment rate is also within Bangladeshi at 20% while the lowest unemployment rate comes from white at 4%. In conclusion, this graph gives very thorough information.
answer_zh: 此条形图显示了 2001 年英国按种族（包括白人、混血儿和印度人）以及性别划分的失业率信息。男性以浅蓝色表示，女性以深蓝色表示。对于男性来说，孟加拉国失业率最高，约为 23%，白人失业率最低，为 5%。相比之下，对于女性来说，失业率最高的也是孟加拉国人，为 20%，而失业率最低的是白人，为 4%。总之，该图提供了非常详尽的信息。

answer: This pie chart illustrates the information about US homelessness by race or ethnicity, including Hispanic, Native American, Black Non-Hispanic, White Non-Hispanic and Other. We can see from the graph that White Non-Hispanic which is represented in red occupies 40.6% of the total population, followed by which Black Non-Hispanic represented in green occupies 39.6%. Native American represented in blue and Hispanic represented in yellow occupy 7.9% and 10.9% respectively. Other represented in light blue occupies the least proportion at 1%. In conclusion, this graph provides a lot of information.
answer_zh: 此饼图按种族或民族显示了有关美国无家可归者的信息，包括西班牙裔、美洲原住民、非西班牙裔黑人、非西班牙裔白人和其他。从图中我们可以看到，红色代表的非西班牙裔白人占总人口的40.6%，其次是绿色代表的非西班牙裔黑人占39.6%。蓝色代表的美洲原住民和黄色代表的西班牙裔分别占7.9%和10.9%。其他以浅蓝色为代表的比例最少，为1%。总之，这张图提供了很多信息。

answer: This line graph illustrates the information about temperature measured in degree Celsius throughout the week, from Sunday to Saturday. It is represented in yellow line. It starts at 25oC on Sunday and increases to a maximum throughout the week of 28oC on Monday, followed by a decrease to 26oC on Tuesday. The temperature keeps decreasing to 22oC on Wednesday and reaches a minimum of 19oC on Thursday. The temperature starts to increase again to 23oC on Friday and concludes at 27oC on Saturday. In conclusion, this line graphs gives very detailed information about the temperature change over the week.
answer_zh: 该线图显示了从周日到周六一周内以摄氏度为单位测量的温度信息。它用黄线表示。周日气温为 25 摄氏度，周一全周最高气温为 28 摄氏度，随后周二降至 26 摄氏度。周三气温持续下降至22℃，周四最低可达19℃。周五气温再次上升至 23 摄氏度，周六最终达到 27 摄氏度。总之，该线图提供了有关一周内温度变化的非常详细的信息。

answer: This map illustrates the countries by GDP per capita in 2014 in the world, measured in dollars. The largest area is $20,000 to $35,000 which is represented in dark green and you can ﬁnd it in most of the northern parts of Asia. The second largest area is $2000 to $5000 which is represented in yellow, and you can ﬁnd it in most parts of Africa as well as some central parts of Asia. $5,000 to $10,000 is represented in light green and you can ﬁnd this colour in China and most parts of South America. Most parts of North America and Australia lie in the category of $25,000 which are represented in dark colours. In conclusion, this map gives very detailed information of GDP.
answer_zh: 该地图显示了 2014 年世界各国人均 GDP（以美元计算）。最大的区域为 20,000 美元至 35,000 美元，以深绿色表示，您可以在亚洲北部的大部分地区找到它。第二大区域是2000至5000美元，以黄色表示，您可以在非洲大部分地区以及亚洲中部的一些地区找到它。 5,000 美元至 10,000 美元以浅绿色表示，您可以在中国和南美大部分地区找到这种颜色。北美和澳大利亚的大部分地区都在 25,000 美元的范围内，以深色表示。总之，这张地图给出了非常详细的GDP信息。

answer: This line graph illustrates the information about Jill’s secondary math scores, depending on grade level from Grade 7 to Grade 12, and shown in percentage. The information is shown in a green line. It starts at 72% in Grade 7, and gradually increases to 75% and 81% in Grade 8 and Grade 9. A slight decrease occurs and in Grade 10, the math score reaches 80%. Then the increase continues and 83% is achieved in Grade 11, concluding at 91% in Grade 12. In conclusion, this graph gives very interesting information about Jill’s secondary math scores.
answer_zh: 此折线图显示了有关 Jill 中学数学成绩的信息，具体取决于从 7 年级到 12 年级的年级，并以百分比显示。该信息以绿线显示。从七年级开始为72%，逐渐提高到八年级和九年级的75%和81%。略有下降，到了十年级，数学成绩达到了80%。然后继续增加，11 年级达到 83%，12 年级达到 91%。总而言之，该图提供了有关吉尔中学数学成绩的非常有趣的信息。

answer: This graph illustrates the temperature and precipitation at Vancouver International Airport over the year from January to December. The temperature is represented in a red line and measured in degree Celsius. It starts and concludes at a minimum of about 2oC in January and December, and a maximum is reached in June and July at about 17oC. The precipitation is represented in blue bars and measured in mm. The maximum occurs in November at 190mm, and the minimum occurs in July at 40mm. In conclusion, this graph gives very interesting relationship between temperature and precipitation.
answer_zh: 该图显示了温哥华国际机场 1 月至 12 月全年的气温和降水量。温度用红线表示并以摄氏度为单位测量。 1 月和 12 月开始和结束温度最低约为 2°C，6 月和 7 月达到最高温度约 17°C。降水量以蓝色条表示并以毫米为单位测量。最大值出现在 11 月，为 190 毫米，最小值出现在 7 月，为 40 毫米。总之，这张图给出了温度和降水之间非常有趣的关系。

answer: This pie chart illustrates the information about the percentage of diﬀerent injury locations, including home, work, roads, school or childcare, leisure or sports and other. It is clear from the chart that home is the most common place to get injured, which is represented in green, at 41.4%, followed by which roads in blue and leisure or sports in black occupy 17.1% and 15.2% respectively. School or childcare occupies 4.8% of the total population while other in light blue occupies the least proportion at about 2%. In conclusion, this bar chart gives very detailed information about injury locations.
answer_zh: 该饼图说明了不同伤害地点的百分比信息，包括家庭、工作、道路、学校或托儿所、休闲或运动等。从图表中可以明显看出，家中是最容易受伤的地方，绿色部分占41.4%，其次是蓝色道路和黑色休闲或运动道路，分别占17.1%和15.2%。学校或托儿所占总人口的4.8%，而其他浅蓝色的人口所占比例最少，约为2%。总之，此条形图提供了有关受伤位置的非常详细的信息。

answer: This line graph illustrates the information about the manufacturing output in the UK from 1999 to 2007, recorded in percentage. It starts at 100% in 1999, and increases to a maximum of 105% in 2001. After that, a rapid decrease occurs and a minimum of 95% is reached in the year 2003. Later the output starts to slowly come back up and gradually achieves a small peak in 2005 at about 102%. over the last two years from 2005 to 2007, the output keeps ﬂuctuating and concludes at about 103% in 2007. In conclusion, this graph gives very detailed information about manufacturing output in the UK.
answer_zh: 该折线图显示了 1999 年至 2007 年英国制造业产出的信息（以百分比记录）。 1999年开始为100%，2001年最高达到105%，之后迅速下降，2003年最低达到95%，之后产量开始缓慢回升，2005年逐渐达到102%左右的小峰值。从 2005 年到 2007 年的过去两年，产出持续波动，2007 年约为 103%。 总之，该图提供了有关英国制造业产出的非常详细的信息。

answer: This graph is about population growth and projected population of Sydney from 1976 to
answer_zh: 该图显示了 1976 年至 1976 年悉尼的人口增长和预测人口

title_en: The data of the year of 1976 and the year of 2001 comes from census data while the
extra_text: data of the year of 2031 is projected. In 1976, the population is about 3 million and increases to about 4 million in 2001. Based on these data, the population in 2031 can be predicted to be about 5.3 million. It is clear that the population of Sydney has been steadily increasing. In conclusion, this line graph shows some very interesting information about the population

answer: This image illustrates three symbolic buildings in diﬀerent areas of the world. All of the three are very high so they have become the landmarks of the cities they are located in. The ﬁrst one is Taipei 101 which is located in Taipei and the height of the building is 1,670 ft. The second one is the Petronas Towers 1 & 2, located in Kuala Lumpur, and the height is a little bit lower than Taipei 101 at 1,483 ft. The last building shown is the Sears Tower located in Chicago, and the height is 1,450 feet. All of the buildings have their own features in terms of the design. In conclusion, this image illustrates a vivid comparison of three symbolic buildings.
answer_zh: 该图展示了世界不同地区的三座象征性建筑。这三座大楼都很高，因此成为了所在城市的地标。第一个是位于台北的台北 101，建筑物高度为 1,670 英尺。第二个是位于吉隆坡的双子塔 1 和 2，高度比台北 101 稍低，为 1,483 英尺。最后一个是位于芝加哥的西尔斯大厦，高度为1,450 英尺。所有的建筑在设计上都有自己的特色。总之，这张图片生动地对比了三座标志性建筑。

answer: This graph is about males in the labour market from 2005 to 2006, and trends in economic inactivity, measured in percentage, from 1911 to 2001. From the bar chart, we can see that 68% of males are employed and 4% of males are unemployed. There are 28% of males not in the labour force, indicating that many men are outside the labour force. Based on the line graph, the economic inactivity of males keeps increasing from about 10% to about 25% throughout the time, while the economic inactivity of females has been decreasing. In conclusion, this graph gives a detailed analysis of men in the labour force.
answer_zh: 该图显示了 2005 年至 2006 年劳动力市场中的男性，以及 1911 年至 2001 年经济不活跃的趋势（以百分比衡量）。从条形图中，我们可以看到 68% 的男性就业，4% 的男性失业。有28%的男性不属于劳动力队伍，这表明许多男性处于劳动力队伍之外。根据折线图，男性的经济不活跃度一直从约 10% 增加到约 25%，而女性的经济不活跃度一直在下降。总之，该图对劳动力中的男性进行了详细分析。

answer: This graph is about the income distribution of China and the USA in 1970 and 2000. China is represented in red and the USA is represented in green. In 1970, most people in China have an income of $1000 per year, while most people in America have an income of about $20,000 per year. The income distribution in America is more even distributed, and the population of China is much more larger. In 2000, in contrast, most people in China have an income of $5000 per year and the income distribution has become much more even. The income of American people increases as well to about $50,000. In conclusion, this graph gives very detailed information.
answer_zh: 这张图是1970年和2000年中国和美国的收入分配情况。中国用红色表示，美国用绿色表示。 1970年，大多数中国人的年收入为1000美元，而大多数美国人的年收入约为2万美元。美国的收入分配更加均匀，而中国的人口数量要多得多。相比之下，2000年中国大多数人的年收入为5000美元，收入分配更加均匀。美国人的收入也增加到5万美元左右。总之，该图提供了非常详细的信息。

answer: This image illustrates the life cycle of the silkworm. There are ﬁve stages in total and it is a continuous process. It starts with eggs which can be laid by adult moths. After 10 days, the eggs become silkworm larva, and its main diet is mulberry leaf. After 4-6 weeks, the larva comes into the thread stage, in which silk thread starts to cover the larva. After 3-8 weeks, the silk thread becomes a cocoon which means the larva is totally covered with silk thread. In 16 days, the cocoon is broken and a moth comes out, which can lay eggs and make the process continue. In conclusion, this image shows a vivid illustration of the life cycle of the silkworm.
answer_zh: 这张图片展示了蚕的生命周期。总共有五个阶段，并且是一个连续的过程。它从可以由成年蛾产下的卵开始。 10天后，卵变成蚕幼虫，主要食物是桑叶。 4-6周后，幼虫进入丝期，丝线开始覆盖幼虫。 3-8周后，丝线变成茧，这意味着幼虫完全被丝线覆盖。 16天后，茧破，飞蛾出来，产卵，使这个过程继续进行。总之，这张图片生动地展示了蚕的生命周期。

title_zh: 安大略制造业就业情况
answer: This line graph gives the information about Ontario manufacturing employment and the Canadian dollar exchange from 1981 to 2013. Ontario manufacturing employment is represented in blue. It starts at about 1000 in 1981 and concludes at a minimum of about 800 in 2013. A maximum of 1100 is reached in 2001. The Canadian dollar exchange rate is represented in red and measured in Canadian dollar value in US dollars. A minimum occurs in 2001 at 0.65 and a maximum occurs in 2009 at 1.00. In conclusion, this graph shows a very interesting trend.
answer_zh: 此折线图提供了 1981 年至 2013 年有关安大略省制造业就业情况和加元汇率的信息。安大略省制造业就业情况以蓝色表示。 1981 年起始于 1000 左右，2013 年最低约为 800。2001 年达到最高 1100。加元汇率以红色表示，以美元换算的加元价值衡量。最小值出现在 2001 年，为 0.65，最大值出现在 2009 年，为 1.00。总之，该图显示了一个非常有趣的趋势。

answer: This ﬂow diagram shows the taxi service work ﬂow. There are two ways that customers can make a booking. The ﬁrst way is to make a booking by phone, so that an operator can make the booking directly. The other way is to make online booking. The booking will be received by workstation desktop. The bookings from both pathways will be sent to taxi service server so that taxi drivers will be sent out for the bookings. The types of taxi include cars, vans and trucks. In conclusion, this ﬂow diagram gives detailed information about taxi booking.
answer_zh: 该流程图显示了出租车服务的工作流程。客户可以通过两种方式进行预订。第一种方式是电话预订，接线员可以直接预订。另一种方式是网上预订。预订将通过工作站桌面接收。两种途径的预订将被发送到出租车服务服务器，以便出租车司机被派出进行预订。出租车的类型包括轿车、货车和卡车。总之，该流程图提供了有关出租车预订的详细信息。

answer: This bar chart gives the information about population of major European countries, including Germany, Spain and France, in 1996 represented in red and in 2007 represented in yellow, measured in millions. In 1996, the largest population is in Germany at 80 million, and in 2007, the largest population is also in Germany and has not changed much. In 1996, the least population is in Poland at about 38 million, while in 2007, Poland also has the least population and again it has not changed much. The population of Turkey has changed from about 60 million to about 75 million over the years. In conclusion, this graph gives very interesting information.
answer_zh: 该条形图提供了欧洲主要国家（包括德国、西班牙和法国）的人口信息，1996 年以红色表示，2007 年以黄色表示，单位为百万。 1996年，人口最多的是德国，为8000万，2007年，人口最多的也是德国，变化不大。 1996年，人口最少的是波兰，约为3800万，而2007年，波兰也是人口最少的，而且也没有太大变化。多年来，土耳其人口已从约 6000 万增至约 7500 万。总之，这张图提供了非常有趣的信息。

answer: This bar chart provides the information about the ratio between pupil and teacher in primary schools in the January of 1997, measured in percentage. It can be seen that only 2% of the schools have a ratio of less than 16, and only 1% have a ratio of 16. Then the percentage gradually increases as the pupilteacher ratio increases. A maximum occurs when the pupil teacher ratio is 24. 14% of the schools have this ratio. After that, as the ratio increases, the percentage decreases and concludes at about 6% when the ratio is over 27. In conclusion, this graph shows very impressive information.
answer_zh: 此条形图提供了 1997 年 1 月小学学生与教师比例的信息（以百分比衡量）。可以看出，只有2%的学校的比例低于16，只有1%的学校的比例为16。然后随着师生比例的增加，比例逐渐增加。当师生比例为 24 时达到最大值。14% 的学校达到这一比例。之后，随着比率的增加，百分比会下降，当比率超过 27 时，百分比大约为 6%。 总之，该图显示了非常令人印象深刻的信息。

answer: This bar chart gives the information about cups of coﬀee sold in downtown, which is represented in blue, and in the mall, which is represented in red, from January to May. In the mall, most coﬀee is sold in February when 43 cups coﬀee are sold, while in the downtown, the highest sale of coﬀee is also in February when about 25 cups are sold. In the mall, the least coﬀee sale is in April when 5 cups are sold while in downtown, the least sale is in May when 6 cups are sold. In March, 10 cups of coﬀee are sold in downtown and 14 cups are sold in the mall. In conclusion, this graph shows very impressive information.
answer_zh: 此条形图提供了从 1 月到 5 月在市中心（以蓝色表示）和在购物中心（以红色表示）出售的咖啡杯数的信息。在商场，咖啡销量最多的月份是二月，售出 43 杯咖啡；而在市中心，咖啡销量最高的也是二月，售出约 25 杯咖啡。在商场，咖啡销售最少的是 4 月份，售出 5 杯；而在市中心，咖啡销售最少的是 5 月份，售出 6 杯。 3月份，市中心售出10杯咖啡，商场售出14杯。总之，该图显示了非常令人印象深刻的信息。

answer: This map illustrates the present potential vegetation in the world. Closed forest means over 70% of land is canopy cover, and it is represented in green on the map. Extreme desert means less than 2% has vegetation cover, and is represented in yellow. It can be seen that the area of closed forest is larger than that of extreme dessert, and you can ﬁnd closed forest in some parts of South America, North America, Asia and a few parts in Africa and Australia. You can ﬁnd extreme dessert in the northern parts of African, and a little bit in the middle of Asia. In conclusion, this map gives a very vivid illustration of the present potential vegetation.
answer_zh: 这张地图展示了世界上目前潜在的植被。封闭的森林意味着超过 70% 的土地被树冠覆盖，在地图上以绿色表示。极端沙漠是指植被覆盖率低于 2%，以黄色表示。可以看出，封闭森林的面积比极端沙漠的面积要大，在南美洲、北美、亚洲的部分地区以及非洲和澳大利亚的少数地区都可以发现封闭森林。在非洲北部和亚洲中部，你可以找到一些美味的甜点。总之，这张地图非常生动地说明了目前潜在的植被。

answer: This map illustrates the early holocene 8000 years ago. Closed forest is represented in green on the map, and extreme desert is represented in yellow. It can be seen that the area of closed forest is much larger than that of extreme desert, and you can ﬁnd closed forest in some parts of South America, North America, Asia and western part of Africa and on the eastern coast of Australia. You can ﬁnd extreme desert on the western coast of South America, southeastern coast of Africa, and a little bit in the middle of Asia. In conclusion, this map gives a very vivid illustration of the early holocene.
answer_zh: 这张地图展示了 8000 年前的全新世早期。地图上绿色表示封闭森林，黄色表示极端沙漠。可见，封闭森林的面积远大于极端沙漠的面积，在南美洲、北美、亚洲和非洲西部的部分地区以及澳大利亚东海岸都可以发现封闭森林。在南美洲西海岸、非洲东南海岸以及亚洲中部的一些地方，你可以找到极端的沙漠。总之，这张地图非常生动地说明了全新世早期。

answer: This map illustrates the last glacial maximum 18,000 years ago. Closed forest is represented in green on the map, and extreme desert is represented in yellow. It can be seen that the area of closed forest is much smaller than that of extreme dessert, and you can ﬁnd closed forest in a few areas in South America, North America and Asia. You can ﬁnd extreme dessert in majority of areas in Asia, Africa and Australia. In conclusion, this map gives a very vivid illustration of the last glacial maximum 18,000 years ago.
answer_zh: 这张地图描绘了 18,000 年前的最后一次盛冰期。地图上绿色表示封闭森林，黄色表示极端沙漠。可以看出，封闭森林的面积比极端沙漠小得多，在南美洲、北美洲和亚洲的少数地区都可以发现封闭森林。在亚洲、非洲和澳大利亚的大部分地区，您都可以找到极致甜点。总之，这张地图非常生动地展示了 18,000 年前的末次盛冰期。

answer: This bar chart gives the information about percentage of population in urban areas in diﬀerent parts of the world, including Africa, Asia and Europe, in 1950 represented in red, in 2007 represented in dark red, and in 2030 represented in blue. In the world, percentage of population in urban areas increases from 20% to 60% from 1950 to 2030. In contrast, in Latin America, the percentage increases from 42% in 1950 to 84% in 2030. In Europe, the percentage increases from 51% in 1950 to 78% in 2030. in conclusion, this graph shows very impressive information.
answer_zh: 该条形图提供了世界不同地区（包括非洲、亚洲和欧洲）城市地区人口百分比的信息，1950 年以红色表示，2007 年以深红色表示，2030 年以蓝色表示。在世界范围内，从1950年到2030年，城市地区人口比例从20%增加到60%。相比之下，在拉丁美洲，这一比例从1950年的42%增加到2030年的84%。在欧洲，这一比例从1950年的51%增加到2030年的78%。总而言之，这张图显示了非常令人印象深刻的信息。

answer: This line graph presents the total population of Thoralby from 1870 to 2010. The information is shown in a blue line. It starts at about 275 in 1870, followed by a decrease to a minimum of about 100 in 1950. During the increase there are some ﬂuctuations. After 1950, there is a huge increase to a maximum of 325 in 1970. After that, the population decreases rapidly again to about 150 in 1990. The population remains relatively constant after that and concludes at about 150 in 2010. In conclusion, this graph gives very detailed information about population in Thoralby.
answer_zh: 此折线图显示了 1870 年至 2010 年索拉尔比的总人口。信息以蓝线显示。 1870年开始为275左右，随后在1950年下降到最低100左右。在上升过程中存在一些波动。 1950年之后，人口大幅增加，到1970年达到最高325人。此后，人口再次迅速减少，到1990年约为150人。此后人口保持相对稳定，到2010年约为150人。总而言之，这张图给出了索拉尔比人口的非常详细的信息。

answer: This graph presents the relationship between temperature and precipitation throughout the year from January to December in Manaus, Amazonas, Brazil. The temperature is represented in an orange line and measured in degree Celsius. It starts at about 26oC in January and gradually increases. A maximum is reached in October at about 27.5oC. It concludes at about 26.5oC in December. The precipitation is represented in blue bars and measured in mm. The maximum occurs in March at 300mm, and the minimum occurs in August at about 50mm. In conclusion, this graph gives very detailed information.
answer_zh: 该图显示了巴西亚马逊马瑙斯全年 1 月至 12 月温度与降水之间的关系。温度以橙色线表示并以摄氏度为单位测量。一月开始温度在26℃左右，逐渐升高。 10 月份达到最高温度，约为 27.5oC。 12 月结束温度约为 26.5oC。降水量以蓝色条表示并以毫米为单位测量。最大值出现在3月份，为300毫米，最小值出现在8月份，约为50毫米。总之，该图提供了非常详细的信息。

answer: This line graph provides the information about population growth and growth in rating base in ﬁnancial years ending 30 June from 2012 to 2022, measured in percentage. The population growth remains relatively stable over the years at about 1.5%. In contrast, the growth in rating base starts at about 1.0% in 2012 and concludes at about 1.8% in 2022. A minimum occurs in 2013 at about 0.7%, and a maximum occurs in 2018 at 2.0%. In conclusion, this graph presents a lot of information.
answer_zh: 该折线图提供了 2012 年至 2022 年截至 6 月 30 日的财政年度中人口增长和评级基础增长的信息（以百分比衡量）。人口增长率多年来保持相对稳定在1.5%左右。相比之下，评级基数的增长从 2012 年约 1.0% 开始，到 2022 年约 1.8% 结束。最小值出现在 2013 年，约为 0.7%，最大值出现在 2018 年，约为 2.0%。总之，这张图提供了很多信息。

answer: This ﬂow diagram presents the life cycle of a frog. The ﬁrst stage is to fertilize eggs. The embryo is inside the egg and after hatching, a young tadpole comes out. Then the life cycle enters the tadpole early stage. The young tadpole has external gills and mucous glands, and the tadpoles attach themselves to substrate. Then the tadpole grows to consist of an operaculum and a mouth. In the tadpole late stage, skin and teeth grow, followed by growth of front limb bulge and hind and front legs. Then the tails become shorter and when the tails disappear, it becomes an adult frog. In conclusion, this image gives a vivid illustration of the life cycle of a frog.
answer_zh: 该流程图显示了青蛙的生命周期。第一阶段是使卵子受精。胚胎在卵内，孵化后会生出小蝌蚪。然后生命周期进入蝌蚪早期阶段。幼蝌蚪有外部鳃和粘液腺，蝌蚪将自己附着在基质上。然后蝌蚪长大，长出鳃盖和嘴。蝌蚪后期，皮肤和牙齿开始生长，随后前肢隆起和后、前腿生长。然后尾巴变短，当尾巴消失时，它就变成了成年青蛙。总之，这张图片生动地说明了青蛙的生命周期。

answer: This map shows the locations of cities with at least one million inhabitants in 2006. these cities are marked as red dots on the map. It can be seen most of these cities are located in Asia, especially in the southeast of Asia. There are also many of these cities on the eastern coast and Southern coast of Asia. In South America and North America, there are also some this kind of cities, mostly located in the south of North America and on the coast of South America. Along the coast of Africa, there are also some cities with over one million inhabitants. However, there are few cities in Australia having over one million inhabitants. In conclusion, this map illustrates very important information.
answer_zh: 该地图显示了 2006 年人口至少为 100 万的城市的位置。这些城市在地图上标记为红点。可以看出，这些城市大部分位于亚洲，尤其是亚洲东南部。亚洲东海岸和南海岸也有许多这样的城市。在南美和北美，也有一些此类城市，大多位于北美南部和南美海岸。非洲沿海也有一些人口超过百万的城市。然而，澳大利亚很少有城市拥有超过一百万的居民。总之，这张地图说明了非常重要的信息。
