answer: This image illustrates the relationship between energy and human life. First of all, the chemical energy is taken into the human body from carbohydrates, fats and others. These can be sourced from varieties of food. The energy is converted into ATP, which is known as body’s “energy currency” . ATP can be used for the metabolism process. During the metabolism process and the process of transferring energy into ATP, heat is produced, and also chemical waste is produced, which includes carbon dioxide and water. In conclusion, this image shows a vivid illustration of energy and human life.
answer_zh: 该图说明了能源与人类生活之间的关系。人体首先从碳水化合物、脂肪等中摄取化学能。这些可以来自各种食物。能量转化为ATP，被称为人体的“能量货币”。 ATP可用于新陈代谢过程。在新陈代谢过程以及将能量转化为ATP的过程中，会产生热量，同时也会产生化学废物，其中包括二氧化碳和水。总之，这张图片生动地展示了能源和人类生活。

answer: This bar chart gives the information about most used types of technology, including computer, TV and webcam, measured in number of users in million. It is clear that telephone that is represented in green has the most users, about 8 million, followed by which TV represented in light blue and computer in purple have 6 million users and more than 4 million users respectively. Radio represented in pink and Ipod in red have more than 3 million users and 1 million users respectively. Webcam is represented in dark blue and has the least users, about 0.5 million. In conclusion, this graph illustrates a lot of impressive information.
answer_zh: 此条形图提供了有关最常用技术类型的信息，包括计算机、电视和网络摄像头，以百万用户数量为单位。可以看出，绿色代表的电话用户最多，约为800万，其次是浅蓝色代表的电视和紫色代表的电脑，分别拥有600万用户和400万以上用户。粉红色的 Radio 和红色的 Ipod 分别拥有超过 300 万和 100 万用户。网络摄像头以深蓝色表示，用户最少，约为 50 万。总之，这张图说明了许多令人印象深刻的信息。

answer: This map shows the information about share of world GDP per capita sourced from the World Bank, ICP. The largest area is over 3.5% represented in dark green, and you can ﬁnd it in the north of Asia, occupying majority of the areas in Asia. 1 to 3.5% represented in green and over 15% in black also have large areas. You can ﬁnd them in most of North America, some parts in South America and Australia. 0.5% to 0.1% and less are represented in yellow, and you can ﬁnd it in majority of areas in Africa, and some parts in Asia. The six biggest economies are also shown on the map, including China, the US and Russia. In conclusion, this map illustrates very detailed information.
answer_zh: 该地图显示了来自世界银行 ICP 的世界人均 GDP 份额信息。最大的面积超过3.5%，以深绿色表示，你可以在亚洲北部找到它，占据了亚洲的大部分地区。 1%至3.5%以绿色表示，15%以上以黑色表示也有大面积。您可以在北美大部分地区、南美部分地区和澳大利亚找到它们。 0.5%到0.1%及以下用黄色表示，在非洲大部分地区和亚洲部分地区都可以找到它。地图上还显示了六大经济体，包括中国、美国和俄罗斯。总之，这张地图说明了非常详细的信息。

answer: This bar chart shows the information about number of motor vehicle thefts from 1998 to 2002, recorded in people per 100,000 people. 1998 which is presented in green has the highest number of vehicle thefts, about 57 people. Followed by 1998, the numbers in 2001 represented in blue, in 2000 represented in yellow and in 1999 represented in orange are 56, 53 and 53 respectively. In 2002 which is represented in red, the number of motor vehicle thefts is the lowest, about 51 people. In conclusion, this graph illustrates very interesting information.
answer_zh: 此条形图显示了 1998 年至 2002 年机动车盗窃数量的信息，以每 10 万人中记录的人数为单位。以绿色表示的 1998 年车辆盗窃案数量最多，约为 57 人。接下来是1998年，2001年的数字以蓝色表示，2000年的数字以黄色表示，1999年的数字以橙色表示，分别为56、53和53。红色代表的2002年，机动车盗窃案数量最低，约为51人。总之，这张图说明了非常有趣的信息。

answer: This line graph presents the information about the proportion of energy produced from coal in four European countries including Sweden, France, Denmark and Germany from 1995 to 2010, measured in percentage. Sweden is represented in blue and it remains relatively stable throughout the years, showing a slight decrease from 35% to about 28%. France in red shows a similar trend. Germany, which is represented in purple, starts at 55% in 1995 and concludes at about 18% in 2010, and a minimum occurs in 2007 at 5%. In conclusion, this graph gives a lot of impressive information.
answer_zh: 该折线图显示了 1995 年至 2010 年瑞典、法国、丹麦和德国等四个欧洲国家煤炭生产能源比例的信息（以百分比表示）。瑞典以蓝色表示，多年来保持相对稳定，从 35% 略有下降至 28% 左右。红色的法国也显示出类似的趋势。德国（以紫色表示）从 1995 年开始为 55%，到 2010 年为 18% 左右，最低值出现在 2007 年，为 5%。总之，这张图提供了很多令人印象深刻的信息。

answer: This bar chart is about water use in Gulf countries, including Kuwait, Qatar, UAE and Saudi Arabia, in 2000, measured in percentage and categorized by domestic in blue, agriculture in red and industrial in yellow. In Bahrain, domestic water use occupies the largest proportion at 50% and industrial sector has the lowest proportion at 10%. In contrast, in Oman, agriculture water use occupies the largest proportion at about 80% and industrial sector occupies about 2%. In Kuwait, domestic water use occupies over 60%. In conclusion, this graph gives very impressive information.
answer_zh: 该条形图显示了 2000 年海湾国家（包括科威特、卡塔尔、阿联酋和沙特阿拉伯）的用水量，以百分比衡量，并按蓝色分类为家庭用水，红色为农业用水，黄色为工业用水。在巴林，生活用水所占比例最大，为50%，工业部门所占比例最低，为10%。相比之下，阿曼农业用水所占比例最大，约为80%，工业用水约占2%。在科威特，生活用水占60%以上。总之，该图提供了非常令人印象深刻的信息。

answer: This bar chart illustrates the number of internet users per 100 people in diﬀerent countries, including Ireland, France, Italy and UK. It can be seen that Sweden has the most internet users, 44 people per 100 people, followed by which the numbers of internet users in Finland, Denmark and Netherlands are 42, 41, and 39 respectively. In UK, Australia and Germany, the numbers of internet users are 23, 22 and 20 respectively. Greece contains the smallest number of internet users, about 7 people per 100 people. In conclusion, the bar chart provides detailed information about number of inter users around the world.
answer_zh: 此条形图显示了不同国家/地区每 100 人的互联网用户数量，包括爱尔兰、法国、意大利和英国。可以看出，瑞典的互联网用户数量最多，每100人中有44人，其次是芬兰、丹麦和荷兰，分别为42人、41人和39人。在英国、澳大利亚和德国，互联网用户数量分别为 23、22 和 20。希腊的互联网用户数量最少，每 100 人中约有 7 人。总之，条形图提供了有关全球内部用户数量的详细信息。

answer: This graph presents the information about cell phone use in Brazil between 1996 and 2002, categorized by men, women and both sexes, recorded in number of people. For men which is represented in blue, it starts at 1,500 people in 1996 and concludes at about 1,700 people in 2002. The trend of women which is represented in pink shows a similar trend. The category “Both sexes” is represented in red, and it starts at the minimum of 3,000 people in 1996 and concludes at a maximum of about 3,500 people in 2002. in conclusion, this graph illustrates very interesting information.
answer_zh: 该图显示了 1996 年至 2002 年间巴西手机使用情况的信息，按男性、女性和男女分类，并以人数记录。蓝色代表的男性人数从 1996 年的 1,500 人开始，到 2002 年约 1,700 人结束。粉色代表的女性人数也显示出类似的趋势。 “男女”类别以红色表示，从 1996 年的最少 3,000 人开始，到 2002 年最多约 3,500 人。 总之，这张图说明了非常有趣的信息。

answer: This line graph shows the level of sports player’s salaries from 1970 to 2000, measured in US dollars. The salary of baseball players is represented in blue and starts at about $100,000 in 1970, then increases and concludes at a maximum of $1,500,000 in 2000. The salary of basketball players is represented in orange and starts at about $100,000 in 1970, then increases and concludes at a maximum of $2,500,000 in 2000. The salary of football players, which is represented in green, increases from $100,000 to about $750,000 over the years. In conclusion, this graph presents very impressive information.
answer_zh: 该折线图显示了 1970 年至 2000 年体育运动员的工资水平（以美元计算）。棒球运动员的工资用蓝色表示，1970 年起价约为 100,000 美元，然后增加，到 2000 年最高达到 1,500,000 美元。篮球运动员的工资用橙色表示，1970 年起价约为 100,000 美元，然后增加，到 2000 年最高达到 2,500,000 美元。足球运动员的工资，表示为绿色部分，多年来从 100,000 美元增加到约 750,000 美元。总之，该图提供了非常令人印象深刻的信息。

answer: The graph shows changes in the number of London underground station passengers in one day from 6:00 to 22:00, in terms of number of people. We can see from the graph that at 6:00, there are only 100 passengers and the number increases to a maximum of 400 passengers at about 8:00. Followed by that there is a decrease and keeps relatively stable at about 300 passengers from 12:00 to 14:00. Then the number continues to decrease to a minimum of 100 passengers at 16:00, followed by which the number increases again. It concludes at about 100 passengers at 22:00. in conclusion, this graph presents very impressive information.
answer_zh: 该图以人数形式展示了伦敦地铁站一日内6:00至22:00乘客数量的变化。从图中我们可以看到，6:00 时乘客只有 100 人，到 8:00 左右人数增加到最多 400 人。其次是12:00至14:00客流量有所减少，并相对稳定在300人左右。随后人数继续减少，到 16:00 时乘客人数至少为 100 人，随后人数再次增加。 22:00 结束时乘客人数约为 100 人。总之，该图提供了非常令人印象深刻的信息。

answer: This ﬂow diagram presents the process of uranium production. Firstly, mining takes place at the uranium ore and in the second stage which is milling, uranium oxide, known as yellowcake, is produced. In the next stage called conversion, uranium hexaﬂuoride is produced and is sent to the enrichment step where both products and low-enriched uranium are produced. The product is sent to storage and the tails are sent to be re-enriched. The low-enriched uranium is sent to the fuel fabrication step where uranium dioxide is produced which can be used in commercial reactors for energy production. In conclusion, this graph illustrates a detailed process description.
answer_zh: 该流程图显示了铀生产的过程。首先，开采铀矿，在第二阶段研磨，生产氧化铀，称为黄饼。在称为转化的下一阶段，生产六氟化铀并将其送往浓缩步骤，在此生产产品和低浓缩铀。产品被送往仓库，尾料被送往重新富集。低浓铀被送往燃料制造步骤，生产二氧化铀，可用于商业反应堆中用于能源生产。总之，该图阐释了详细的流程描述。

answer: This line graph describes the climate graph including temperature in degree Celsius and precipitation in mm for Port Moresby, Papua New Guinea. Temperature is represented in red and remains relatively stable over the year at about 27oC. A minimum occurs in August at about 25oC. The precipitation is represented in blue bars. The maximum occurs in February at about 200mm while the minimum occurs in July at about 25mm. It starts at about 175mm in January and concludes at about 125mm in December. In conclusion, this graph gives signiﬁcant information.
answer_zh: 此线图描述了巴布亚新几内亚莫尔兹比港的气候图，包括温度（摄氏度）和降水量（毫米）。温度以红色表示，全年相对稳定在 27oC 左右。最低温度出现在 8 月，温度约为 25oC。降水量以蓝色条表示。最大值出现在 2 月，约为 200 毫米，最小值出现在 7 月，约为 25 毫米。一月份开始时厚度约为 175 毫米，十二月结束时厚度约为 125 毫米。总之，这张图提供了重要的信息。

answer: This image illustrates the village of Chorleywood showing development between 1868 and
answer_zh: 此图展示了乔利伍德 (Chorleywood) 村在 1868 年至

title_en: Chorleywood Park, Golf course and Chorleywood station are shown on the map. Also, the main roads are crossing the main parts of the village, and the motorway has been built in 1970, while the railway has been built in 1909. These have become the main transportation routes. Areas in diﬀerent time periods are shown on the map, including 1868 to 1883, 1883 to 1922, 1922 to 1970 and 1970 to 1994. It can be seen that the village has become bigger and the traﬃc has become much more convenient. In conclusion, this map gives impressive information.

answer: This image presents the process of water treatment. The rain water can be treated via several pathways. The ﬁrst one is to collect the rainwater using a dam, and the water is sent to a water treatment plant where drinking water is produced and can be provided to the households. Another pathway is that rainwater is collected in the rainwater tank, and through the households, water is sent to a waste water treatment plant where excess treated water is sent to the rivers while the recycled water is sent back to the households. The last pathway is that through stormwater treatment, water is sent to the rivers. In conclusion, this image gives a very detailed description of the process.
answer_zh: 该图展示了水处理的过程。雨水可以通过多种途径进行处理。第一个是利用水坝收集雨水，然后将水送往水处理厂，在那里生产饮用水并提供给家庭。另一种途径是，雨水被收集在雨水箱中，通过家庭，将水送到废水处理厂，多余的处理水被排入河流，而回收的水则被送回家庭。最后一条途径是通过雨水处理，将水排入河流。总之，这张图片给出了该过程的非常详细的描述。

answer: The map below shows the changes that have taken place in the seaside resort of Templeton between 1990 and 2005. On the top of the picture, we can see that in 1990, there are few tall buildings and there are a lot of trees. At the bottom of the picture, we can see that the resort has changed a lot. A lot of trees have been cut down, and many small houses have been removed to be replaced by tall buildings. New public transport forms have been introduced such as ferries, trains and airplanes. Also the railways have been built so that people can travel across the river. A new factory is built within the resort. In conclusion, this image gives a very vivid illustration of the change of the resort.
answer_zh: 下面的地图显示了坦普尔顿海滨度假胜地在1990年至2005年间发生的变化。在图片的顶部，我们可以看到1990年的时候，高楼很少，树木很多。在图片的底部，我们可以看到度假村发生了很大的变化。许多树木被砍伐，许多小房子被拆除，取而代之的是高楼大厦。引入了新的公共交通形式，如渡轮、火车和飞机。铁路也已建成，以便人们可以过河。度假村内建造了一座新工厂。总之，这张图片非常生动地说明了度假村的变化。

answer: This line graph gives the information about Dubai Gold Sales in 2002 from January to December, recorded in millions of Dirhams. It is clear that the sale starts at 200 million Dirhams in January, followed by an increase to a maximum of 350 million Dirhams in March. Then the sale starts to gradually decrease and reaches a minimum of 100 million Dirhams in July. After that, the sale increases a little to about 200 million Dirhams in August but decreases immediately. It remains relatively stable from October to December at about 200 million Dirhams. In conclusion, this graph clearly shows the trend of Dubai gold Sales.
answer_zh: 此折线图提供了 2002 年 1 月至 12 月迪拜黄金销售量的信息，单位为百万迪拉姆。很明显，1月份的销售起始价为2亿迪拉姆，随后3月份增至最高3.5亿迪拉姆。然后销售额开始逐渐减少，7月份最低达到1亿迪拉姆。此后，8月份的销售额略有增加，达到约2亿迪拉姆，但立即下降。 10月至12月保持相对稳定在2亿迪拉姆左右。总之，这张图清楚地显示了迪拜黄金销售的趋势。

answer: This pie chart illustrates the proportion of causes of poor attendance in UK schools in 2007, categorized by upbringing, both parents working, lack of school discipline, peer group pressure and bullying. It is clear from the chart that both parent working occupies the largest proportion of 40%, followed by which lack of school discipline, peer group pressure and bullying occupy 25%, 15% and 15% respectively. Upbringing occupies the least proportion at 5%. In conclusion, this graph gives a detailed analysis of the causes of poor attendance.
answer_zh: 该饼图显示了 2007 年英国学校出勤率低的原因的比例，按成长、父母双方工作、缺乏学校纪律、同伴群体压力和欺凌等分类。从图表中可以看出，父母双方都工作的比例最大，为40%，其次是学校纪律缺失、同伴压力和欺凌，分别占25%、15%和15%。教养所占比例最小，为5%。总之，这张图详细分析了出勤率低的原因。

answer: This line graph presents the information about coﬀee exports in diﬀerent countries including Brazil, Colombia and Costa Rica from 2002 to 2012, measured in million kilograms. It can be seen from the graph that the coﬀee export of Costa Rica is represented in green and starts at 15 million kilograms in 2002 and concludes at a maximum of 20 million kilograms in 2012. A minimum occurs in 2006 at 7 million kilograms. Colombia is represented in red and it starts at 5 million kilograms in 2002 and concludes at a maximum of 15 million kilograms in 2012. A minimum occurs in 2008 at about 2 million kilograms. In conclusion, this graph shows very interesting information.
answer_zh: 该折线图显示了 2002 年至 2012 年巴西、哥伦比亚和哥斯达黎加等不同国家的咖啡出口信息（以百万公斤为单位）。从图中可以看出，哥斯达黎加的咖啡出口量以绿色表示，2002 年为 1500 万公斤，2012 年最高为 2000 万公斤。2006 年最低为 700 万公斤。哥伦比亚以红色表示，2002 年产量为 500 万公斤，2012 年产量最高为 1500 万公斤。2008 年产量最低，约为 200 万公斤。总之，该图显示了非常有趣的信息。

answer: This map and bar chart show the population measured in thousand million and distribution of diﬀerent consumption levels, including low income, middle income and high income. According to the bar chart, the population of low income which is represented in green increases from 1.5 thousand million to 3 thousand million from 1960 to 2004, while the population of high income which is represented in red increases from 0.6 thousand million to 1.0 thousand million. According the map, middle income represented in yellow is the most common and you can ﬁnd it mostly in South America and Asia. In conclusion, this graph gives very thorough information.
answer_zh: 该地图和条形图显示了以亿为单位的人口以及不同消费水平的分布，包括低收入、中等收入和高收入。根据条形图，从1960年到2004年，绿色代表的低收入人口从15亿增加到3亿，而红色代表的高收入人口从06亿增加到10亿。根据地图，以黄色表示的中等收入是最常见的，你可以在南美洲和亚洲找到它。总之，该图提供了非常详尽的信息。

answer: This image illustrates the life cycle of a frog. There are seven stages in total. It starts with eggs which are laid by an adult frog. The eggs become small tadpoles. And then the lungs and the legs are grown so that the tadpoles become tadpoles with lungs and legs. The size is growing larger but the colour remains grey. Then the tadpole becomes a froglet which is a small frog with a little tail. The colour becomes green at this stage. When the little tail disappears, the froglet becomes a young frog which is a small frog with light green colour. In the last stage, the young frog becomes an adult frog eventually which can lay eggs. In conclusion, this image shows a very vivid description of the process.
answer_zh: 这张图片展示了青蛙的生命周期。总共有七个阶段。它始于成年青蛙产下的卵。卵变成小蝌蚪。然后长出肺和腿，这样蝌蚪就变成了有肺和腿的蝌蚪。尺寸越来越大，但颜色仍然是灰色的。然后蝌蚪就变成了青蛙，也就是一只长着小尾巴的小青蛙。此阶段颜色变为绿色。当小尾巴消失后，小青蛙就变成了幼蛙，是一种浅绿色的小青蛙。在最后阶段，幼蛙最终成为可以产卵的成年青蛙。总之，这张图非常生动地描述了这个过程。

answer: This map illustrates the air temperature in January in diﬀerent areas of the world. In the north of the world, the air temperature is low, between -40oC and -25oC, represented in blue. Below those areas, above the equator, the air temperature is between 5oC to 20oC, represented in yellow and orange colours. Further down, near the equator, the air temperature is pretty high, between 25oC to 35oC, represented in red. When we get further from the equator, the temperature cools down again to 5oC to 20oC. And in the most northern part of the world, the temperature is between -5oC to -20oC, represented in light blue. In conclusion, this map gives a vivid description.
answer_zh: 这张地图显示了世界不同地区一月份的气温。在世界北部，气温较低，在-40°C 至-25°C 之间，以蓝色表示。在这些区域下方、赤道上方，气温在 5°C 至 20°C 之间，以黄色和橙色表示。再往下，靠近赤道，气温相当高，在 25°C 到 35°C 之间，用红色表示。当我们远离赤道时，温度再次冷却至 5°C 至 20°C。而在世界最北端，温度在-5℃到-20℃之间，以浅蓝色表示。总之，这张地图给出了生动的描述。

answer: This line graph gives the information about consumer conﬁdence from the January of 1990 to the January of 2008. It is clear from the graph that it starts at about 80 in 1990 and remains relatively constant until 1996 in terms of the average values. Then the index starts to increase rapidly to about 100 in 2002. After that, the increase is slowing down and it concludes at about 100 in 2008. The consumer conﬁdence index ﬂuctuates to a great extent over the time, but the trend shows an increase. In conclusion, this graph is a good demonstration of the consumer conﬁdence index.
answer_zh: 该折线图提供了从 1990 年 1 月到 2008 年 1 月的消费者信心信息。从图中可以清楚地看出，从平均值来看，它从 1990 年开始约为 80，直到 1996 年保持相对稳定。此后，该指数开始快速上升，2002年达到100左右。此后，上升速度逐渐放缓，2008年结束在100左右。消费者信心指数随时间波动较大，但呈现上升趋势。总之，该图很好地展示了消费者信心指数。

answer: This line graph presents the life expectancy at birth by sex from 1888 to 2013, measured in years. The life expectancy of males is represented in dark blue and starts at 45 years in 1888, increasing to a maximum and concluding at 70 years in 2013. The life expectancy of females is overall longer than males, and it is represented in light blue. It starts at 50 years in 1888 and increases to a maximum and concludes at 75 years in 2013. The life expectancy of both males and males has been increasing. In conclusion, this graph gives a very interesting analysis of life expectancy of males and females.
answer_zh: 该折线图显示了 1888 年至 2013 年按性别划分的出生时预期寿命（以年为单位）。男性的预期寿命以深蓝色表示，从 1888 年的 45 岁开始，增加到最大值，并于 2013 年达到 70 岁。女性的预期寿命总体上比男性长，以浅蓝色表示。它从1888年的50岁开始，增加到最高值，到2013年结束于75岁。男性和男性的预期寿命都在增加。总之，这张图对男性和女性的预期寿命进行了非常有趣的分析。

answer: This image gives the demonstration of the process of Pu-erh raw tea and ripe tea. The ﬁrst step is pan frying where the enzymes in the tea are inactivated. The second step is rolling, after which the tea leaves are dried under the sun. This is how loose raw tea is produced. Later, to produce vintage Pu-erh raw tea, the loose raw tea is compressed to become Pu-er raw tea which can be aged by storage and eventually becomes vintage Pu-erh raw tea. Instead, if you want to produce Pu-erh ripe tea, the loose raw tea needs to undergo fermentation by mold to obtain loose ripe tea, and after compression, Pu-erh ripe tea is produced. In conclusion, this image shows very interesting information.
answer_zh: 此图展示了普洱生茶和熟茶的加工过程。第一步是用平底锅煎，茶叶中的酶被灭活。第二步是揉捻，然后将茶叶晒干。这就是散装生茶的制作方法。后来生产陈年普洱生茶时，将散装的生茶压制成普洱生茶，经过储藏陈化，最终成为陈年普洱生茶。相反，如果想要生产普洱熟茶，则需要将散装生茶经过霉菌发酵，得到散装熟茶，再经过压缩，就生产出了普洱熟茶。总之，这张图片显示了非常有趣的信息。

answer: This bar chart indicates the information about earnings and unemployment rates by educational attainment in 2012, categorized by doctoral degree, master’s degree and high school diploma. The unemployment rate is represented in purple and measured in percentage. Less than a high school diploma occupies the largest proportion at 12.4% and professional degree occupies the least proportion at 2.1%. The median weekly earnings is represented in green and measured in dollars. The largest number is for professional degree at about $1200, and the smallest number is for less than a high school diploma at about $500. In conclusion, this graph provides thorough information.
answer_zh: 此条形图显示了 2012 年按教育程度划分的收入和失业率信息，按博士学位、硕士学位和高中文凭分类。失业率以紫色表示并以百分比衡量。高中以下学历占比最大，为12.4%，专业学位占比最小，为2.1%。每周收入中位数以绿色表示并以美元衡量。数量最多的是专业学位，约为 1200 美元，最少的是高中以下文凭，约为 500 美元。总之，该图提供了全面的信息。

answer: This bar chart gives the information about publications by subject areas, including humanities, sciences and arts, of four universities including Warwick, Sheﬃeld, York and Birmingham, from 2006 to 2012, recorded in number of publications. In Warwick, humanities have the most publications, which is 120 publications while the arts have the smallest number of publications, that is 90. In contrast, in Birmingham, humanities have the most publications which is 30 publications, while sciences have the least number of publications which is 20. In conclusion, this bar chart demonstrates interesting comparisons.
answer_zh: 该条形图显示了华威大学、谢菲尔德大学、约克大学和伯明翰大学等四所大学2006年至2012年按学科领域（包括人文、科学和艺术）的出版物信息，以出版物数量记录。在沃里克，人文学科的出版物数量最多，为 120 种，而艺术学科的出版物数量最少，为 90 种。相比之下，在伯明翰，人文学科的出版物数量最多，为 30 种，而科学的出版物数量最少，为 20 种。总而言之，这张条形图显示了有趣的比较。

answer: This line graph gives the information about number of articles published per year by male and female university professors from 2006 to 2012. Number of articles published by males is represented in blue and remains relatively constant at about 3000 articles. There is a minimum in the year of 2010. The number of articles published by females is represented in pink and shows an increase trend. It starts at about 1000 articles in 2006 and increases to a maximum of 3000 articles in 2012. There is a slight decrease from 2000 articles to 1900 articles from 2008 to 2009 but then it increases immediately after 2009. In conclusion, this graph presents very interesting information.
answer_zh: 该折线图提供了 2006 年至 2012 年间男性和女性大学教授每年发表的文章数量信息。男性发表的文章数量以蓝色表示，相对稳定在 3000 篇左右。 2010年有一个最小值。女性发表的文章数量以粉红色表示，呈增加趋势。从 2006 年的大约 1000 篇文章开始，到 2012 年增加到最多 3000 篇文章。从 2008 年到 2009 年，从 2000 篇文章略有减少到 1900 篇文章，但在 2009 年之后立即增加。总而言之，该图提供了非常有趣的信息。

answer: This table presents the information about percentage of diﬀerent countries, including Sweden, France, Denmark and Germany from 1995 to 2010. It is clear that for Sweden, the percentage starts at 35% in 1995 and keeps decreasing to the minimum of 27% in 2004. The number remains constant for the last 6 years. For France, the percentage starts at 30% in 1995 and concludes at 24% in 2010. A minimum occurs in 2004 at 23%. In Denmark, the decrease is rapidly, from 60% in 1995 to 10% in 2010. In conclusion, this table gives very interesting information.
answer_zh: 该表列出了1995年至2010年间瑞典、法国、丹麦和德国等不同国家的百分比信息。很明显，瑞典的百分比从1995年的35%开始，一直下降到2004年的最低27%。在过去的6年里，这个数字保持不变。对于法国来说，这一比例从 1995 年的 30% 开始，到 2010 年达到 24%。2004 年达到最低值，为 23%。在丹麦，下降速度很快，从 1995 年的 60% 下降到 2010 年的 10%。 总之，该表提供了非常有趣的信息。

answer: These charts show the percentage of enrolments on six courses at a local education college in the UK in 2010 and 2012. The courses include nursing, engineering and social studies, in 2010 and 2012. In 2010, nursing occupies the largest proportion at 27% while carpentry occupies the least proportion at 8%. In contrast, in 2012, sports science occupies the largest proportion at 25.5%, and carpentry still occupies the least proportion at 5%. Compared to 2010, in 2012, the proportions of psychology and engineering increase while nursing decrease. In conclusion, these charts demonstrate very interesing comparisons.
answer_zh: 这些图表显示了2010年和2012年英国当地教育学院六门课程的入学百分比。这些课程包括2010年和2012年的护理、工程和社会研究。2010年，护理所占比例最大，为27%，木工所占比例最小，为8%。相比之下，2012年，体育科学所占比例最大，为25.5%，木工仍然所占比例最小，为5%。与2010年相比，2012年心理学、工科所占比重有所上升，而护理专业所占比重有所下降。总之，这些图表展示了非常有趣的比较。

answer: The bar chart shows the average number of hours per week that men and women spend doing activities around the home. For men, which is represented in blue, the most common activity is watching television, at 13 hours per week, followed by which they spend 12 hours per week surﬁng on the internet, while the least common activity for them is cleaning the house, at 3 hours per week. In contrast, the most common activity for women, which is represented in pink, is cooking, at 15 hours per week while the least common activity is gardening, at 2 hours per week. In conclusion, this graph demonstrates interesting comparisons.
answer_zh: 条形图显示男性和女性每周在家中进行活动的平均小时数。对于蓝色代表的男性来说，最常见的活动是看电视，每周 13 小时，其次是每周上网 12 小时，而最不常见的活动是打扫房间，每周 3 小时。相比之下，女性最常见的活动（以粉色表示）是烹饪，每周 15 小时，而最不常见的活动是园艺，每周 2 小时。总之，该图展示了有趣的比较。

answer: This image shows the working principle of water power generation. Firstly, water is sourced from the reservoir and gets into the system via an intake. After the intake, the water enters a penstock which leads to a turbine. The water can power the turbine which can generate electricity with a generator. The generator is assembled in a powerhouse. The electricity generated can be provided to the users via long distance power lines. The water can go back to the river and the process can be continued. In conclusion, this image gives a vivid demonstration of the process of water power generation.
answer_zh: 该图显示了水力发电的工作原理。首先，水来自水库并通过进水口进入系统。取水后，水进入通向涡轮机的压力管道。水可以为涡轮机提供动力，涡轮机可以通过发电机发电。发电机组装在动力室中。产生的电力可以通过长距离电力线提供给用户。水可以返回河流，这个过程可以继续。总之，这张图片生动地展示了水力发电的过程。

answer: This line graph contains the information about number of arrests per year for using illegal drugs from 1991 to 2005. It starts at 10 arrests in 1991 and increases to about 23 arrests in 1993, followed by a much steeper increase to about 60 arrests in 1995 and remains constant until 1997. The number decreases after that to 40 arrests in 1999, but then increases again to a maximum of 70 arrests in 2000. The number remains relatively stable in the last three years and concludes at 40 arrests in 2005. In conclusion, this graph gives an interesting trend.
answer_zh: 该折线图包含 1991 年至 2005 年间每年因使用非法毒品而被捕的人数信息。从 1991 年的 10 人逮捕开始，到 1993 年增加到约 23 人被捕，随后急剧增加到 1995 年约 60 人被捕，并保持不变，直到 1997 年。此后，该数字减少到 1999 年被捕 40 人，但随后再次增加到最多2000 年逮捕了 70 人。过去三年中逮捕人数相对稳定，2005 年逮捕人数为 40 人。总而言之，该图给出了一个有趣的趋势。

answer: The bar chart shows the number of men and women doing drama, painting, sculpture and language. For men represented in blue, painting occupies the largest proportion at 25 people while for women represented in green, language is the most common one at 40 people. The pie chart shows the proportion of diﬀerent age groups. 50 or over represented in red occupies the largest proportion at 42%, followed by which 40-49 in orange and 30-39 in yellow have proportions of 26% and 16% respectively. Aged under 20 in blue occupies the least at 5%. In conclusion, these graphs show interesting information.
answer_zh: 条形图显示了从事戏剧、绘画、雕塑和语言活动的男性和女性人数。对于蓝色代表的男性来说，绘画所占比例最大，为 25 人；而对于绿色代表的女性来说，语言是最常见的一项，有 40 人。饼图显示了不同年龄段的比例。 50岁及以上的红色占比最大，为42%，其次是40-49的橙色和30-39的黄色，比例分别为26%和16%。 20岁以下的蓝色人群至少占5%。总之，这些图表显示了有趣的信息。

answer: This line chart presents the information about renewable energy total consumption and major sources from 1949 to 2008, measured in quadrillion BTU. The total consumption is represented in red. It starts at 3 quadrillion BTU in 1950 and increases to a maximum of 7 quadrillion BTU in 2000. The consumption of wood and hydroelectric power increases a little at the beginning but remains relatively stable afterwards at about 2 quadrillion BTU. The consumption of wind in green and biofuels in blue has been very little, although there is an increase at the end.
answer_zh: 此折线图显示了 1949 年至 2008 年可再生能源总消耗量和主要来源的信息（以万亿 BTU 为单位）。总消耗量以红色表示。 1950 年开始为 3 万亿 BTU，2000 年增加到最高 7 万亿 BTU。木材和水力发电的消耗在开始时略有增加，但之后保持相对稳定，约为 2 万亿 BTU。绿色的风能消耗量和蓝色的生物燃料消耗量非常少，尽管最后有所增加。

answer: This image illustrates the world water distribution. We can see from the image that 98% of the world water is salt water, represented in purple, and only 2% is fresh water, represented in green. In the fresh water sector, ice, which is represented in blue, occupies the largest proportion at 87%, followed by which ground water in purple occupies 12%. Rivers and lakes, which are represented in yellow, occupy the least proportion at only 1%. in conclusion, these pie charts demonstrates signiﬁcant information about world water distribution.
answer_zh: 该图显示了世界水资源的分布。从图中我们可以看到，世界上98%的水是咸水，用紫色表示，只有2%是淡水，用绿色表示。在淡水领域，以蓝色表示的冰所占比例最大，为87%，其次是紫色的地下水，占12%。黄色代表的河流和湖泊所占比例最少，仅为1%。总之，这些饼图展示了有关世界水资源分布的重要信息。

answer: This bar chart illustrates the information about estimated world illiteracy rates, by region including developed countries, East Asia and South Asia, and by gender including male and female, in 2000. for male which is represented in blue, the highest illiteracy rate is in South Asia, at 35%, while the lowest rate is in developed countries at about 1%. For female which is represented in red, the highest illiteracy rate can be found in South Asia as well at 55%, but the rates in Arab States and Sub-Saharan Africa are also high. In conclusion, this bar chart demonstrates very interesting comparisons and information.
answer_zh: 该条形图显示了 2000 年按地区（包括发达国家、东亚和南亚）以及按性别（包括男性和女性）估计的世界文盲率信息。对于以蓝色表示的男性，文盲率最高的是南亚，为 35%，最低的是发达国家，约为 1%。对于红色代表的女性来说，南亚的文盲率最高，也达到 55%，但阿拉伯国家和撒哈拉以南非洲的文盲率也很高。总之，这个条形图展示了非常有趣的比较和信息。

answer: This line graph gives the information about U.S energy consumption by fuel measured in quadrillion units from 1980 to 2030. Petrol and oil has the largest consumption, starting at 35 quadrillion units in 1980 and increasing to a maximum of 50 quadrillion units in 2030. Followed by that comes the coal and natural gas. Both start at about 20 quadrillion units and increase to about 20-25 quadrillion units in 2030. The consumption of nuclear, solarwind and hydropower shows slight increases but remains relatively stable at about 5 quadrillion units. In conclusion, this graph provides interesting comparisons.
answer_zh: 该折线图提供了 1980 年至 2030 年美国以千万万亿单位为单位的能源消耗信息。汽油和石油的消耗量最大，从 1980 年的 35 万亿单位开始，到 2030 年增加到最多 50 万亿单位。其次是煤炭和天然气。两者起始数量约为20万亿单位，到2030年将增加到约20-25万亿单位。核能、太阳能风能和水力发电的消耗量略有增加，但仍相对稳定在5万亿单位左右。总之，该图提供了有趣的比较。
